Berakhot 1:1: Meematay korin et shema bearvit mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan ad sof haashmura harishona divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim ad chatzot rabban gamliel omer ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar maase shebbau vanav mibbet hammishte amru lo lo karinu et shema amar lahem im lo ala ammud hashshachar chayyavin attem likrot velo zo bilvad ella kal ma sheamru chachamim ad chatzot mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar hekter chalavim veevarim mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar vechal hanneechalim leom echad mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar im ken lamma amru chachamim ad chatzot kede leharchik et haadam min haavera
Berakhot 1:2: Meematay korin et shema beshacharit mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan rabbi eliezer omer ben techelet lecharti vegomrah ad hanetz hachamma rabbi yehoshua omer ad shalosh shaot shekken derech bene melachim laamod beshalosh shaot hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid keadam hakkore vattora
Berakhot 1:3: Bet shammay omrim baerev kal adam yattu veyikreu uvabboker yaamdu shenneemar dvrm v uvshachbecha uvkumecha uvet hillel omrim kal adam kore chedarko shenneemar shm uvlechtecha vadderech im ken lamma neemar uvshachbecha uvkumecha beshaa shebbene adam shochvim uvshaa shebbene adam omdim amar rabbi tarfon ani hayiti va vadderech vehitteti likrot kedivre vet shammay vesikkanti veatzmi mippene hallistim amru lo keday hayita lachuv beatzmecha sheavarta al divre vet hillel
Berakhot 1:4: Bashshachar mevarech shettayim lefaneha veachat leachareha uvaerev shettayim lefaneha ushtayim leachareha achat arukka veachat ketzara makom sheamru lehaarich eno rashshay lekatztzer lekatztzer eno rashshay lehaarich lachtom eno rashshay shello lachtom veshello lachtom eno rashshay lachtom
Berakhot 1:5: Mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim ballelot amar rabbi elazar ben azarya hare ani keven shivim shana velo zachiti shetteamer yetziat mitzrayim ballelot ad shedderashah ben zoma shenneemar dvrm tz lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha yeme chayyecha hayyamim kol yeme chayyecha hallelot vachachamim omrim yeme chayyecha haolam hazze kol yeme chayyecha lehavi limot hammashiach
Berakhot 2:1: Haya kore vattora vehiggia zeman hammikra im kiven libbo yatza veim lav lo yatza bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv uvaemtza shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer baemtza shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv mippene hakkavod bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechal adam
Berakhot 2:2: Ellu hen ben happerakim ben beracha rishona lishniyya ben sheniyya lishma uven shema livehaya im shamoa ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv rabbi yehuda omer ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv lo yafsik amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha lamma kadma shema livehaya im shamoa ella chede sheyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim techilla veachar kach yekabbel alav ol mitzot vehaya im shamoa levayyomer shevehaya im shamoa noheg bayyom uvallayela vayyomer eno noheg ella bayyom
Berakhot 2:3: Hakkore et shema velo hishmia leazno yatza rabbi yose omer lo yatza kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha rabbi yose omer yatza rabbi yehuda omer lo yatza hakkore lemafrea lo yatza kara vetaa yachazor lemakom shettaa
Berakhot 2:4: Haummanin korin berosh hailan o verosh hannidbach ma sheenan rashshain laasot ken battefilla
Berakhot 2:5: Chatan patur mikkeriat shema ballayela harishon ad motzae shabbat im lo asa maase maase berabban gamliel shekkara vallayela harishon shennasa amru lo talmidav lo limmadtanu rabbenu shechatan patur mikkeriat shema ballayela harishon amar lahem eni shomea lachem levattel mimmenni malchut shamayim afillu shaa echat
Berakhot 2:6: Rachatz layela harishon shemmeta ishto amru lo talmidav lo limmadtanu rabbenu sheavel asur lirchotz amar lahem eni chishar kal adam istenis ani
Berakhot 2:7: Uchshemmet tavi avdo kibbel alav tanchumin amru lo talmidav lo limmadtanu rabbenu sheen mekabbelin tanchumin al haavadim amar lahem en tavi avdi kishar kal haavadim kasher haya
Berakhot 2:8: Chatan im ratza likrot keriat shema layela harishon kore rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo chal harotze littol et hashshem yittol
Berakhot 3:1: Mi shemmeto mutal lefanav patur mikkeriat shema min hattefilla umin hattefillin nose hammitta vechillufehen vechillufe chillufehen et shellifne hammitta veet shelleachar hammitta et shellammitta tzorech bahen peturim veet sheen lammitta tzorech bahen chayyavin ellu vaellu peturim min hattefilla
Berakhot 3:2: Kavru et hammet vechazru im yecholin lehatchil veligmor ad shello yaggiu lashshura yatchilu veim lav lo yatchilu haomdim bashshura happenimim peturim vehachitzonim chayyavin
Berakhot 3:3: Nashim vaavadim uktannim peturin mikkeriat shema umin hattefillin vechayyavin bitfilla uvimzuza uvvirkat hammazon
Berakhot 3:4: Baal keri meharher belibbo veeno mevarech lo lefaneha velo leachareha veal hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav rabbi yehuda omer mevarech lifnehem ulacharehem
Berakhot 3:5: Haya omed battefilla venizkar shehu vaal keri lo yafsik ella yekatztzer yarad litbol im yachol laalot ulhitkassot velikrot ad shello tanetz hachamma yaale veyitkasse veyikra veim lav yitkasse vammayim veyikra aval lo yitkasse lo vammayim haraim velo veme hammishra ad sheyyattil letochan mayim vechamma yarchik mehem umin hatztzoa arba ammot
Berakhot 3:6: Zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera vehamshammeshet sheraata nidda tzerichin tevila verabbi yehuda poter
Berakhot 4:1: Tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot rabbi yehuda omer ad arba shaot tefillat hammincha ad haerev rabbi yehuda omer ad pelag hammincha tefillat haerev en lah keva veshel musafin kal hayyom rabbi yehuda omer ad sheva shaot
Berakhot 4:2: Rabbi nechunya ben hakkana haya mitpallel bichnisato levet hammidrash uvitziato tefilla ketzara amru lo ma makom litfilla zo amar lahem bichnisati ani mitpallel shello teera takala al yadi uvitziati ani noten hodaya al chelki
Berakhot 4:3: Rabban gamliel omer bechal yom mitpallel adam shemone esre rabbi yehoshua omer meen shemone esre rabbi akiva omer im shegura tefillato befiv yitpallel shemone esre veim lav meen shemone esre
Berakhot 4:4: Rabbi eliezer omer haose tefillato keva en tefillato tachanunim rabbi yehoshua omer hamhallech bimkom sakkana mitpallel tefilla ketzara omer hosha hashshem et ammecha et sheerit yisrael bechal parashat haibbur yihu tzarchehem lefanecha baruch atta shomea tefilla
Berakhot 4:5: Haya rochev al hachamor yered veim eno yachol lered yachazir et panav veim eno yachol lehachazir et panav yechaven et libbo keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim
Berakhot 4:6: Haya yoshev bisfina o vekaron o veasda yechaven et libbo keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim
Berakhot 4:7: Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer en tefillat hammusafin ella bechever ir vachachamim omrim bechever ir veshello vechever ir rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo kal makom sheyyesh chever ir hayyachid patur mittefillat hammusafin
Berakhot 5:1: En omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh chasidim harishonim hau shohim shaa achat umitpallelim kede sheyechavvenu et libbam lammakom afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu vaafillu nachash karuch al akevo lo yafsik
Berakhot 5:2: Mazkirin gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim veshoalin haggeshamim bevirkat hashshanim vehavdala bechonen haddaat rabbi akiva omer omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah rabbi eliezer omer behodaa
Berakhot 5:3: Haomer al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha veal tov yizzacher shemecha modim modim meshattekin oto haover lifne hatteva vetaa yaavor acher tachtav velo yehe sarvan beotah shaa minnayin hu matchil mittechillat habberacha shettaa vah
Berakhot 5:4: Haover lifne hatteva lo yaane achar hakkohanim amen mippene hatteruf veim en sham kohen ella hu lo yissa et kappav veim havtachato shehu nose et kappav vechozer litfillato rashshay
Berakhot 5:5: Hammitpallel vetaa siman ra lo veim sheliach tzibbur hu siman ra lesholchav mippene sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto amru alav al rabbi chanina ven dosa keshehaya mitpallel al hacholim veomer ze chay veze met amru lo minnayin atta yodea amar lahem im shegura tefillati befi yodea ani shehu mekubbal veim lav yodea ani shehu metoraf
Berakhot 6:1: Ketzad mevarchin al happerot al perot hailan omer bore peri haetz chutz min hayyayin sheal hayyayin omer bore peri haggafen veal perot haaretz omer bore peri haadama chutz min happat sheal happat hu omer hammotzi lechem min haaretz veal hayerakot omer bore peri haadama rabbi yehuda omer bore mine deshaim
Berakhot 6:2: Berach al perot hailan bore peri haadama yatza veal perot haaretz bore peri haetz lo yatza al kullam im amar shehakkol nihya yatza
Berakhot 6:3: Al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz omer shehakkol al hachometz veal hannovlot veal haggovay omer shehakkol al hechalav veal haggevina veal habbetzim omer shehakkol rabbi yehuda omer kal shehu min kelala en mevarchin alav
Berakhot 6:4: Hau lefanav minim harbe rabbi yehuda omer im yesh benehem mimmin shiva mevarech alav vachachamim omrim mevarech al eze mehem sheyyirtze
Berakhot 6:5: Berach al hayyayin shellifne hammazon patar et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon berach al happarperet shellifne hammazon patar et happarperet shelleachar hammazon berach al happat patar et happarperet al happarperet lo fatar et happat bet shammay omrim af lo maase kedera
Berakhot 6:6: Hau yoshvin leechol kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo hesebbu echad mevarech lechullan ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo leachar hammazon echad mevarech lechullam vehu omer al hammugmar af al pi sheen meviin et hammugmar ella leachar hasseudda
Berakhot 6:7: Heviu lefanav maliach battechilla ufat immo mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat shehappat tefela lo ze hakkelal kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela
Berakhot 6:8: Achal teenim anavim verimmonim mevarech acharehen shalosh berachot divre rabban gamliel vachachamim omrim beracha achat meen shalosh rabbi akiva omer afillu achal shelek vehu mezono mevarech acharav shalosh berachot hashshote mayim litzmao omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro rabbi tarfon omer bore nefashot rabbot
Berakhot 7:1: Shelosha sheachlu cheechad chayyavin lezammen achal demay umaaser rishon shennittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehashshammash sheachal kazzayit vehakkuti mezammenin alehem aval achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkazzayit vehannachri en mezammenin alehem
Berakhot 7:2: Nashim vaavadim uktannim en mezammenin alehem ad kamma mezammenin ad kazzayit rabbi yehuda omer ad kabbetza
Berakhot 7:3: Ketzad mezammenin bishlosha omer nevarech bishlosha vehu omer barchu baasara omer nevarech lelohenu baasara vahu omer barchu echad asara veechad asara ribbo bemea omer nevarech laya elohenu bemea vehu omer barchu beelef omer nevarech laya elohenu elohe yisrael beelef vehu omer barchu beribbo omer nevarech laya elohenu elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu beribbo vehu omer barchu keinyan shehu mevarech kach onin acharav baruch Adonai elohenu elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu rabbi yose haggelili omer lefi rov hakkahal hen mevarchin shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael tehillim sach amar rabbi akiva ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset echad merubbin veechad muatin omer barchu et Adonai rabbi yishmael omer barchu et Adonai hamvorach
Berakhot 7:4: Shelosha sheachlu cheechad enan rashshain lechalek vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha shishsha nechelakin ad asara vaasara enan nechelakin ad sheyyihu esrim
Berakhot 7:5: Shette chavurot shehau ochlot bevayit echad bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu hare ellu mitztarfim lezimmun veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman en mevarchin al hayyayin ad sheyyitten letocho mayim divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim mevarchin
Berakhot 8:1: Ellu devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel basseudda bet shammay omrim mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin uvet hillel omrim mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom
Berakhot 8:2: Bet shammay omrim notlin layyadayim veachar kach mozgin et hakkos uvet hillel omrim mozgin et hakkos veachar kach notlin layyadayim
Berakhot 8:3: Bet shammay omrim mekanneach yadav bammappa umannichah al hashshulchan uvet hillel omrim al hakkeset
Berakhot 8:4: Bet shammay omrim mechabbedin et habbayit veachar kach notlin layyadayim uvet hillel omrim notlin layyadayim veachar kach mechabbedin et habbayit
Berakhot 8:5: Bet shammay omrim ner umazon uvsamim vehavdala uvet hillel omrim ner uvsamim umazon vehavdala bet shammay omrim shebbara meor haesh uvet hillel omrim bore meore haesh
Berakhot 8:6: En mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel ovde chochavim velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel metim velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shellifne avoda zara en mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro
Berakhot 8:7: Mi sheachal veshachach velo verach bet shammay omrim yachazor limkomo vivarech uvet hillel omrim yevarech bammakom shennizkar ad ematay hu mevarech ad kede sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav
Berakhot 8:8: Ba lahem yayin leachar hammazon veen sham ella oto hakkos bet shammay omrim mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon uvet hillel omrim mevarech al hammazon veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin onin amen achar yisrael hamvarech veen onin amen achar hakkuti hamvarech ad sheyyishma kal habberacha
Berakhot 9:1: Haroe makom shennaasu vo nissim leyisrael omer baruch sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara omer baruch sheakar avoda zara meartzenu
Berakhot 9:2: Al hazzikin veal hazzevaot veal habberakim veal haramim veal haruchot omer baruch shekkocho ugvurato male olam al heharim veal haggevaot veal hayyammim veal hanneharot veal hammidbarot omer baruch ose maase vereshit rabbi yehuda omer haroe et hayyam haggadol omer baruch sheasa et hayyam haggadol bizman sheroe oto lifrakim al haggeshamim veal habbesorot hattovot omer baruch hattov vehammetiv veal shemuot raot omer baruch dayyan haemet
Berakhot 9:3: Bana vayit chadash vekana chelim chadashim omer baruch shehecheyanu mevarech al haraa meen hattova veal hattova meen haraa hatztzoek lesheavar hare zo tefillat shave ketzad hayeta ishto meubberet veamar yehi ratzon shetteled ishti zachar hare zo tefillat shave haya va vadderech veshama kol tzevacha bair veamar yehi ratzon shello yihu ellu bene veti hare zo tefillat shave
Berakhot 9:4: Hannichnas lichrach mitpallel shettayim achat bichnisato veachat bitziato ben azzay omer arba shettayim bichnisato ushtayim bitziato venoten hodaa lesheavar vetzoek leatid lavo
Berakhot 9:5: Chayyav adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova shenneemar dvrm v veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechal levavcha uvchal nafshecha uvchal meodecha bechal levavcha bishne yetzarecha beyetzer tov uvyetzer ra uvchal nafshecha afillu hu notel et nafshecha uvchal meodecha bechal mamonecha davar acher bechal meodecha bechal midda umidda shehu moded lecha heve mode lo bimod meod lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar hammizrach shehu mechuvan keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim lo yikkanes lehar habbayit bemaklo uvminalo uvfundato uvavak sheal raglav velo yaasennu kappandarya urkika mikkal vachomer kal chotme verachot shehau vammikdash hau omrim min haolam mishshekkilkelu hamminin veamru en olam ella echad hitkinu sheyehu omrim min haolam vead haolam vehitkinu sheyehe adam shoel et shelom chavero bashshem shenneemar rt be vehinne voaz ba mibbet lechem vayyomer lakkotzrim Adonai immachem vayyomru lo yevarechcha Adonai veomer shftm v Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil veomer mshly chg al tavuz ki zakna immecha veomer tehillim kt et laasot laya heferu toratecha rabbi natan omer heferu toratecha et laasot laya
Peah 1:1: Ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur happea vehabbikkurim vehareaon ugmilut chasadim vetalmud tora ellu devarim sheadam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba kibbud av vaem ugmilut chasadim vahavaat shalom ben adam lachavero vetalmud tora keneged kullam
Peah 1:2: En pochatin lappea mishshishshim veaf al pi sheamru en lappea shiur hakkol lefi godel hassade ulfi rov haaniyyim ulfi rov haanava
Peah 1:3: Notnin pea mittechillat hassade umeemtzaah rabbi shimon omer uvilvad sheyyitten bassof kashshiur rabbi yehuda omer im shiyyer kelach echad somech lo mishshum pea veim lav eno noten ella mishshum hefker
Peah 1:4: Kelal amru bappea kal shehu ochel venishmar vegiddulav min haaretz ulkitato cheachat umachniso lekiyyum chayyav bappea vehattevua vehakkitniyyot bakkelal hazze
Peah 1:5: Uvailan haog vehecharuvin vehaegozim vehashshekedim vehaggefanim veharimmonim vehazzetim vehattemarim chayyavin bappea
Peah 1:6: Leolam hu noten mishshum pea ufatur min hammaasrot ad sheyemareach venoten mishshum hefker ufatur min hammaasrot ad sheyemareach umaachil labbehema velachayya velaofot ufatur min hammaasrot ad sheyemareach venotel min haggoren vezorea ufatur min hammaasrot ad sheyemareach divre rabbi akiva kohen velevi shellakchu et haggoren hammaasrot shellahem ad sheyemareach hammakdish ufode chayyav bemaasrot ad sheyemareach haggizbar
Peah 2:1: Veellu mafsikin lappea hannachal vehashshelulit vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim ushvil harabbim ushvil hayyachid hakkavua bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim vehabbur vehannir vezera acher vehakkotzer leshachat mafsik divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim eno mafsik ella im ken charash
Peah 2:2: Ammat hammayim sheenah yechola lehikkatzer keachat rabbi yehuda omer mafseket vechol heharim asher bammader yeaderun af al pi sheen habbakar yachol laavor bechelav hu noten pea lakkol
Peah 2:3: Hakkol mafsik lazzeraim veeno mafsik lailan ella gader veim haya sear kotesh eno mafsik ella noten pea lakkol
Peah 2:4: Velecharuvin kal haroin ze et ze amar rabban gamliel nohagin hau bet abba notnin pea achat lazzetim shehau lahem bechal ruach velecharuvin kal haroin ze et ze rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer mishshemo af lecharuvin shehau lahem bechal hair
Peah 2:5: Hazzorea et sadehu min echad af al pi shehu osehu shette geranot noten pea achat zeraah shene minin af al pi sheasaan goren achat noten shette feot hazzorea et sadehu shene mine chittin asaan goren achat noten pea achat shette geranot noten shette feot
Peah 2:6: Maase shezzara rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa lifne rabban gamliel vealu lelishkat haggazit veshaalu amar nachum hallavlar mekubbal ani merabbi meyasha shekkibbel meabba shekkibbel min hazzugot shekkibbelu min hanneviim halacha lemoshe missinay bezorea et sadehu shene mine chittin im asaan goren achat noten pea achat shette geranot noten shette feot
Peah 2:7: Sade shekketzaruha kutim ketzaruha listim kirsemuha nemalim shevarattah haruach o vehema petura katzar chetzyah vekatzru listim chetzyah petura shechovat happea bakkama
Peah 2:8: Ketzaruha listim chetzyah vekatzar hu chetzyah noten pea mimma shekkatzar katzar chetzyah umachar chetzyah hallokeach noten pea lakkol katzar chetzyah vehikdish chetzyah happode miyyad haggizbar hu noten pea lakkol
Peah 3:1: Malbenot hattevua shebben hazzetim bet shammay omrim pea mikkal achat veechat bet hillel omrim meechad al hakkol umodim sheim hau rashe shurot meoravin shehu noten pea meechad al hakkol
Peah 3:2: Hamnammer et sadehu veshiyyer kelachim lachim rabbi akiva omer noten pea mikkal echad veechad vachachamim omrim meechad al hakkol umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva bezorea shevet o chardal bishlosha mekomot shehu noten pea mikkal echad veechad
Peah 3:3: Hammachalik betzalim lachim lashshuk umkayyem yeveshim laggoren noten pea laellu leatzman velaellu leatzman vechen baafunin vechen bakkerem hammedel noten min hamshoar al ma sheshshiyyer vehammachalik meachat yad noten min hamshoar al hakkol
Peah 3:4: Haimmahot shel betzalim chayyavot befea verabbi yose poter malbenot habbetzalim shebben hayyarak rabbi yose omer pea mikkal achat veechat vachachamim omrim meachat al hakkol
Peah 3:5: Haachin shechalku notnin shette feot chazru venishtattefu notnin pea achat shenayim shellakchu et hailan notnin pea achat lakach ze tzefono veze deromo ze noten pea leatzmo veze noten pea leatzmo hammocher kilche ilan betoch sadehu noten pea mikkal echad veechad amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shello shiyyer baal hassade aval im shiyyer baal hassade hu noten pea lakkol
Peah 3:6: Rabbi eliezer omer karka bet rova chayyevet bappea rabbi yehoshua omer haosa satayim rabbi tarfon omer shishsha al shishsha tefachim rabbi yehuda ven betera omer kede liktzor velishnot vahalacha kidvarav rabbi akiva omer karka kal shehu chayyevet bappea uvabbikkurim velichtov alav perozbul veliknot immo nechasim sheen lahem acharaut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka
Peah 3:7: Hakkotev nechasav shechiv mera shiyyer karka kal shehu mattenato mattana lo shiyyer karka kal shehu en mattenato mattana hakkotev nechasav levanav vechatav leishto karka kal shehu ibbeda chetubbatah rabbi yose omer im kibbela aleha af al pi shello chatav lah ibbeda chetubbatah
Peah 3:8: Hakkotev nechasav leavdo yatza ven chorin shiyyer karka kal shehu lo yatza ven chorin rabbi shimon omer leolam hu ven chorin ad sheyyomar hare chal nechasay netunin leish peloni avdi chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen
Peah 4:1: Happea nittenet bimchubbar lakkarka bedalit uvdekel baal habbayit morid umchallek laaniyyim rabbi shimon omer af bachalike egozim afillu tishim vetisha omrim lechallek veechad omer lavoz laze shomin sheamar kahalacha

Peah 5:2: Shibbolet shebbakkatzir veroshah maggia lakkama im niktzera im hakkama hare hi shel baal habbayit veim lav hare hi shel aniyyim shibbolet shel leket shennitarva vaggadish measser shibbolet achat venoten lo amar rabbi eliezer vechi heach heani hazze machalif davar shello va virshuto ella mezakke et heani bechal haggadish umasser shibbolet achat venoten lo
Peah 5:3: En megalgelin betofeach divre rabbi meir vachachamim mattirin mippene sheefshar

Peah 5:5: Hammachalif im haaniyyim beshello patur uvshel aniyyim chayyav shenayim shekkibbelu et hassade baarisut ze noten laze chelko masar ani veze noten laze chelko masar ani hamkabbel sade liktzor asur beleket shichcha ufea umasar ani amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shekkibbel mimmennu lemechetza lishlish velirvia aval im amar lo shelish ma sheatta kotzer shellach muttar beleket uvshichcha uvfea veasur bemasar ani
Peah 5:6: Hammocher et sadehu hammocher muttar vehallokeach asur lo yiskor adam et happoalim al menat sheyelakket beno acharav mi sheeno manniach et haaniyyim lilkot o shehu manniach et echad veechad lo o shehu mesayyea et echad mehen hare ze gozel et haaniyyim al ze neemar mshly chv al tasseg gevul olim
Peah 5:7: Haomer sheshshechachuhu foalim velo shechacho vaal habbayit shechacho vaal habbayit velo shechachuhu foalim amdu aniyyim befanav o shechippuhu vekash hare ze eno shichcha
Peah 5:8: Hamammer lechovaot ulchumsaot lacharara velaomarim en lo shichcha mimmennu velaggoren yesh lo shichcha hamammer laggadish yesh lo shichcha mimmennu velaggoren en lo shichcha ze hakkelal kal hamammer lemakom shehu gemar melacha yesh lo shichcha mimmennu velaggoren en lo shichcha lemakom sheeno gemar melacha en lo shichcha mimmennu velaggoren yesh lo shichcha
Peah 6:1: Bet shammay omrim hevker laaniyyim hevker uvet hillel omrim eno hefker ad sheyyufkar af laashirim kashshemitta kal amre hassade shel kav kav veechad shel arbaat kabbin ushchacho bet shammay omrim eno shichcha uvet hillel omrim shichcha
Peah 6:2: Haomer shehu samuch laggafa velaggadish labbakar velakkelim ushchacho bet shammay omrim eno shichcha uvet hillel omrim shichcha

Peah 6:5: Shene omarim shichcha ushlosha enan shichcha shene tzibbure zetim vecharuvin shichcha ushlosha enan shichcha shene hutzne fishtan shichcha ushlosha enan shichcha shene gargerim peret ushlosha enan peret shene shibbolim leket ushlosha enan leket ellu kedivre vet hillel veal kullan bet shammay omrim shelosha laaniyyim vearbaa levaal habbayit
Peah 6:6: Haomer sheyyesh bo satayim ushchacho eno shichcha shene omarim uvahem satayim rabban gamliel omer levaal habbayit vachachamim omrim laaniyyim amar rabban gamliel vechi merov haomarim yuppe choach shel baal habbayit o hura kocho amru lo yuppe chocho amar lahem uma im bizman shehu omer echad uvo satayim ushchacho eno shichcha shene omarim uvahem satayim eno din shello yehe shichcha amru lo lo im amarta beomer echad shehu chegadish tomar bishne omarim shehen kichrichot
Peah 6:7: Kama sheyyesh bah satayim ushchachah enah shichcha en bah satayim aval hi reuya laasot satayim afillu hi shel tofeach roin otah keillu hi anava shel seorim
Peah 6:8: Hakkama matztzelet et haomer veet hakkama haomer eno matztzil lo et haomer velo et hakkama ezo hi kama shehi matztzelet et haomer kal sheenah shichcha afillu kelach echad
Peah 6:9: Sea tevua akura usa sheenah akura vechen bailan vehashshum vehabbetzalim enan mitztarfin lesatayim ella shel aniyyim hem rabbi yose omer im bat reshut heani baemtza enan mitztarfin veim lav hare ellu mitztarfin
Peah 6:10: Tevua shennittena leshachat o laalumma vechen baagudde hashshum vaaguddot hashshum vehabbetzalim en lahen shichcha vechal hattemunim baaretz kegon halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim rabbi yehuda omer en lahem shichcha vachachamim omrim yesh lahem shichcha
Peah 6:11: Hakkotzer ballayela vehamammer vehassuma yesh lahem shichcha veim haya mitkaven littol et haggas haggas en lo shichcha im amar hare ani kotzer al menat ma sheani shochech ani ettol yesh lo shichcha
Peah 7:1: Kal zayit sheyyesh lo shem bassade afillu kezet hannetofa bishato ushchacho eno shichcha bamme devarim amurim bishmo uvmaasav uvimkomo bishmo shehaya shifchoni o veshani bemaasav shehu ose harbe bimkomo shehu omed betzad haggat o vetzad happirtza ushar kal hazzetim shenayim shichcha ushlosha enan shichcha rabbi yose omer en shichcha lazzetim
Peah 7:2: Zayit shennimtza omed ben shalosh shurot shel shene malbenim ushchacho eno shichcha zayit sheyyesh bo satayim ushchacho eno shichcha bamme devarim amurim bizman shello hitchil bo aval im hitchil bo afillu kezet hannetofa bishato ushchacho yesh lo shichcha kal zeman sheyyesh lo tachtav yesh lo verosho rabbi meir omer mishshettelech hammachave
Peah 7:3: Ezehu feret hannosher bishat habbetzira haya votzer akatz et haeshkol husbach bealim nafal miyyado laaretz venifrat hare hu shel baal habbayit hammanniach et hakkalkala tachat haggefen beshaa shehu votzer hare ze gozel et haaniyyim al ze neemar mshly chv al tasseg gevul olim
Peah 7:4: Ezohi olelet kal sheen lah lo chatef velo natef im yesh lah katef o natef shel baal habbayit im safek laaniyyim olelet shebbaarkubba im nikretzet im haeshkol hare hi shel baal habbayit veim lav hare hi shel aniyyim garger yechidi rabbi yehuda omer eshkol vachachamim omrim olelet
Peah 7:5: Hammedel baggefanim keshem shehu medel betoch shello ken hu medel beshel aniyyim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer beshello hu rashshay veeno rashshay beshel aniyyim
Peah 7:6: Kerem revai bet shammay omrim en lo chomesh veen lo viur bet hillel omrim yesh lo bet shammay omrim yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot vehaaniyyim podin leatzman uvet hillel omrim kullo laggat
Peah 7:7: Kerem shekkullo ollot rabbi eliezer omer levaal habbayit rabbi akiva omer laaniyyim amar rabbi eliezer ki tivtzor lo teolel dvrm kad im en batzir minnayin ollot amar lo rabbi akiva vecharmecha lo teolel vkr yt afillu chullo ollot im ken lamma neemar ki tivtzor lo teolel en laaniyyim baollot kodem habbatzir
Peah 7:8: Hammakdish karmo ad shello nodu vo haollot en haollot laaniyyim mishshennodu vo haollot haollot laaniyyim rabbi yose omer yittenu sechar giddulav lahekdesh eze hi shichcha bearis kal sheeno yachol lifshot et yado velittelah uvrogliyyot mishsheyyaavor hemenna
Peah 8:1: Meematay kal adam muttarin beleket mishsheyyelchu hannamoshot beferet veollot mishsheyyelchu haaniyyim bakkerem veyavou uvzetim mishshettered revia sheniyya amar rabbi yehuda vahalo yesh sheenam moskin et zetehem ella leachar revia sheniyya ella chede sheyehe heani yotze velo yehe mevi bearbaa issarot
Peah 8:2: Neemanim al halleket veal hashshichcha veal happea bishatan veal masar ani bechal shenato uven levi neeman leolam veenan neemanin ella al davar shebbene adam nohagin ken
Peah 8:3: Neemanin al hachittim veen neemanin al hakkemach velo al happat neemanin al hasseora shel orez veen neemanin alav ben chay ben mevushshal neemanin al happol veen neemanin al haggerisin lo chayyim velo mevushshalin neemanin al hashshemen lomar shel masar ani hu veen neemanin alav lomar shel zete nikkuf hu
Peah 8:4: Neemanim al hayyarak chay veen neemanim al hamvushshal ella im ken haya lo davar muat shekken derech baal habbayit lihot motzi millefaso
Peah 8:5: En pochatin laaniyyim baggoren mechatzi kav chittim vekav seorim rabbi meir omer chatzi kav kav vachetzi chussemin vekav gerogarot o mane devela rabbi akiva omer peras chatzi log yayin rabbi akiva omer reviit reviit shemen rabbi akiva omer sheminit ushar kal happerot amar abba shaul kede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bahem mezon shette seuddot
Peah 8:6: Midda zo amura bechohanim uvilviyyim uvyisreelim haya matztzil notel mechetza venoten mechetza haya lo davar muat noten lifnehem vehen mechallekin benehem
Peah 8:7: En pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar befundeon mearba sein besela lan notnin lo parnasat lina shavat notnin lo mezon shalosh seuddot mi sheyyesh lo mezon shette seuddot lo yittol min hattamchuy mezon arba esre seuddot lo yittol min hakkuppa vehakkuppa nigbet bishnayim umitchalleket bishlosha
Peah 8:8: Mi sheyyesh lo matayim zuz lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani hau lo matayim chaser dinar afillu elef notnin lo cheachat hare ze yittol hau memushkanim levaal chovo o lichtubbat ishto hare ze yittol en mechayevin oto limkor et beto veet kele tashmisho
Peah 8:9: Mi sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz vehu nose venoten bahem hare ze lo yittol vechal mi sheeno tzarich littol venotel eno niftar min haolam ad sheyyitztarech labberiyyot vechal mi shetztzarich littol veeno notel eno met min hazzikna ad sheyefarnes acherim mishshello vealav hakkatuv omer baruch haggever asher yivtach ba vehaya mivtacho yirmeya yz vechen dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto vechal mi sheeno lo chigger velo suma velo fisseach veose atzmo keachad mehem eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyihye keechad mehem shenneemar dvrm tz tzedek tzedek tirdof vechal dayyan shellokeach shochad umatte et haddin eno met min hazzikna ad sheenav kehot shenneemar shmt chg veshochad lo tikkach ki hashshochad yeaver pikchim vego selik massechet pea
Demai 1:1: Hakkallin shebbaddemay hashshitin veharimin vehauzradin uvnot shuach uvnot shikma venovlot hattemara vehaggufnin vehannitzpa uvihuda haog vehachometz shebbihuda vehakkusbar rabbi yehuda omer kal hashshitin peturin chutz mishshel dufra kal harimin peturin chutz merime shikmona kal benot shikma peturot chutz min hammustafos

Demai 2:1: Veellu devarim mitasserin demay bechal makom haddevela vehattemarim vehecharuvim haorez vehakkammon haorez shebbechutza laaretz kal hammishtammesh mimmennu patur
Demai 2:2: Hamkabbel alav lihot neeman measser et shehu ochel veet shehu mocher veet shehu lokeach veeno mitareach etzel am haaretz rabbi yehuda omer af hammitareach etzel am haaretz neeman amru lo al atzmo eno neeman ketzad yehe neeman al shel acherim
Demai 2:3: Hamkabbel alav lihot chaver eno mocher leam haaretz lach veyavesh veeno lokeach mimmennu lach veeno mitarech etzel am haaretz velo mearcho etzlo bichsuto rabbi yehuda omer af lo yegaddel behema dakka velo yehe farutz bindarim uvischok velo yehe mittamme lemetim umshammesh bevet hammidrash amru lo lo vau ellu lakkelal
Demai 2:4: Hannachtomim lo chiyevu otam chachamim lehafrish ella chede terumat maaser vechalla hachenvanim enan rashshain limkor et haddemay kal hammashpiin bemidda gassa rashshain limkor et haddemay ellu hen hammashpiin bemidda gassa kegon hassitonot umochre tevua
Demai 2:5: Rabbi meir omer et sheddarko lehimmaded begassa umdado vedakka tefela dakka laggassa et sheddarko lehimmaded bedakka umadad bagassa tefela gassa laddakka ezo hi midda gassa beyavesh sheloshet kabbin uvlach dinar rabbi yose omer salle teenim vesalle anavim vekuppot shel yarak kal zeman shehu mochran achsara patur
Demai 3:1: Maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay rabban gamliel haya maachil et poalav demay gabbae tzedaka bet shammay omrim notnin et hamussar lesheeno measser veet sheeno meussar limasser nimtzeu chal haadam ochlin metukkan vachachamim omrim govin setam umchallekin setam veharotze letakken yetakken
Demai 3:2: Harotze lachazom ale yarak lehakel mimmassao lo yashlich ad sheyeasser hallokeach yarak min hashshuk venimlach lehachazir lo yachazir ad sheyeasser sheeno mechussar ella minyan haya omed velokeach veraa toan acher yafe mimmennu muttar lehachazir mippene shello mashach
Demai 3:3: Hammotze ferot badderech untalan leachlan venimlach lehatznia lo yatznia ad sheyeasser veim mittechilla netalan bishvil shello yovedu patur kal davar sheen adam rashshay lemachro demay lo yishlach lachavero demay rabbi yose mattir bevadday uvilvad sheyyodiennu
Demai 3:4: Hammolich chittim letochen kuti o letochen am haaretz bechezkatan lammaasrot velashsheviit letochen oved kochavim demay hammafkid perotav etzel hakkuti o etzel am haaretz bechezkatan lammaasrot velashsheviit etzel haoved kochavim keferotav rabbi shimon omer demay
Demai 3:5: Hannoten lefundakit measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel mimmenna mippene shechashuda lachalof amar rabbi yose en anu acharain larammain eno measser ella ma shehu notel mimmenna bilvad
Demai 3:6: Hannoten lachamoto measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel mimmenna mippene shehi chashuda lachalof et hammitkalkel amar rabbi yehuda rotza hi vetakkanat bittah uvosha mechatanah mode rabbi yehuda benoten lachamoto sheviit sheenah chashuda lehachalif lehaachil et bittah sheviit
Demai 4:1: Hallokeach perot mimmi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot veshachach leasseran veshoalo veshabbat yochal al piv chashcha motzae shabbat lo yochal ad sheyeasser lo metzao amar lo echad sheeno neeman al hammaasrot meussarin hen ochel al piv chashcha motzae shabbat lo yochal ad sheyeasser terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah rabbi shimon shezuri omer af bechol shoalo veochlo al piv
Demai 4:2: Hammaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot ochel immo bashshabbat harishona veaf al pi sheeno maamino al hammaasrot uvilvad sheyyomar lo meussarin hen uvshabbat sheniyya af al pi shennadar mimmennu hanaya lo yochal ad sheyeasser
Demai 4:3: Rabbi eliezer omer en adam tzarich likrot shem lemasar ani shel demay vachachamim omrim kore shem veeno tzarich lehafrish
Demai 4:4: Mi shekkara shem litrumat maaser shel demay ulmasar ani shel vadday lo yittelem beshabbat veim haya chohen o ani lemudim leechol etzlo yavou veyochlu uvilvad sheyyodiem
Demai 4:5: Haomer lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot kach li mimmi shehu neeman umimmi shehu measser eno neeman meish peloni hare ze neeman halach likkach mimmennu veamar lo lo metzativ velakachti lecha meacher shehu neeman eno neeman
Demai 4:6: Hannichnas leir veeno makkir adam sham amar mi kan neeman mi kan measser amar lo echad ani eno neeman amar lo ish peloni neeman hare ze neeman halach likkach mimmennu amar lo mi kan mocher yashan amar lo mi sheshshelachacha etzli af al pi shehen kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin
Demai 4:7: Hachammarim shennichnesu leir amar echad shelli chadash veshel chaveri yashan shelli eno metukkan veshel chaveri metukkan enan neemanin rabbi yehuda omer neemanin
Demai 5:1: Hallokeach min hannachtom ketzad hu measser notel kede terumat maaser vechalla veomer echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan hare vetzad ze maaser ushar maaser samuch lo ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav vehashshear challa umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo umchullal al hammaot
Demai 5:2: Harotze lehafrish teruma utrumat maaser keachat notel echad mishsheloshim veshalosh ushlish veomer echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan hare ze betzad ze chullin vehashshear teruma al hakkol umea chullin sheyyesh kan hare ze betzad ze maaser ushar maaser samuch lo ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav vehashshear challa umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo umchullal al hammaot
Demai 5:3: Hallokeach min hannachtom measser min hachamma al hatztzonenet umin hatztzonenet al hachamma afillu mittefusin harbe divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda oser sheani omer chittim shel emesh hau mishshel echad veshel hayyom hau mishshel acher rabbi shimon oser bitrumat maaser umattir bechalla
Demai 5:4: Hallokeach min happalter measser mikkal tefus utfus divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer meachat al hakkol mode rabbi yehuda belokeach min hammanpol shehu measser mikkal echad veechad
Demai 5:5: Hallokech min heani vechen heani shennatnu lo ferusot pat o filche devela measser mikkal echad veechad uvitmarim uvigrogarot bolel venotel amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehammattana merubba aval bizman shehammattana muetet measser mikkal echad veechad
Demai 5:6: Hallokeach min hassiton vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze afillu meoto hassug afillu meoto hammin neeman hassiton lomar mishshel echad hem
Demai 5:7: Hallokeach mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya measser mizze al ze afillu mishshette kuppot afillu mishshette ayarot baal habbayit shehaya mocher yarak bashshuk bizman shemmeviin lo miggannotav measser meachat al hakkol umiggannot acherot measser mikkal echad veechad
Demai 5:8: Hallokeach tevel mishshene mekomot measser mizze al ze af al pi sheamru en adam rashshay limkor tevel ella letzorech
Demai 5:9: Measserin mishshel yisrael al shel nachri mishshel nachri al shel yisrael mishshel yisrael al shel kutim mishshel kutim al shel kutim rabbi eliezer oser mishshel kutim al shel kutim

Terumot 6:2: Bat yisrael sheachla teruma veachar kach nisset lechohen im teruma shello zacha vah kohen achla meshallemet keren vechomesh leatzmah veim teruma shezzacha vah kohen achla meshallemet keren labbealim vechomesh leatzmah mippene sheamru haochel teruma shogeg meshallem keren labbealim vechomesh lechal mi sheyyirtze
Terumot 6:3: Hammaachil et poalav veet orchav teruma hu meshallem et hakkeren vehem meshallemin et hachomesh divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim hem meshallemin keren vechomesh vehu meshallem lahem deme seudatan
Terumot 6:4: Haggonev teruma velo achalah meshallem tashlume chefel deme teruma achalah meshallem shene keranim vechomesh keren vechomesh min hachullin vekeren deme teruma ganav terumat hekdesh vaachalah meshallem shene chomashim vekeren sheen bahekdesh tashlume chafel
Terumot 6:5: En meshallemin min halleket umin hashshichcha umin happea umin hahefker velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato velo mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu sheen hekdesh pode et hakkodesh divre rabbi meir vachachamim mattirin baellu
Terumot 6:6: Rabbi eliezer omer meshallemin mimmin al sheeno mino bilvad sheyeshallem min hayyafe al hara verabbi akiva omer en meshallemin ella mimmin al mino lefichach im achal kishshuin shel erev sheviit yamtin lekishshuin shel motzae sheviit vishallem mehem mimmekom sherabbi eliezer mekel mishsham rabbi akiva machmir shenneemar vkr chv venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh kal shehu rauy lihot kodesh divre rabbi eliezer verabbi akiva omer venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh kodesh sheachal
Terumot 7:1: Haochel teruma mezid meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh hattashlumin chullin im ratza hakkohen limchol mochel
Terumot 7:2: Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veachar kach achla teruma meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh umitatah bisrefa nisset leechad mikkal happesulin meshallemet keren vechomesh umitatah bechenek divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim zo vazo meshallemot et hakkeren veenan meshallemot et hachomesh umitatan bisrefa
Terumot 7:3: Hammaachil et banav ketannim veet avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim haochel terumat chutza laaretz vehaochel pachot mikkazzayit teruma meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh vehattashlumin chullin im ratza hakkohen limchol mochel
Terumot 7:4: Ze hakkelal kal hamshallem keren vechomesh hattashlumin teruma im ratza hakkohen limchol eno mochel vechal hamshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh hattashlumin chullin im ratza hakkohen limchol mochel
Terumot 7:5: Shette kuppot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin shennafla sea teruma letoch achat mehen veen yadua leezo mehen nafla hare ani omer letoch shel teruma nafla en yadua ezo hi shel teruma veezo hi shel chullin achal achat mehen patur vehashsheniyya noheg bah kitruma vechayyevet bechalla divre rabbi meir rabbi yose potrah achal acher et hashsheniyya patur achal echad et shettehen meshallem kakketanna shebbishtehen
Terumot 7:6: Nafla achat mehen letoch hachullin enah medammatan vehashsheniyya noheg bah kitruma vechayyevet bechalla divre rabbi meir verabbi yose poter nafla sheniyya lemakom acher enah medammatan naflu shettehen lemakom echad medammeot kakketanna shebbishtehen
Terumot 7:7: Zara et achat mehen patur vehashsheniyya noheg bah kitruma vechayyevet bechalla divre rabbi meir verabbi yose poter zara acher et hashsheniyya patur zara echad et shettehen bedavar shezzaro chale muttar uvdavar sheen zaro chale asur
Terumot 8:1: Haishsha shehayeta ochelet bitruma bau veamru lah met balich o gershech vechen haeved shehaya ochel bitruma uvau veamru lo met rabbach o mecharach leyisrael o netanach bemattana o asaach ben chorin vechen kohen shehaya ochel bitruma venoda shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh verabbi yehoshua poter haya omed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach venoda shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza rabbi eliezer omer kal hakkarbanot shehikriv al gabbe hammizbeach pesulim verabbi yehoshua machshir noda shehu vaal mum avodato pesula
Terumot 8:2: Vechullam shehayeta teruma vetoch pihem rabbi eliezer omer yivleu verabbi yehoshua omer yiflotu amru lo nitmeta venitmet teruma rabbi eliezer omer yivla verabbi yehoshua omer yiflot tame hayita utmea hayeta teruma o noda shehu tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu o shettaam taam pishpesh letoch piv hare ze yiflot
Terumot 8:3: Haya ochel beeshkol venichnas min hagginna lechatzer rabbi eliezer omer yigmor verabbi yehoshua omer lo yigmor chashecha lele shabbat rabbi yehoshua omer yigmor verabbi eliezer omer lo yigmor
Terumot 8:4: Yayin shel teruma shennitgalla yishshafech veen tzarich lomar shel chullin shelosha mashkin asurim mishshum gilluy hammayim vehayyayin vehechalav ushar kal hammashkin muttarim kamma yishhu veyihu asurin kede sheyyetze harachash mimmakom karov veyishte
Terumot 8:5: Shiur hammayim hamgullin kede shettovad bahem hammara rabbi yose omer bechelim kal shehen uvakkarkaot arbaim sea
Terumot 8:6: Nikkure teenim vaanavim vekishshuin vehaddeluin vehaavattichim vehammelaffonot afillu hem kikkar echad gadol veechad katan echad talush veechad mechubbar kal sheyyesh bo lecha asur unshuchat hannachash asura mippene sakkanat nefashot
Terumot 8:7: Hamshammeret shel yayin asura mishshum gilluy rabbi nechemya mattir
Terumot 8:8: Chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tuma rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta munnachat bimkom turpa yannichenna bemakom hammutzna veim hayeta megulla yechassenna verabbi yehoshua omer im hayeta munnachat bemakom mutzna yannichenna bimkom turpa veim hayeta mechussa yegallenna rabban gamliel omer al yechaddesh bah davar
Terumot 8:9: Chavit shennishbera baggat haelona vehattachtona temea mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yecholim lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betahora yatztzil veim lav rabbi eliezer omer tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna veyadav
Terumot 8:10: Vechen chavit shel shemen shennishpecha mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betahora yatztzil veim lav rabbi eliezer omer tered vetibbala veal yevalleenna veyadav
Terumot 8:11: Veal zo veal zo amar rabbi yehoshua lo zo hi teruma sheani muzhar aleha milletammeah ella milleachlah uval tetammeah ketzad haya over mimmakom lemakom vechikkarot shel teruma veyado amar lo nachri ten li achat mehen vaatammeah veim lav hare ani metamme et kullah rabbi eliezer omer yetamme et kullah veal yitten lo achat mehen vitamme rabbi yehoshua omer yanniach lefanav achat mehen al hassala
Terumot 8:12: Vechen nashim sheamru lahem nachrim tenu achat mikkem untamme veim lav hare anu metammeim et kullechem yetammeu et kullan veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael
Terumot 9:1: Hazzorea teruma shogeg yofach umezid yekayyem im hevia shelish ben shogeg ben mezid yekayyem uvfishtan mezid yofach
Terumot 9:2: Vechayyevet beleket uvshichcha uvfea vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye chohanim melakketim vaaniyye yisrael mochrin et shellahem lakkohanim bidme teruma vehaddamim shellahem rabbi tarfon omer lo yelakketu ella aniyye chohanim shemma yishkechu veyittenu letoch pihem amar lo rabbi akiva im ken lo yelakketu ella tehorim
Terumot 9:3: Vechayyevet bemaasrot uvmaasar ani vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye chohanim notlim vaaniyye yisrael mochrin et shellahem lechohanim bidme teruma vehaddamim shellahem hachovet meshubbach vehaddash ketzad yaase tole chefifot betzavvere vehema venoten letochan meoto hammin nimtza lo zomem et habbehema velo maachil et hatteruma
Terumot 9:4: Giddule teruma teruma veggiddule giddulin chullin aval hattevel umaaser rishon usfiche sheviit utrumat chutza laaretz vehamdumma vehabbikkurim giddulehen chullin giddule hekdesh umaaser sheni chullin ufode otam bizman zaram
Terumot 9:5: Mea ligna shel teruma veachat shel chullin kullan muttarin bedavar shezzaro chale aval bedavar sheen zaro chale afillu mea shel chullin veachat shel teruma kullan asurin
Terumot 9:6: Hattevel giddulav muttarin bedavar shezzaro chale aval bedavar sheen zaro chale giddule giddulin asurin ezehu davar sheen zaro chale kegon halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim rabbi yehuda omer hashshum kasseorim
Terumot 9:7: Hamnakkesh im hannachri bachasiyyot af al pi shepperotav tevel ochel mehem aray shetile teruma shenitmeu shetalan taharu milletamme vaasurin milleechol ad sheyyagom et haochel rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyagom veyishne
Terumot 10:1: Batzal shennetano vetoch adashim im shalem muttar veim chittecho benoten taam ushar kal hattavshil ben shalem ben mechuttach benoten taam rabbi yehuda mattir betzachana sheeno ella littol et hazzuhama
Terumot 10:2: Tappuach sherisseko untano letoch issa vechimmetzah hare zo asura seorim shennaflu letoch habbor shel mayim af al pi shehivishu memav muttarin
Terumot 10:3: Harode pat chamma untanah al pi chavit shel yen teruma rabbi meir oser verabbi yehuda mattir rabbi yose mattir beshel chittim veoser beshel seorim mippene shehasseorim shoavot
Terumot 10:4: Tannur shehissiko vechammon shel teruma veafa vo happat mutteret sheen taam kammon ella reach kammon
Terumot 10:5: Tiltan shennafla letoch habbor shel yayin bitruma bemaaser sheni im yesh bazzera kede litten taam aval lo vaetz bishviit uvchile hakkerem vehekdesh im yesh bazzera uvaetz kede litten taam
Terumot 10:6: Mi shehau lo chavile tiltan bechile hakkerem yiddaleku hau lo chavile tiltan shel tevel kotesh umchashshev kamma zera yesh bahem umafrish et hazzera veeno tzarich lehafrish et haetz im hifrish lo yomar echtosh veettol et haetz veetten et hazzera ella noten haetz im hazzara
Terumot 10:7: Zete chullin shekkevashan im zete teruma petzue chullin im petzue teruma petzue chullin im sheleme teruma o veme teruma asur aval sheleme chullin im petzue teruma muttar
Terumot 10:8: Dag tame shekkevasho im dag tahor kal garav shehu machazik satayim im yesh bo mishkal asara zuz bihuda shehen chamesh selaim baggalil dag tame tziro asur rabbi yehuda omer reviit besatayim verabbi yose omer echad mishshishsha asar bo
Terumot 10:9: Chagavim temeim shennichbeshu im chagavim tehorim lo faslu et tziram heid rabbi tzadok al tzir chagavim temeim shehu tahor
Terumot 10:10: Kal hannichbashim ze im ze muttarim ella im hachasit chasit shel chullin im chasit shel teruma yarak shel chullin im chasit shel teruma asur aval chasit shel chullin im yarak shel teruma muttar
Terumot 10:11: Rabbi yose omer kal hannishlakim im hatteradim asurim mippene shehem notnin et hattaam rabbi shimon omer keruv shel shikya im keruv shel baal asur mippene shehu volea rabbi yehuda omer kal hammitbashshelin ze im ze muttarim ella im habbasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret mippene shehi foletet veenah bolaat
Terumot 10:12: Betza shennitbashshela bitvalin asurin afillu chelmon shellah asur mippene shehu volea me shelakot ume chevashim shel teruma asurim lezarim
Terumot 11:1: En notnin devela ugrogarot letoch hammuryas mippene shehu meabbedan aval notnin et hayyayin lammuryas veen mefattemin et hashshemen aval osin et hayyayin yenumlin en mevashshelin yayin shel teruma mippene shehu mamito rabbi yehuda mattir mippene shehu mashbicho
Terumot 11:2: Devash temarim veyen tappuchim vechometz sitvaniyyot ushar kal me ferot shel teruma rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh verabbi yehoshua poter verabbi eliezer metamme mishshum mashke amar rabbi yehoshua lo manu chachamim shiva mashkim kemone fetamim ella amru shiva mashkin temeim ushar kal hammashkin tehorin
Terumot 11:3: En osin temarim devash velo tappuchim yayin velo sitvaniyyot chometz ushar kal happerot en meshannin otam mibberiyyatan bitruma uvmaaser sheni ella zetim vaanavim bilvad en sofgin arbaim mishshum arla ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim veen meviin bikkurim mashkin ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim veeno mittamme mishshum mashke ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim veen makrivin al gabbe hammizbeach ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim
Terumot 11:4: Uktze teenim ugrogarot vehakkelisim vehecharuvin shel teruma asurim lezarim
Terumot 11:5: Garine teruma bizman shehu mechannesan asurot veim hishlichan muttarot vechen atzmot hakkadashim bizman shehu mechannesan asurin veim hishlichan muttarin hammursan muttar subbin shel chadashot asurot veshel yeshanot muttarot venoheg batteruma kederech shehu noheg bachullin hamsallet kav o kabbayim lisa lo yeabbed et hashshear ella yannichennu bemakom hammutzna
Terumot 11:6: Megura sheppinna mimmenna chitte teruma en mechayevin oto lihot yoshev umlakket achat achat ella mechabbed kedarko venoten letochah chullin
Terumot 11:7: Vechen chavit shel shemen shennishpecha en mechayevin oto lihot yoshev umtappeach ella noheg bah kederech shehu noheg bechullin
Terumot 11:8: Hamare mikkad lechad venotef shalosh tippim noten letochah chullin hirkinah umitztzah hare zo teruma vechamma tehe vitrumat maaser shel demay veolichenna lakkohen echad mishshemona lashsheminit
Terumot 11:9: Karshine teruma maachilin otam labbehema velachayya velattarnegolim yisrael shessachar para mikkohen maachilah karshine teruma vechohen shessachar para miyyisrael af al pi shemmezonoteha alav lo yaachilenna charshine teruma yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen lo yaachilenna charshine teruma vechohen sheshsham para miyyisrael maachilah karshine teruma
Terumot 11:10: Madlikin shemen serefa bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot uvammevoot haafelin veal gabbe hacholin birshut kohen bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehi lemuda etzel aviha aviha madlik birshutah madlikin bevet hammishte aval lo vevet haevel divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose omer bevet haevel aval lo vevet hammishte rabbi meir oser kan vechan rabbi shimon mattir kan vechan
Maasrot 1:1: Kelal amru bammaasrot kal shehu ochel venishmar vegiddulav min haaretz chayyav bammaasrot veod kelal acher amru kal shettechillato ochel vesofo ochel af al pi shehu shomro lehosif ochel chayyav katan vegadol vechal sheen techillato ochel aval sofo ochel eno chayyav ad sheyyease ochel
Maasrot 1:2: Meematay happerot chayyavot bammaasrot hatteenim mishsheyyavchilu haanavim vehaovashim mishshehivishu haog vehattutim mishsheyyadimu vechal haadummim mishsheyyadimu harimmonim mishsheyyimmassu hattemarim mishsheyyattilu seor haafarsekim mishsheyyattilu gidim haegozim mishsheyyaasu megura rabbi yehuda omer haegozim vehashshekedim mishsheyyaasu kelippa
Maasrot 1:3: Hecharuvin mishsheyyinnakedu vechal hashshechorim mishsheyyinnakdu haagasim vehakkerustomelin vehapparishin vehauzradim mishsheyyikkarechu vechal hallevanim mishsheyyikkarechu hattiltan mishshettetzammeach hattevua vehazzetim mishsheyyachnisu shelish
Maasrot 1:4: Uvayyarak hakkishshuin vehaddeluim vehaavattichim vehammelaffonot hattappuchim vehaetrogin chayyavim gedolim uktannim rabbi shimon poter et haetrogim bekatnan hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim patur bammetukim hachayyav bammetukim patur bammarim
Maasrot 1:5: Ezehu garnan lammaasrot hakkishshuim vehaddeluim mishsheyefaksu veim eno mefakkes mishsheyyaamid arema avattiach mishsheyeshallek veim eno meshallek ad sheyyaase muktze yarak hanneegad mishsheyyogad im eno oged ad sheyemalle et hakkeli veim eno memalle et hakkeli ad sheyelakket kal tzarko kalkala ad sheyechappe veim eno mechappe ad sheyemalle et hakkeli veim eno memalle et hakkeli ad sheyelakket kal tzarko bamme devarim amurim bemolich lashshuk aval bemolich leveto ochel mehem aray ad shehu maggia leveto
Maasrot 1:6: Happered vehatztzimmukin vehecharuvin mishsheyyaamid arema habbetzalim mishsheyefakkel veim eno mefakkel mishsheyyaamid arema hattevua mishsheyemareach veim eno memareach ad sheyyaamid arema hakkitniyyot mishsheyyichbor veim eno chover ad sheyemareach af al pi shemmerach notel min hakkuttaim umin hatztzedadim umimma shebbetoch hatteven veochel
Maasrot 1:7: Hayyayin mishsheyekappe af al pi shekkippa kolet min haggat haelona umin hatztzinnor veshote hashshemen mishsheyyered lauka af al pi sheyyarad notel min heakal umibben hammamal umibben happatztzim venoten lachamitta velattamchuy aval lo yitten lakkedera velallefas keshehen rotchin rabbi yehuda omer lakkol hu noten chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir
Maasrot 1:8: Haiggul mishsheyyachalikennu machalikim bitenim uvaanavim shel tevel rabbi yehuda oser hammachalik baanavim lo huchshar rabbi yehuda omer huchshar haggerogarot mishsheyyadush umgura mishsheyeaggel haya dash bechavit umaggel bammegura nishbera hechavit veniftecha hammegura lo yochal mehem aray rabbi yose mattir
Maasrot 2:1: Haya over bashshuk veamar telu lachem teenim ochlin ufturin lefichach im hichnisu levattehem metakkenim vadday telu vehachnisu levattechem lo yochlu mehem aray lefichach im hichnisu levattehem enam metakkenim ella demay
Maasrot 2:2: Hau yoshvin bashshaar o vachanut veamar telu lachem teenim ochlin ufturin uvaal hashshaar uvaal hachanut chayyavin rabbi yehuda poter ad sheyyachazir et panav o ad sheyeshanne mekom yeshivato
Maasrot 2:3: Hammaale ferot min haggalil lihuda o ole lirushalayim ochel mehem ad shehu maggia lemakom shehu holech vechen bihuda rabbi meir omer ad shehu maggia limkom hashshevita veharochlin hammechazzerin baayarot ochlim ad shemmaggiim limkom hallina rabbi yehuda omer habbayit harishon hu veto
Maasrot 2:4: Perot shetteraman ad shello nigmera melachtan rabbi eliezer oser milleechol mehem aray vachachamim mattirin chutz mikkalkalat teenim kalkalat teenim shetteramah rabbi shimon mattir vachachamim osrin
Maasrot 2:5: Haomer lachavero helach issar ze veten li vo chamesh teenim lo yochal ad sheyeasser divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer ochel achat achat patur veim tzeraf chayyav amar rabbi yehuda maase veginnat veradim shehayeta virushalayim vehau teenim nimkarot mishshalosh umearba beissar velo hufrash mimmenna teruma umaaser meolam
Maasrot 2:6: Haomer lachavero helach issar ze beeser teenim sheavor li borer veochel beeshkol sheavor li megarger veochel berimmon sheavor li poret veochel baavattiach sheavor li sofet veochel aval im amar lo beesrim teenim elu bishne eshkolot elu bishne rimmonim elu bishne avattichim elu ochel kedarko ufatur mippene shekkana vimchubbar lakkarka
Maasrot 2:7: Hassocher et happoel liktzot immo bitenim amar lo al menat sheochal teenim ochel ufatur al menat sheochal ani uvne veti o sheyyochal beni bischari hu ochel ufatur uvno ochel vechayyav al menat sheochal bishat hakketzia ulachar hakketzia bishat hakketzia ochel ufatur ulachar hakketzia ochel vechayyav sheeno ochel min hattora ze hakkelal haochel min hattora patur vesheeno ochel min hattora chayyav
Maasrot 2:8: Haya ose vilvasim lo yochal bivnot sheva bivnot sheva lo yochal bilvasim aval monea hu et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel hammachalif im chavero ze leechol veze leechol ze liktzot veze liktzot ze leechol veze liktzot chayyav rabbi yehuda omer hammachalif leechol chayyav veliktzot patur
Maasrot 3:1: Hammaavir teenim bachatzero liktzot banav uvne veto ochlin ufturin happoalim sheimmo bizman sheen lahem alav mezonot ochlin ufturin aval im yesh lahem alav mezonot hare ellu lo yochelu
Maasrot 3:2: Hammotzi poalav lassade bizman sheen lahem alav mezonot ochlin ufturin veim yesh lahem alav mezonot ochlin achat achat min hatteena aval lo min hassal velo min hakkuppa velo min hammuktze
Maasrot 3:3: Hassocher et happoel laasot bezetim amar lo al menat leechol zetim ochel echad echad ufatur veim tzeraf chayyav lenakkesh bivtzalim amar lo al menat leechol yarak mekartem ale ale veochel veim tzeraf chayyav
Maasrot 3:4: Matza ketzitzot badderech afillu vetzad sede ketzitzot vechen teena shehi nota al derech umatza tachteha teenim muttarot mishshum gazel ufturot min hammaasrot uvzetim uvcharuvim chayyavim matza gerogarot im darsu rov bene adam chayyav veim lav patur matza filche devela chayyav sheyyadua shehen middavar gamur vehecharuvin ad shello chenasan lerosh haggag morid mehem livhema patur mippene shehu machazir et hammotar
Maasrot 3:5: Ezo hi chatzer shehi chayyevet bammaasrot rabbi yishmael omer chatzer hatztzorit shehakkelim nishmarim betochah rabbi akiva omer kal sheechad poteach veechad noel petura rabbi nechemya omer kal sheen adam bosh milleechol betochah chayyevet rabbi yose omer kal shennichnas lah veen omer ma atta mevakkesh petura rabbi yehuda omer shene chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo happenimit chayyevet vehachitzona petura
Maasrot 3:6: Haggaggot peturin af al pi shehem shel chatzer hachayyavet bet shaar achsadra umirpeset hare ellu kechatzer im chayyevet chayyavin veim petura peturim
Maasrot 3:7: Hatztzerifin vehabburganin vehaelkatiyyot peturin sukkat ginnosar af al pi sheyyesh bo rechayim vetarnegolim petura sukkat hayyotzrim happenimit chayyevet vehachitzona petura rabbi yose omer kal sheenah dirat hachamma vedirat haggeshamim petura sukkat hechag bechag rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Maasrot 3:8: Teena shehi omedet bechatzer ochel achat achat ufatur veim tzeraf chayyav rabbi shimon omer achat bimino veachat bismolo veachat befiv ala leroshah memalle cheko veochel
Maasrot 3:9: Gefen shehi netua vechatzer notel et kal haeshkol vechen berimmon vechen baavattiach divre rabbi tarfon rabbi akiva omer megarger baeshkolot uforet barimmon vesofet baavattiach kusbar shehi zerua vechatzer mekartem ale ale veochel veim tzeraf chayyav hassea vehaezov vehakkoranit shebbechatzer im hau nishmarim chayyavin
Maasrot 3:10: Teena shehi omedet bechatzer venota lagginna ochel kedarko ufatur omedet bagginna venota lechatzer ochel achat achat patur veim tzeraf chayyav omedet baaretz venota lechutza laaretz bechutza laaretz venota laaretz hakkol holech achar haikkar uvvatte are choma hakkol holech achar haikkar uvare miklat hakkol holech achar hannof uvirushalayim hakkol holech achar hannof
Maasrot 4:1: Hakkovesh hashsholek hammoleach chayyav hamchammen baadama patur hamtabbel bassade patur happotzea zetim sheyyetze mehem hasseraf patur hassochet zetim al besaro patur im sachat venatan letoch yado chayyav hamkappe letavshil patur likdera chayyav mippene shehu chevor katan
Maasrot 4:2: Tinokot shettamnu teenim leshabbat veshachchu leasseran lo yochlu lemotzae shabbat ad sheyeasseru kalkalat shabbat bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayevin rabbi yehuda omer af halloket et hakkalkala lishloach lachavero lo yochal ad sheyyitasser
Maasrot 4:3: Hannotel zetim min hammaatan tovel echad echad bemelach veochel im malach venatan lefanav chayyav rabbi eliezer omer min hammaatan hattahor chayyav umin hattame patur mippene shehu machazir et hammotar
Maasrot 4:4: Shotim al haggat ben al hachammin ben al hatztzonen patur divre rabbi meir rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok mechayyev vachachamim omrim al hachammin chayyav veal hatztzonen patur
Maasrot 4:5: Hamkallef seorim mekallef achat achat veochel veim killef venatan letoch yado chayyav hammolel melilot shel chittim menappe miyyad leyad veochel veim nippa venatan letoch cheko chayyav kusbar shezzeraah lezera yarkah patur zeraah leyarak mitasseret zera veyarak rabbi eliezer omer hashshevet mitasseret zera veyarak vezerin vachachamim omrim eno mitasser zera veyarak ella hashshachalayim vehaggargir bilvad
Maasrot 4:6: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer temarot shel tiltan veshel chardal veshel pol hallavan chayyavot bammaaser rabbi eliezer omer hatztzalaf mitasser temarot vaaviyyonot vekafras rabbi akiva omer en mitasser ella aviyyonot mippene shehen peri
Maasrot 5:1: Haoker shetalim mittoch shello venata letoch shello patur lakach bimchubbar lakkarka patur lakat lishloach lachavero patur rabbi elazar ben azarya omer im yesh kayyotze vahem nimkarim bashshuk hare ellu chayyavin
Maasrot 5:2: Haoker lefet utznonot mittoch shello venotea letoch shello lezera chayyav mippene shehu garnan betzalim mishshehishrishu vaaliyya taharu milletamme nafla alehem mappolet vehem megullim hare ellu kintuim bassade
Maasrot 5:3: Lo yimkor adam et perotav mishebbau leonat hammaasrot lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot velo vashsheviit lemi shehu chashud al hashsheviit veim bikkeru notel et habbakkurot umocher et hashshear
Maasrot 5:4: Lo yimkor adam et tivno veet gifto veet zaggav lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot lehotzi mehen mashkin veim hotzi chayyav bammaasrot ufatur min hatteruma shehattorem belibbo al hakketuim al hatztzedadim veal ma shebbetoch hatteven
Maasrot 5:5: Hallokeach sede yarak besurya im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot chayyav umishshebba leonat hammaasrot patur veloket kedarko veholech rabbi yehuda omer af yiskor poalim vilakket amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim bizman shekkana karka aval bizman shello kana karka im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot patur rabbi omer af lefi cheshbon
Maasrot 5:6: Hamtammed venatan mayim bammidda umatza chede middato patur rabbi yehuda mechayyev matza yoter al kede middato motzi alav mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon
Maasrot 5:7: Chore hannemalim shellanu vetzad haarema hachayyevet hare ellu chayyavim sheyyadua shemmiddavar haggamur hau gorrin kal hallayela
Maasrot 5:8: Shum baal bechi uvatzal shel richpa ugrisin hakkilkin vehaadashim hammitzriyyot rabbi meir omer af hakkarkas rabbi yose omer af hakkutnim peturim min hammaasrot venilkachin mikkal adam bashsheviit zera luf haelon zera kereshim zera betzalim zera lefet utznonot ushar zerone ginna sheenan neechalim peturim min hammaasrot venilkachin mikkal adam bashsheviit sheaf al pi sheavihen teruma hare ellu yeachelu
Maaser Sheni 1:1: Maaser sheni en mochrin oto veen memashkenin oto veen machalifin oto velo shoklin kennegdo velo yomar adam lachavero birushalayim helach yayin veten li shamen vechen shear kal happerot aval notnin ze laze mattenat chinnam
Maaser Sheni 1:2: Masar behema en mochrin oto tamim chay velo vaal mum chay veshachut veen mekaddeshin bo haishsha habbechor mochrin oto tamim chay uvaal mum chay veshachut umkaddeshin bo haishsha en mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon velo al hammatbea sheeno yotze velo al hammaot sheenan birshuto
Maaser Sheni 1:3: Hallokeach behema lezivche shelamim o chayya livsar taava yatza haor lechullin af al pi shehaor merubbe al habbasar kadde yayin setumot mekom sheddarkan limkor setumot yatza kankan lechullin haegozim vehashshekedim yatzu kelippehem lechullin hattemed ad shello hechmitz eno nilkach bechesef maaser umishshehechmitz nilkach bechesef maaser
Maaser Sheni 1:4: Hallokeach chayya lezivche shelamim behema livsar taava lo yatza haor lechullin kadde yayin petuchot o setumot mekom sheddarkan limmacher petuchot lo yatza kankan lechullin salle zetim vesalle anavim im hakkeli lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin
Maaser Sheni 1:5: Hallokeach mayim umelach uferot hamchubbarim lakkarka o ferot sheenan yecholin lehaggia lirushalayim lo kana maaser hallokeach perot shogeg yachzeru damim limkoman mezid yaolu veyeachlu vammakom veim en mikdash yerakkevu
Maaser Sheni 1:6: Hallokeach behema shogeg yachzeru dameha limkoman mezid taole veteachel bammakom veim en mikdash tikkaver al yede orah
Maaser Sheni 1:7: En lokchin avadim ushfachot vekarkaot uvhema temea middeme maaser sheni veim lakach yochal kenegdan en meviin kinne zavim vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot chattaot vaashamot middeme maaser sheni veim hevi yochal kenegdam ze hakkelal kal shehu chutz laachila velishtiyya ulsicha middeme maaser sheni yochal kenegdo
Maaser Sheni 2:1: Maaser sheni nittan laachila velishtiyya ulsicha leechol davar sheddarko leechol lasuch davar sheddarko lasuch lo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen en mefattemin shemen shel maaser sheni veen lokchin bidme maaser sheni shemen mefuttam aval mefattem hu et hayyayin nafal letocho devash utvalin vehishbicho hashshevach lefi cheshbon dagim shennitbashshelu im hakkaflotot shel maaser sheni vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon issa shel maaser sheni sheafaah vehishbiach hashshevach lashsheni ze hakkelal kal sheshshivcho nikkar hashshevach lefi hacheshbon vechal sheen shivcho nikkar hashshevach lashsheni
Maaser Sheni 2:2: Rabbi shimon omer en sachin shemen shel maaser sheni birushalayim vachachamim mattirin amru lo lerabbi shimon im hekel bitruma chamura lo nakel bemaaser sheni hakkal amar lahem ma lo im hekel bitruma hachamura mekom shehekel becharshinim uvtiltan nakel bemaaser sheni hakkal mekom shello hekel becharshinim uvtiltan
Maaser Sheni 2:3: Tiltan shel maaser sheni teachel tzimchonim veshel teruma bet shammay omrim kal maaseha betahora chutz mechafifatah uvet hillel omrim kal maaseha vetuma chutz mishsheriyyatah
Maaser Sheni 2:4: Karshine maaser sheni yeachlu tzimchonim venichnasin lirushalayim veotzin nitmeu rabbi tarfon omer yitchalleku leissot vachachamim omrim yippadu veshel teruma bet shammay omrim shorin veshafin betahora umaachilin betuma uvet hillel omrim shorin betahora veshafin umaachilin betuma shammay omer yeachlu tzarid rabbi akiva omer kal maasehen betuma
Maaser Sheni 2:5: Meot chullin umot maaser sheni shennitpazzeru ma shellikket likket lemaaser sheni ad sheyyashlim vehashshear chullin im balal vechafan lefi cheshbon ze hakkelal hammitlakketim lemaaser sheni vehannivlalim lefi cheshbon
Maaser Sheni 2:6: Sela shel maaser sheni veshel chullin shennitarvu mevi vesela maot veomer sela shel maaser sheni bechal makom shehi mechullelet al hammaot haellu uvorer et hayyafa shebbah umchallelan aleha mippene sheamru mechallelin kesef al nechoshet middochak velo sheyyitkayyem ken ella chozer umchallelam al hakkasef
Maaser Sheni 2:7: Bet shammay omrim lo yaase adam et selaav dinre zahav uvet hillel mattirin amar rabbi akiva ani asiti lerabban gamliel ulrabbi yehoshua et kaspan dinre zahav
Maaser Sheni 2:8: Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni bet shammay omrim kal hassela maot uvet hillel omrim shekel kesef veshekel maot rabbi meir omer en mechallelin kesef uferot al hakkesef vachachamim mattirim
Maaser Sheni 2:9: Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim bet shammay omrim kal hassela maot uvet hillel omrim shekel kesef veshekel maot haddanin lifne chachamim omrim bishlosha dinare kesef vedinar maot rabbi akiva omer shelosha dinarin kesef urviit maot rabbi tarfon omer arbaa aspere chesef shammay omer yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah
Maaser Sheni 2:10: Mi shehau miktzat banav temein umiktzatan tehorim manniach et hassela veomer ma shehattehorim shotim sela zo mechullelet alav nimtzeu tehorim utmeim shotin mikkad echad
Maaser Sheni 3:1: Lo yomar adam lachavero haal et happerot haellu lirushalayim lechallek ella omer lo haalem shennochlem venishtem birushalayim aval notnim ze laze mattenat chinnam
Maaser Sheni 3:2: En lokchin teruma bechesef maaser sheni mippene shehu memaet baachilato verabbi shimon mattir amar lahem rabbi shimon ma im hekel bezivche shelamim shehu mevian lide figgul venotar vetame lo nakel batteruma amru lo ma im hekel bezivche shelamim shehen muttarim lezarim nakel batteruma shehi asura lezarim
Maaser Sheni 3:3: Mi shehau lo maot birushalayim vetzarich lo velachavero ferot omer lachavero hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perotecha nimtza ze ochel perotav betahora vehalla ose tzarko bimotav velo yomar ken leam haaretz ella vidmay
Maaser Sheni 3:4: Perot birushalayim umaot bammedina omer hare hammaot hahem mechullalin al perot haellu maot birushalayim uferot bammedina omer hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perot hahem uvilvad sheyyaolu happerot veyeachlu virushalayim
Maaser Sheni 3:5: Maot nichnasot lirushalayim veotzot uferot nichnasin veenan yotzin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af happerot nichnasin veotzin
Maaser Sheni 3:6: Perot shennigmera melachtan veavru vetoch yerushalayim yachazor maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel birushalayim veshello nigmera melachtan salle anavim laggat vesalle teenim lammuktze bet shammay omrim yachazor maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim uvet hillel omrim yippade veyeachel bechal makom rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose lo nechleku vet shammay uvet hillel al perot shello nigmera melachtan sheyyippade maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel bechal makom veal ma nechleku al perot shennigmera melachtan shebbet shammay omrim yachazor maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim uvet hillel omrim yippade veyeachel bechal makom vehaddemay nichnas veotze venifde
Maaser Sheni 3:7: Ilan shehu omed bifnim venote lachutz o omed bachutz venote lifnim mikkeneged hachoma velifnim kelifnim mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz batte habbaddim sheppitchehen lifnim vachalalan lachutz o sheppitchehen lachutz vachalalan lifnim bet shammay omrim hakkol kelifnim uvet hillel omrim mikkeneged hachoma velifnim kelifnim mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz
Maaser Sheni 3:8: Halleshachot benuot bakkodesh uftuchot lachol tochan chol vegaggotehen kodesh benuot bachol uftuchot lakkodesh tochan kodesh vegaggotehen chol benuot bakkodesh uvachol uftuchot lakkodesh velachol tochan vegaggotehen mikkeneged hakkodesh velakkodesh kodesh mikkeneged hachol velachol chol
Maaser Sheni 3:9: Maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim venitma ben shennitma veav hattuma ben shennitma bivelad hattuma ben bifnim ben bachutz bet shammay omrim yippade veyeachel hakkol bifnim chutz mishshennitma beav hattuma bachutz uvet hillel omrim hakkol yippade veyeachel bachutz chutz mishshennitma bivelad hattuma bifnim
Maaser Sheni 3:10: Hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma yippade rabbi yehuda omer yikkaver amru lo lerabbi yehuda uma im maaser sheni atzmo shennitma hare hu nifde hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma eno din sheyyippade amar lahem lo im amartem bemaaser sheni atzmo shekken hu nifde vetahor berichuk makom tomru velakuach bechesef maaser sheeno nifde vetahor berichuk makom
Maaser Sheni 3:11: Tzevi shellekacho bechesef maaser vamet yikkaver al yede oro rabbi shimon omer yippade lekacho chay ushchato venitma yippade rabbi yose omer yikkaver lekacho shachut venitma hare hu cheferot
Maaser Sheni 3:12: Hammashil kankannin lemaaser sheni af al pi sheggafan lo kana maaser zalaf letochan setam ad shello gafan lo kana maaser mishsheggafan kana maaser ad shello gafan olot beechad umea umishsheggafan mekaddeshot bechal shehen ad shello gafan torem meachat al hakkol umishsheggafan torem mikkal achat veechat
Maaser Sheni 3:13: Bet shammay omrim mefatteach umare laggat uvet hillel omrim mefatteach veeno tzarich learot bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheddarkan limkor setumot aval bemakom sheddarkan limkor petuchot lo yatza kankan lechullin aval im ratza lehachmir al atzmo limkor bemidda yatza kankan lechullin rabbi shimon omer af haomer lachavero chavit zo ani mocher lecha chutz mikkankannim yatza kankan lechullin
Maaser Sheni 4:1: Hammolich perot maaser sheni mimmekom hayyoker limkom hazzol o mimmekom hazzol limkom hayyoker podehu cheshaar mekomo hammevi ferot min haggoren lair vechadde yayin min haggat lair hashshevach lashsheni vitziot mibbeto
Maaser Sheni 4:2: Podin maaser sheni beshaar hazzol kemot shehachenvani lokeach lo chemot shehu mocher kemot shehashshulchani foret velo chemot shehu metzaref veen podin maaser sheni achsara et sheddamav yeduim yippade al pi ed echad veet sheen damav yeduim yippade al pi shelosha kegon hayyayin shekkaram uferot shehirkivu umaot shehecheliu
Maaser Sheni 4:3: Baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela baal habbayit kodem mippene shehu mosif chomesh baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela veissar et shel sela veissar kodem mippene shehu mosif al hakkeren happode maaser sheni shello mosif alav chamishshit ben shehu shello uven shennittan lo bemattana
Maaser Sheni 4:4: Maarimin al maaser sheni ketzad omer adam livno ulvitto haggedolim leavdo ulshifchato haivrim helach maot ellu ufde lach maaser sheni ze aval lo yomar ken livno ulvitto hakketannim leavdo ulshifchato hakkenaanim mippene sheyyadan keyado
Maaser Sheni 4:5: Haya omed baggoren veen beyado maot omer lachavero hare happerot haellu netunim lach bemattana chozer veomer hare ellu mechullalin al maot shebbabbayit
Maaser Sheni 4:6: Mashach mimmennu maaser besela velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bishtayim noten lo sela umistakker besela umaaser sheni shello mashach mimmennu maaser bishtayim velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad besela noten lo sela mechullin vesela shel maaser sheni shello im haya am haaretz noten lo middemay
Maaser Sheni 4:7: Happode maaser sheni velo kara shem rabbi yose omer dayyo rabbi yehuda omer tzarich lefaresh haya medabber im haishsha al iske gittah vekiddusheha venatan lah gittah vekiddusheha velo feresh rabbi yose omer dayyo rabbi yehuda omer tzarich lefaresh
Maaser Sheni 4:8: Hammanniach issar veachal alav chetzo vehalach lemakom acher vahare hu yotze befundeon ochel alav od issar hammanniach pundeon veachal alav chetzo vehalach lemakom acher vahare hu yotze beissar ochel alav od pelag hammanniach issar shel maaser sheni ochel alav achad asar beissar veechad mimmea beissar bet shammay omrim hakkol asara uvet hillel omrim bavadday achad asar uvaddemay asara
Maaser Sheni 4:9: Kal hammaot hannimtzaim hare ellu chullin afillu dinar zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot matza vetochan cheres vechatuv alav maaser hare ze maaser
Maaser Sheni 4:10: Hammotze cheli vechatuv alav karban rabbi yehuda omer im haya shel cheres hu chullin uma shebbetocho karban veim haya shel mattechet hu karban uma shebbetocho chullin amru lo en derech bene adam lihot konsin chullin lekarban
Maaser Sheni 4:11: Hammotze cheli vechatuv alav kuf karban m maaser d demay t tevel t teruma shebbishat sakkana hau chotvin t tachat teruma rabbi yose omer kullam shemot bene adam hem amar rabbi yose afillu matza chavit vehi melea ferot vechatuv aleha teruma hare ellu chullin sheani omer eshtakad hayeta melea ferot teruma ufinnah
Maaser Sheni 4:12: Haomer livno maaser sheni bezavit zo umatza vezavit acheret hare ellu chullin haya sham mane umatza matayim hashshear chullin matayim umatza mane hakkol maaser
Maaser Sheni 5:1: Kerem revai metzayenin oto bekozzot adama veshel arla becharsit veshel kevarot besid ummache veshofech amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim bashsheviit vehatztzenuim mannichin et hammaot veomrim kal hannilkat mizze yehe mechullal al hammaot haellu
Maaser Sheni 5:2: Kerem revai haya ole lirushalayim mahalach yom echad lechal tzad veezo hi techumah elat min haddarom veakrabbat min hatztzafon lod min hammaarav vehayyarden min hammizrach umishsherabbu happerot hitkinu sheyehe nifde samuch lachoma utnay haya haddavar sheematay sheyyirtzu yachazor haddavar lichmot shehaya rabbi yose omer mishshecharav bet hammikdash haya hattenay hazze utnay haya ematay sheyyibbane bet hammikdash yachazor haddavar lichmot shehaya
Maaser Sheni 5:3: Kerem revai bet shammay omrim en lo chomesh veen lo viur uvet hillel omrim yesh lo bet shammay omrim yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot vehaaniyyim podin leatzman uvet hillel omrim kullo laggat
Maaser Sheni 5:4: Ketzad podin neta revai manniach et hassal al pi shelosha veomer kamma adam rotze lifdot lo vesela al menat lehotzi yetziot mibbeto umanniach et hammaot veomer kal hannilkat mizze mechullal al hammaot haellu bechach vechach sallim besala
Maaser Sheni 5:5: Uvashsheviit podehu veshaveo veim haya hakkol mufkar en lo ella sechar lekita happode neta revai shello mosif alav chamishshito ben shehu shello uven shennittan lo bemattana
Maaser Sheni 5:6: Erev yom tov harishon shel pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit haya viur ketzad haya viur notnin teruma utrumat maaser labbealim umaaser rishon livalav umaasar ani livalav umaaser sheni vehabbikkurim mitbaarim bechal makom rabbi shimon omer habbikkurim nittanin lakkohanim katteruma hattavshil bet shammay omrim tzarich levaer uvet hillel omrim hare hu kimvoar
Maaser Sheni 5:7: Mi shehau lo ferot bazzeman hazze vehiggia sheat habbiur bet shammay omrim tzarich lechallelan al hakkesef uvet hillel omrim echad shehen kesef veechad shehen perot
Maaser Sheni 5:8: Amar rabbi yehuda barishona hau sholchin etzel baale vattim shebbammedinot maharu vehatkinu et perotechem ad shello taggia sheat habbiur ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed shekkal happerot shello vau leonat hammaasrot peturim min habbiur
Maaser Sheni 5:9: Mi shehau ferotav rechokim mimmennu tzarich likro lahem shem maase verabban gamliel vehazzekenim shehau vain bisfina amar rabban gamliel issur sheani atid lamod natun lihoshua umkomo muskar lo issur acher sheani atid lamod natun laakiva ven yosef sheyyizke vo laaniyyim umkomo muskar lo amar rabbi yehoshua issur sheani atid lamod natun leelazar ben azarya umkomo muskar lo venitkabbelu ze mizze sachar
Maaser Sheni 5:10: Bammincha veom tov haacharon hau mitvaddin ketzad haya havidduy biarti hakkodesh min habbayit dvrm chv ze maaser sheni veneta revai netattiv lallevi ze masar levi vegam netattiv zo teruma utrumat maaser lagger layyatom velaalmana ze maasar ani halleket vehashshichcha vehappea af al pi sheenan meakkevin et havidduy min habbayit zo challa
Maaser Sheni 5:11: Kechal mitzvatcha asher tzivitani shm ha im hikdim maaser sheni larishon eno yachol lehitvaddot lo avarti mimmitzotecha lo hifrashti mimmin al sheeno mino velo min hattalush al hamchubbar velo min hamchubbar al hattalush velo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash velo shachachti lo shachachti millevarechcha umillehazkir shimcha alav
Maaser Sheni 5:12: Lo achalti veoni mimmennu shm ha im achalo vaanina eno yachol lehitvaddot velo viarti mimmennu betame ha im hifrisho vetuma eno yachol lehitvaddot velo natatti mimmennu lemet lo lakachti mimmennu aron vetachrichim lemet velo netattiv leonnim acherim shamati vekol elohay havetiv levet habbechira asiti kechol asher tzivitani samachti vesimmachti vo
Maaser Sheni 5:13: Hashkifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim dvrm chv tv asinu ma sheggazarta alenu af atta ase ma shehivtachtanu hashkifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim uvarech et ammecha et yisrael bevanim uvvanot veet haadama asher natatta lanu betal uvmatar uvvaldot behema kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udvash kede shettitten taam bapperot
Maaser Sheni 5:14: Mikkan amru yisrael umamzerim mitvaddim aval lo gerim velo avadim meshuchrarim sheen lahem chelek baaretz rabbi meir omer af lo chohanim ulviyyim shello natlu chelek baaretz rabbi yose omer yesh lahem are migrash
Maaser Sheni 5:15: Yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodaot hammaaser af hu bittel et hamorrim veet hannokfim vead yamav haya fattish makke virushalayim uvyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay
Challah 1:1: Chamishsha devarim chayyavim bachalla hachittim vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshifon hare ellu chayyavin bachalla umitztarfin ze im ze vaasurin bechadash millifne happesach umilliktzor millifne haomer veim hishrishu kodem laomer haomer mattiran veim lav asurin ad sheyyavo haomer habba
