Challah 1:2: Haochel mehem kazzayit matztza befesach yatza yede chovato kazzayit chametz chayyav behikkaret nitarev echad mehem bechal hamminim hare ze over befesach hannoder min happat umin hattevua asur bahem divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim hannoder min haddagan eno asur ella mehen vechayyavin bachalla uvammaasrot
Challah 1:3: Ellu chayyavin bachalla ufturim min hammaasrot halleket vehashshichcha vehappea vehahefker umaaser rishon shennittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu umotar haomer utvua shello hevia shelish rabbi eliezer omer tevua shello hevia shelish petura min hachalla
Challah 1:4: Ellu chayyavin bammaasrot ufturim min hachalla haorez vehaddochan vehapperagim vehashshumshemin vehakkitniyyot ufachot mechameshet revaim battevua hassufganin vehadduvshanin vehaiskeritin vechallat hammasret vehamdumma peturin min hachalla
Challah 1:5: Issa shettechillatah sufganin vesofah sufganin petura min hachalla techillatah issa vesofah sufganin techillatah sufganin vesofah issa chayyavin bachalla vechen hakkenuvkaot chayyavot
Challah 1:6: Hammeissa bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayevin hachalita bet shammay mechayevin uvet hillel potrin challot toda urkike nazir asaan leatzmo patur limkor bashshuk chayyav
Challah 1:7: Nachtom sheasa seor lechallek chayyav bachalla nashim shennatnu lenachtom laasot lahen seor im en beshel achat mehen kashshiur petura min hachalla
Challah 1:8: Issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna chayyevet bachalla umarvin bah umishtattefin bah umvarchin aleha umzammenin aleha venaaset beom tov veotze vah adam yede chovato befesach im en haroim ochlin mimmenna enah chayyevet bachalla veen mearvin bah veen mishtattefin bah veen mevarchin aleha veen mezammenin aleha veenah naaset beom tov veen adam yotze vah yede chovato befesach ben kach uven kach mittammea tumat ochalin
Challah 1:9: Hachalla vehatteruma chayyavin aleha mita vechomesh vaasurim lezarim vehem nichse chohen veolin beechad umea utunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh veen nittalin min hattahor al hattame ella min hammukkaf umin haddavar haggamur haomer kal garni teruma vechal issati challa lo amar kelum ad sheyeshayyer miktzat
Challah 2:1: Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz chayyavim bachalla yatzu mikkan lesham rabbi eliezer mechayyev verabbi akiva poter
Challah 2:2: Afar chutza laaretz shebba visfina laaretz chayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehassefina gosheshet issa shennillosha veme ferot chayyevet bachalla veneechelet beyadayim mesoavot
Challah 2:3: Haishsha yoshevet vekotza challatah arumma mippene shehi yechola lechassot atzmah aval lo haish mi sheeno yachol laasot issato vetahora yaasenna kabbin veal yaasenna vetuma verabbi akiva omer yaasenna vetuma veal yaasenna kabbim shekkeshem shehu kore lattehora kach hu kore lattemea lezo kore challa vashshem ulzo kore challa vashshem aval kabbim en lahem chelek bashshem
Challah 2:4: Haose issato kabbim venagu ze vaze peturim min hachalla ad sheyyishshochu rabbi eliezer omer af harode venoten lassal hassal metzarfan lachalla
Challah 2:5: Hammafrish challato kemach enah challa vegazel beyad kohen haissa atzmah chayyevet bachalla vehakkemach im yesh bo chashshiur chayyevet bachalla vaasura lezarim divre rabbi yehoshua amru lo maase ukfashah zaken zar amar lahem af hu kilkel leatzmo vetikken laacherim
Challah 2:6: Chameshet revaim kemach chayyavim bachalla hem usoran vesubban umursanan chameshet revaim chayyavin nittal mursanan mittochan vechazar letochan hare ellu feturin
Challah 2:7: Shiur hachalla echad meesrim vearbaa haose issa leatzmo vehaose lemishte veno echad meesrim vearbaa nachtom shehu ose limkor bashshuk vechen haishsha shehi osa limkor bashshuk echad mearbaim ushmona nitmet issatah shogeget o anusa echad mearbaim ushmona nitmet mezida echad meesrim vearbaa kede shello yehe chote niskar
Challah 2:8: Rabbi eliezer omer nittelet min hattahor al hattame ketzad issa tehora veissa temea notel kede challa meissa shello huram challatah venoten pachot mikkabbetza baemtza kede sheyyittol min hammukkaf vachachamim osrin
Challah 3:1: Ochlin aray min haissa ad shettitgalgel bachittim vetittamtem basseorim gilgelah bachittim vetimtemah basseorim haochel mimmenna chayyav mita kevan shehi notenet et hammayim magbahat challatah uvilvad shello yehe sham chamishsha rive kemach
Challah 3:2: Nidmea issatah ad shello gilgela petura shehammedumma patur umishsheggilgela chayyevet nolad lah sefek tuma ad shello gilgela tease vetuma umishsheggilgela tease vetahora
Challah 3:3: Hikdisha issatah ad shello gilgela ufdaattah chayyevet mishsheggilgela ufdaatta chayyevet hikdishattah ad shello gilgela vegilgelah haggizbar veachar kach pedaattah petura shebbishat chovatah hayeta fetura
Challah 3:4: Kayyotze vo hammakdish perotav ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot ufdaan chayyavin umishshebbau leonat hammaasrot ufdaan chayyavin hikdishan ad shello nigmeru ugmaran haggizbar veachar kach pedaan peturin shebbishat chovatan hau feturin
Challah 3:5: Nachri shennatan leyisrael laasot lo issa petura min hachalla netanah lo mattana ad shello gilgel chayyav umishsheggilgel patur haose issa im hannachri im en beshel yisrael keshiur challa petura min hachalla
Challah 3:6: Ger shennitgayyer vehayeta lo issa naaset ad shello nitgayyer patur umishshennitgayyer chayyav veim safek chayyav veen chayyavin aleha chomesh rabbi akiva omer hakkol holech achar hakkerima vattannur
Challah 3:7: Haose issa min hachittim umin haorez im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bachalla veotze vah adam yede chovato befesach veim en bah taam dagan enah chayyevet bachalla veen adam yotze vah yede chovato befesach
Challah 3:8: Hannotel seor meissa shello hurma challatah venoten letoch issa shehurma challatah im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher motzi lefi cheshbon veim lav motzi challa achat al hakkol
Challah 3:9: Kayyotze vo zete masik shennitarvu im zete nikkuf inneve vatzir im inneve ollot im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher motzi lefi cheshbon veim lav motzi teruma utrumat maaser lakkol vehashshear maaser umaaser sheni lefi cheshbon
Challah 3:10: Hannotel seor meissat chittim venoten letoch issat orez im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bachalla veim lav petura im ken lamma amru hattevel oser kal shehu min bemino veshello vemino benoten taam
Challah 4:1: Shette nashim sheasu shene kabbin venagu ze vaze afillu hem mimmin echad peturim uvizman shehem shel ishsha achat min bemino chayyav veshello vemino patur
Challah 4:2: Eze hu min bemino hachittim enan mitztarfot im hakkol ella im hakkussemin hasseorim mitztarfot im hakkol chutz min hachittim rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer shear hamminim mitztarfin ze im ze
Challah 4:3: Shene kabbim vekav orez o kav teruma baemtza enan mitztarfin davar shennittela challato baemtza mitztarfin shekkevar nitchayyev bachalla
Challah 4:4: Kav chadash vekav yashan shennashchu ze vaze rabbi yishmael omer yittol min haemtza vachachamim osrim hannotel challa min hakkav rabbi akiva omer challa vachachamim omrim enah challa
Challah 4:5: Shene kabbin shennittela challato shel ze bifne atzmo veshel ze bifne atzmo chazar vaasao issa achat rabbi akiva foter vachachamim mechayevin nimtza chumro kullo
Challah 4:6: Notel adam kede challa meissa shello hurma challatah laasota betahora lihot mafrish aleha veholech challat demay ad shettissareach shechallat demay nittelet min hattahor al hattame veshello min hammukkaf
Challah 4:7: Yisrael shehau arisin lenachrim besurya rabbi eliezer mechayyev perotehem bammaasrot uvashsheviit verabban gamliel poter rabban gamliel omer shette challot besurya verabbi eliezer omer challa echat achazu kullo shel rabban gamliel vekullo shel rabbi eliezer chazru linhog kedivre rabban gamliel bishte derachim
Challah 4:8: Rabban gamliel omer shalosh aratzot lachalla meeretz yisrael vead keziv challa echat mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amana shette challot achat laur veachat lakkohen shel ur yesh lah shiur veshel kohen en lah shiur min hannahar vead amana velifnim shette challot achat laur veachat lakkohen shel ur en lah shiur veshel kohen yesh lah shiur utvul yom ochlah rabbi yose omer eno tzarich tevila vaasura lazzavim velazzavot lannidda velayyoldot veneechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan venittenet lechal kohen
Challah 4:9: Veellu nittanin lechal kohen hacharamim vehabbechorot ufidon habben ufidon peter chamor vehazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva vereshit haggez veshemen serefa vekadshe hammikdash vehabbikkurim rabbi yehuda oser babbikkurim karshine teruma rabbi akiva mattir vachachamim osrim
Challah 4:10: Nittay ish tekoa hevi challot mibbetar velo kibbelu mimmennu anshe alekkesanderiyya heviu challotehen mealekkesanderiyya velo kibbelu mehem anshe har tzevoim heviu vikkurehem kodem atzeret velo kibbelu mehem mippene hakkatuv shebbattora shmt chg vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade
Challah 4:11: Ben antinos heela vechorot mibbavel velo kibbelu mimmennu yosef hakkohen hevi vikkure yayin veshemen velo kibbelu mimmennu af hu heela et banav uvne veto laasot pesach katan birushalayim vehecheziruhu shello yikkava haddavar chova ariston hevi vikkurav meappamya vekibbelu mimmennu mippene sheamru hakkone vesurya kekone befarvar shebbirushalayim
Orlah 1:1: Hannotea lisyag ulkorot patur min haarla rabbi yose omer afillu amar happenimi lemaachal vehachitzon lisyag happenimi chayyav vehachitzon patur
Orlah 1:2: Et shebbau avotenu laaretz matzu natua patur natu af al pi shello chibbeshu chayyav hannotea larabbim chayyav rabbi yehuda poter hannotea birshut harabbim vehannachri shennata vehaggazlan shennata vehannotea bisfina vehaole meelav chayyav baarla
Orlah 1:3: Ilan shenneekar vehassela immo shetafo nahar vehassela immo im yachol lichot patur veim lav chayyav neekar hassela mitztziddo o shezzizeattu hammacharesha o shezzizeo vaasao cheafar im yachol lichot patur veim lav chayyav
Orlah 1:4: Ilan shenneekar venishtayyer bo shoresh patur vechamma yehe hashshoresh rabban gamliel omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota kemachat shel mittun
Orlah 1:5: Ilan shenneekar uvo verecha vehu chayye mimmenna chazra hazzekena lihot kabberecha hivrichah shana achar shana venifseka mone mishshaa shennifseka sippuk haggefanim vesippuk al gabbe sippuk af al pi shehivrichan baaretz muttar rabbi meir omer makom shekkochah yafe muttar vemakom shekkochah ra asur vechen berecha shennifseka vehi melea ferot im hosif bematayim asur
Orlah 1:6: Netia shel arla veshel kile hakkerem shennitarvu vintiot hare ze lo yilkot veim lakat yaale veechad umatayim uvilvad shello yitkaven lilkot rabbi yose omer af yitkaven lilkot veyaale veechad umatayim
Orlah 1:7: Healim vehallulavim ume gefanim usmadar muttarim baarla uvarvai uvannazir vaasurim baashera rabbi yose omer hassemadar asur mippene shehu peri rabbi eliezer omer hammaamid bisraf haarla asur amar rabbi yehoshua shamati beferush shehammaamid bisraf healim uvisraf haikkarim muttar bisraf happaggim asur mippene shehem peri
Orlah 1:8: Ankoklot vehachartzannim vehazzaggim vehattemed shellahem kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello kelippe egozim vehaggarinim asurim baarla uvaashera uvannazir umuttarin barvai vehannovlot kullan asurot
Orlah 1:9: Rabbi yose omer notin yichur shel arla veen notin egoz shel arla mippene shehu peri veen markivin bechafniyyot shel arla
Orlah 2:1: Hatteruma utrumat maaser shel demay hachalla vehabbikkurim olim beechad umea umitztarfin ze im ze vetzarich leharim haarla vechile hakkerem olim beechad umatayim umitztarfin ze im ze veen tzarich leharim rabbi shimon omer enan mitztarfin rabbi eliezer omer mitztarfin benoten taam aval lo leesor
Orlah 2:2: Hatteruma maala et haarla vehaarla et hatteruma ketzad sea teruma shennafla lemea veachar kach naflu shelosha kabbin arla o shelosha kabbin kile hakkerem zo hi shehatteruma maala et haarla vehaarla et hatteruma
Orlah 2:3: Haarla maala et hakkilayim vehakkilayim et haarla vehaarla et haarla ketzad sea arla shennafla lematayim veachar kach nafla sea veod arla o sea veod shel kile hakkerem zo hi shehaarla maala et hakkilayim vehakkilayim et haarla vehaarla et haarla
Orlah 2:4: Kal hamchammetz vehamtabbel vehamdammea batteruma uvaarla uvchile hakkerem asur uvet shammay omrim af metamme uvet hillel omrim leolam eno metamme ad sheyehe bo kabbetza
Orlah 2:5: Dostay ish kefar yitma haya mittalmide vet shammay veamar shamati mishshammay hazzaken sheamar leolam eno metamme ad sheyehe bo kabbetza
Orlah 2:6: Ulma amru kal hamchammetz vehamtabbel vehamdammea lehachamir min bemino lehakel ulhachamir min besheeno mino ketzad seor shel chittim shennafal letoch issat chittim veyesh bo chede lechammetz ben sheyyesh bo laalot beechad umea uven sheen bo laalot beechad umea asur en bo laalot bemea veechad ben sheyyesh bo chede lechammetz ben sheen bo chede lechammetz asur
Orlah 2:7: Lehakel ulhachamir min besheeno mino ketzad kegon gerisin shennitbashshelu im adashim veyesh bahem benoten taam ben sheyyesh bahem laalot beechad umea uven sheen bahem laalot beechad umea asur en bahem benoten taam ben sheyyesh bahem laalot beechad umea uven sheen bahem laalot beechad umea muttar
Orlah 2:8: Seor shel chullin shennafal letoch issa veyesh bo kede lechammetz veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem veyesh bo chede lechammetz asur
Orlah 2:9: Seor shel chullin shennafal letoch issa vechimmetzah veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem veyesh bo chede lechammetz asur rabbi shimon mattir
Orlah 2:10: Tevalin shenayim ushlosha shemot mimmin echad o mishshelosha asur umitztarfin rabbi shimon omer shenayim ushlosha shemot mimmin echad o shene minin mishshem echad enan mitztarfin
Orlah 2:11: Seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch issa lo baze chede lechammetz velo baze chede lechammetz nitztarfu vechimmetzu rabbi eliezer omer achar haacharon ani va vachachamim omrim ben shennafal issur battechilla ben bassof leolam eno oser ad sheyehe bo chede lechammetz
Orlah 2:12: Yoezer ish habbira haya mittalmide bet shammay veamar shaalti et rabban gamliel hazzaken omed beshaar hammizrach veamar leolam eno oser ad sheyehe bo chede lechammetz
Orlah 2:13: Kelim shessachan beshemen tame vechazar vesachan beshemen tahor o shessachan beshemen tahor vechazar vesachan beshemen tame rabbi eliezer omer achar harishon ani ba vachachamim omrim achar haacharon
Orlah 2:14: Seor shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu letoch issa lo vaze chede lechammetz velo vaze chede lechammetz venitztarfu vechimmetzu asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim
Orlah 2:15: Tevalin shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu bakkedera lo vaelu chede letabbel velo vaellu chede letabbel venitztarfu vetibbelu asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim
Orlah 2:16: Chaticha shel kadshe kadashim shel piggul veshel notar shennitbashshelu im hachatichot asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim
Orlah 2:17: Besar kadshe kadashim uvsar kadashim kallim shennitbashshelu im besar hattaava asur litmeim umuttar lithorim
Orlah 3:1: Beged shetztzevao viklippe arla yiddalek nitarev baacherim kullam yiddaleku divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yaale beechad umatayim
Orlah 3:2: Hatztzovea melo hassit biklippe arla vaarago veveged veen yadua eze hu rabbi meir omer yiddalek habbeged vachachamim omrim yaale veechad umatayim
Orlah 3:3: Haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer habbechor beveged yiddalek habbeged umissear hannazir umippeter chamor besak yiddalek hassak uvmukdashin mekaddeshin kal shehen
Orlah 3:4: Tavshil shebbishshelo viklippe arla yiddalek nitarev baacherim yaale beechad umatayim
Orlah 3:5: Tannur shehissikuhu viklippe arla veafa vo et happat tiddalek happat nitarva vaacherot taale beechad umatayim
Orlah 3:6: Mi shehau lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem yiddaleku nitarvu vaacherim kullam yiddaleku divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yaalu beechad umatayim
Orlah 3:7: Shehaya rabbi meir omer et sheddarko limmanot mekaddesh vachachamim omrim eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad verabbi akiva omer shiva veellu hem egoze ferech rimmone vadan vechaviyyot setumot vechulfot teradin vekulse cheruv udlaat yevanit rabbi akiva omer af kikkarot shel baal habbayit harauy learla arla lechile hakkerem kile hakkarem
Orlah 3:8: Ketzad nitpatztzeu haegozim nitpardu harimmonim nitpattechu hechaviyyot nitchattechu haddeluim nitparsu hakkikkarot yaalu beechad umatayim
Orlah 3:9: Sefek arla beeretz yisrael asur uvsurya muttar uvchutza laaretz yored velokeach uvilvad shello yirennu loket kerem natua yarak veyarak nimkar chutza lo beeretz yisrael asur uvsurya muttar uvchutza laaretz yored veloket uvilvad shello yilkot bayyad hechadash asur min hattora bechal makom vehaarla halacha vehakkilayim middivre sofrim
Bikkurim 1:1: Yesh meviin bikkurim vekorin meviin velo korin veyesh sheenan meviin ellu sheenan meviin hannotea letoch shello vehivrich letoch shel yachid o shel rabbim vechen hammavrich mittoch shel yachid o mittoch shel rabbim letoch shello hannotea letoch shello vehivrich letoch shello vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim baemtza hare ze eno mevi rabbi yehuda omer kaze mevi
Bikkurim 1:2: Meeze taam eno mevi mishshum shenneemar reshit bikkure admatcha shmt chg ad sheyehu chal haggiddulin meadmatcha haarisin vehechachorot vehassikkarikon vehaggazlan en meviin meoto hattaam mishshum shenneemar reshit bikkure admatcha
Bikkurim 1:3: En meviin bikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim lo mittemarim shebbeharim velo mipperot shebbaamakim velo mizzete shemen sheenam min hammuvchar en meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret anshe har tzevoim heviu vikkurehem kodem laatzeret velo kibbelu mehem mippene hakkatuv shebbattora shmt chg vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade
Bikkurim 1:4: Ellu meviin velo korin hagger mevi veeno kore sheeno yachol lomar asher nishba laavotenu latet lanu dvrm chg veim hayeta immo miyyisrael mevi vekore uchshehu mitpallel beno leven atzmo omer elohe avot yisrael uchshehu vevet hakkeneset omer elohe avotechem veim hayeta immo miyyisrael omer elohe avotenu
Bikkurim 1:5: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ishsha vat gerim lo tinnase lakkehunna ad shettehe immah miyyisrael echad gerim veechad avadim meshuchrarim vaafillu ad asara dorot ad shettehe imman miyyisrael haappotroppos vehashshaliach vehaeved vehaishsha vetumtum veanderoginos meviin velo korin sheenan yecholin lomar dvrm chy asher natatta li
Bikkurim 1:6: Hakkone shette ilanot betoch shel chavero mevi veeno kore rabbi meir omer mevi vekore yavash hammayan niktzatz hailan mevi veeno kore rabbi yehuda omer mevi vekore meatzeret vead hechag mevi vekore min hechag vead chanukka mevi veeno kore rabbi yehuda ven betera omer mevi vekore
Bikkurim 1:7: Hifrish bikkurav umachar sadehu mevi veeno kore vehashsheni meoto hammin eno mevi mimmin acher mevi vekore rabbi yehuda omer af meoto hammin mevi vekore
Bikkurim 1:8: Hifrish bikkurav nivzezu namakku nignevu avdu o shennitmeu mevi acherim tachtehem veeno kore vehashsheniyyim enam chayyavim alehem chomesh nitmeu vaazara nofetz veeno kore
Bikkurim 1:9: Uminnayin shehu chayyav beacharautan ad sheyyavi lehar habbayit shenneemar shmt chg reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet elohecha melammed shechayyav beacharautam ad sheyyavi lehar habbayit hare shehevi mimmin echad vekara vechazar vehevi mimmin acher eno kore
Bikkurim 1:10: Veellu meviin vekorin min haatzeret vead hechag mishshivat hamminim mipperot shebbeharim mittemarot shebbaamakim umizzete shemen meever hayyarden rabbi yose haggelili omer en meviin bikkurim meever hayyarden sheenah eretz zavat chalav udvash
Bikkurim 1:11: Hakkone shelosha ilanot betoch shel chavero mevi vekore rabbi meir omer afillu shenayim kana ilan vekarkao mevi vekore rabbi yehuda omer af baale arisut vechachorot meviin vekorin
Bikkurim 2:1: Hatteruma vehabbikkurim chayyavim alehen mita vechomesh vaasurim lezarim vehem nichse chohen veolin beechad umea utunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh hare ellu vitruma uvikkurim ma sheen ken bammaaser
Bikkurim 2:2: Yesh bemaaser uvikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma shehammaaser vehabbikkurim teunim havaat makom utunim vidduy vaasurin laonen rabbi shimon mattir vechayyavin babbiur verabbi shimon poter vaasurin kal shehen milleechol birushalayim vegiddulehen asurim milleechol birushalayim af lezarim velabbehema rabbi shimon mattir hare ellu bammaaser uvabbikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma
Bikkurim 2:3: Yesh batteruma vevammaaser ma sheen ken babbikkurim shehatteruma vehammaaser osrin et haggoren veyesh lahem shiur venohagim bechal happerot bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit uvaarisin uvechachorot uvassikkarikon uvaggazlan hare ellu vatteruma uvammaaser ma sheen ken babbikkurim
Bikkurim 2:4: Veyesh babbikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma uvammaaser shehabbikkurim niknin bimchubbar lakkarka veose adam kal sadehu bikkurim vechayyav beacharautam utunim karban veshir utnufa velina
Bikkurim 2:5: Terumat maaser shava labbikkurim bishte derachim velatteruma bishte derachim nittelet min hattahor al hattame veshello min hammukkaf kabbikkurim veoseret et haggoren veyesh lah shiur katteruma
Bikkurim 2:6: Etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim velayyarak bederech echad shave lailan baarla uvarvai uvashsheviit velayyarak bederech echad shebbishat lekitato issuro divre rabban gamliel rabbi eliezer omer shave lailan bechal davar
Bikkurim 2:7: Dam mehalleche shettayim shave ledam behema lehachshir et hazzeraim vedam hashsheretz en chayyavin alav
Bikkurim 2:8: Koy yesh bo derachim shave lachayya veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema velachayya veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo labbehema velo lachayya
Bikkurim 2:9: Ketzad shave lachayya damo taun kissuy kedam chayya veen shochatin oto beom tov veim shechato en mechassin et damo vechelbo metamme vetumat nevela kachayya vetumato vesafek veen podin bo peter chamor
Bikkurim 2:10: Ketzad shave labbehema chelbo asur kechelev behema veen chayyavin alav karet veeno nilkach bechesef maaser leechol birushalayim vechayyav bizroa ulchayayim vekeva rabbi eliezer poter shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Bikkurim 2:11: Ketzad eno shave lo lachayya velo labbehema asur mishshum kilayim im hachayya veim habbehema hakkotev chayyato uvhemto livno lo chatav lo et hakkoy im amar hareni nazir shezze chayya o vehema hare hu nazir ushar kal derachav shavim lachayya velabbehema vetaun shechita kaze vechaze umtamme mishshum nevela umishshum ever min hachay kaze vechaze
Bikkurim 3:1: Ketzad mafrishin habbikkurim yored adam betoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera eshkol shebbikker rimmon shebbikker koshro vegemi veomer hare ellu bikkurim rabbi shimon omer af al pi chen chozer vekore otam bikkurim meachar sheyyittalshu min hakkarka
Bikkurim 3:2: Ketzad maalin et habbikkurim kal haayarot shebbammaamad mitkannesot lair shel maamad velanin birchovah shel ir velo hau nichnasin labbattim velammashkim haya hammunne omer yirmeya l kumu venaale tziyyon el bet elohenu
Bikkurim 3:3: Hakkerovim meviim hatteenim vehaanavim veharchokim meviim gerogarot vetzimmukim vehashshor holech lifnehem vekarnav metzuppot zahav vaateret shel zayit berosho hechalil makke lifnehem ad shemmaggiim karov lirushalayim higgiu karov lirushalayim shalchu lifnehem veitteru et bikkurehem happachot hasseganim vehaggizbarim yotzim likratam lefi chevod hannichnasim hau yotzim vechal baale ummaniyyot shebbirushalayim omdim lifnehem veshoalin bishlomam achenu anshe hammakom peloni batem leshalom
Bikkurim 3:4: Hechalil makke lifnehem ad shemmaggiin lehar habbayit higgiu lehar habbayit afillu agripas hammelech notel hassal al ketefo venichnas ad shemmaggia laazara higgia laazara vedibberu halviyyim bashshir aromimcha ki dillitani velo simmachta oyevay li tehillim l
Bikkurim 3:5: Haggozalot sheal gabbe hassallim hau olot uma shebbeyadam notnim lakkohanim
Bikkurim 3:6: Odehu hassal al ketefo kore mehiggadti hayyom la elohecha dvrm chv ad sheggomer kal happarasha rabbi yehuda omer ad arammi oved avi higgia laarammi oved avi morid hassal meal ketefo veochazo vesiftotav vechohen manniach yado tachtav umnifo vekore mearammi oved avi ad shehu gomer kal happarasha umannicho betzad hammizbeach vehishtachava veyatza
Bikkurim 3:7: Barishona kal mi sheyyodea likrot kore vechal mi sheeno yodea likrot makrin oto nimneu millehavi hitkinu sheyehu makrin et mi sheyyodea veet mi sheeno yodea
Bikkurim 3:8: Haashirim meviim bikkurehem biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav vehaaniyyim meviin otam besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa vehassallim vehabbikkurim nittanin lakkohanim
Bikkurim 3:9: Rabbi shimon ben nannas omer meatterin et habbikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim rabbi akiva omer en meatterin et habbikkurim ella mishshivat hamminim
Bikkurim 3:10: Rabbi shimon omer shalosh middot babbikkurim habbikkurim vetosefet habbikkurim veittur habbikkurim tosefet habbikkurim min bemino veittur habbikkurim min besheeno mino tosefet habbikkurim neechelet betahora uftura min haddemay veittur habbikkurim chayyav baddemay
Bikkurim 3:11: Ematay amru tosefet habbikkurim kabbikkurim bizman shehi vaa min haaretz veim enah baa min haaretz enah kabbikkurim
Bikkurim 3:12: Lema amru habbikkurim kenichse chohen shehu kone mehem avadim vekarkaot uvhema temea uvaal chov notlan bechovo vehaishsha vichtubbatah kesefer tora verabbi yehuda omer en notnim otam ella lechaver betova vachachamim omrim notnin otam leanshe mishmar vehem mechallekin benehem kekadshe hammikdash
Bikkurim 4:1: Anderoginos yesh bo derachim shave laanashim veyesh bo derachim shave lannashim veyesh bo derachim shave laanashim venashim veyesh bo derachim eno shave lo laanashim velo lannashim
Bikkurim 4:2: Ketzad shave laanashim metamme beloven kaanashim vezokek leyibbum kaanashim umitattef umistapper kaanashim venose aval lo nissa kaanashim vechayyav bechal mitzot haamurot battora kaanashim
Bikkurim 4:3: Ketzad shave lannashim metamme beodem kannashim veeno mityached im haanashim kannashim veeno over al bal takkif velo al bal tashchit velo al bal tetamme lammetim kannashim ufasul min haedut kannashim veeno nival baavera kannashim venifsal min hakkehunna kannashim
Bikkurim 4:4: Ketzad shave laanashim velannashim chayyavim al makkato veal killato kaanashim vechannashim vehahorgo shogeg gole umezid neherag kaanashim venashim veoshevet alav dam tame vedam tahor kaanashim vechannashim vecholek bekadshe kodashim kaanashim vechannashim venochel lechal hannechalot kaanashim vechannashim veim amar hareni nazir shezze ish veishsha hare ze nazir
Bikkurim 4:5: Ketzad eno shave lo laanashim velo lannashim en chayyavim lo al makkato velo al killato lo kaanashim velo kannashim veeno neerach lo kaanashim velo kannashim veim amar hareni nazir shezze lo ish velo ishsha eno nazir rabbi meir omer anderoginos beriyya bifne atzmah hu velo yachlu chachamim lehachria alav im hu ish o ishsha aval tumtum eno ken peamim shehu ish peamim shehu ishsha
Shabbat 1:1: Yetziot hashshabbat shettayim shehen arba bifnim ushtayim shehen arba bachutz ketzad heani omed bachutz uvaal habbayit bifnim pashat heani et yado lifnim venatan letoch yado shel baal habbayit o shennatal mittochah vehotzi heani chayyav uvaal habbayit patur pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatan letoch yado shel ani o shennatal mittochah vehichnis baal habbayit chayyav veheani patur pashat heani et yado lifnim venatal baal habbayit mittochah o shennatan letochah vehotzi shenehem peturin pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatal heani mittochah o shennatan letochah vehichnis shenehem peturin
Shabbat 1:2: Lo yeshev adam lifne hassappar samuch lammincha ad sheyyitpallel lo yikkanes adam lammerchatz velo labburseki velo leechol velo ladin veim hitchilu en mafsikin mafsikim likrot keriat shema veen mafsikim lattefilla
Shabbat 1:3: Lo yetze hachayyat bemachto samuch lachashecha shemma yishkach veyetze velo hallavlar bekulmoso velo yefalle et kelav velo yikra leor hanner beemet amru hachazzan roe hechan tinokot korim aval hu lo yikra kayyotze vo lo yochal hazzav im hazzava mippene hergel avera
Shabbat 1:4: Veellu min hahalachot sheamru vaaliyyat chananya ven chizkiyya ven guron keshealu levakkero nimnu verabbu bet shammay al bet hillel ushmona asar devarim gazru vo vayyom
Shabbat 1:5: Bet shammay omrim en shorin deo vesammanim vecharshinim ella kede sheyyishshoru mibbeod yom uvet hillel mattirin
Shabbat 1:6: Bet shammay omrim en notnin unin shel pishtan letoch hattannur ella kede sheyyahbilu mibbeod yom velo et hatztzemer layyora ella chede sheyyiklot haayin uvet hillel mattirin bet shammay omrim en porsin metzudot chayya veofot vedagim ella chede sheyyitztzodu mibbeod yom uvet hillel mattirin
Shabbat 1:7: Bet shammay omrim en mochrin lannachri veen toanin immo veen magbihin alav ella kede sheyyaggia lemakom karov uvet hillel mattirin
Shabbat 1:8: Bet shammay omrim en notnin orot leabbedan velo chelim lechoves nachri ella kede sheyyeasu mibbeod yom uvchullan bet hillel mattirin im hashshamesh
Shabbat 1:9: Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel nohagin hau bet abba shehau notnin kele lavan lechoves nachri shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat veshavin ellu vaellu shettoanin korot bet habbad veiggule haggat
Shabbat 1:10: En tzolin basar batzal uvetza ella kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom en notnin pat lattannur im chashecha velo charara al gabbe gechalim ella kede sheyyikremu faneha mibbeod yom rabbi eliezer omer kede sheyyikrom hattachton shellah
Shabbat 1:11: Meshalshelin et happesach battannur im chashecha umaachizin et haur bimdurat bet hammoked uvaggevulin kede sheyyeechoz haur berubban rabbi yehuda omer befechamin kal shehu
Shabbat 2:1: Bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin en madlikin lo velechesh velo vechosen velo vechalach velo viftilat haidan velo viftilat hammidbar velo viroka sheal pene hammayim velo vezefet velo veshaava velo veshemen kik velo veshemen serefa velo vealya velo vechelev nachum hammadi omer madlikin bechelev mevushshal vachachamim omrim echad mevushshal veechad sheeno mevushshal en madlikin bo
Shabbat 2:2: En madlikin beshemen serefa beom tov rabbi yishmael omer en madlikin beitran mippene chevod hashshabbat vachachamim mattirin bechal hashshemanim beshemen shumshemin beshemen egozim beshemen tzenonot beshemen dagim beshemen pakkuot beitran uvneft rabbi tarfon omer en madlikin ella veshemen zayit bilvad
Shabbat 2:3: Kal hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo ella fishtan vechal hayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumat ohalim ella fishtan petilat habbeged shekkippelah velo hivhavah rabbi eliezer omer temea veen madlikin bah rabbi akiva omer tehora umadlikin bah
Shabbat 2:4: Lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalenna shemen veyittenenna al pi hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet afillu hi shel cheres verabbi yehuda mattir aval im chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla muttar mippene shehu cheli echad lo yemalle adam et hakkeara shemen veyittenenna vetzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila vetochah bishvil shettehe shoevet verabbi yehuda mattir
Shabbat 2:5: Hamchabbe et hanner mippene shehu mityare mippene goyim mippene listim mippene ruach raa veim bishvil hachole sheyyishan patur kechas al hanner kechas al hashshemen kechas al happetila chayyav verabbi yose poter bechullan chutz min happetila mippene shehu osah pecham
Shabbat 2:6: Al shalosh averot nashim metot bishat ledatan al sheenan zehirot bannidda uvachalla uvhadlakat hanner
Shabbat 2:7: Shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha issartem eravtem hadliku et hanner safek chashecha safek en chashecha en measserin et havadday veen matbilin et hakkelim veen madlikin et hannerot aval measserin et haddemay umarvin vetomnin et hachammin
Shabbat 3:1: Kira shehissikuha vekash uvigvava notnim aleha tavshil begefet uvetzim lo yitten ad sheyyigrof o ad sheyyitten et haefer bet shammay omrim chammin aval lo tavshil uvet hillel omrim chammin vetavshil bet shammay omrim notlin aval lo machazirin uvet hillel omrim af machazirin
Shabbat 3:2: Tannur shehissikuhu vekash uvaggevava lo yitten ben mittocho ben meal gabbav kuppach shehissikuhu vekash uvigvava hare ze chechirayim begefet uvetzim hare hu chetannur
Shabbat 3:3: En notnin betza vetzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel velo yafkienna vesudarin verabbi yose mattir velo yatminenna vechol uvaavak derachim bishvil shettitztzale
Shabbat 3:4: Maase sheasu anshe teverya veheviu sillon shel tzonen letoch amma shel chammin amru lahen chachamim im beshabbat kechammin shehuchammu veshabbat asurin birchitza uvishtiyya beom tov kechammin shehuchammu veom tov asurin birchitza umuttarin bishtiyya mulyar haggaruf shotin hemennu veshabbat antichi af al pi sheggerufa en shotin mimmenna
Shabbat 3:5: Hammecham sheppinnahu lo yitten letocho tzonen bishvil sheyyechammu aval noten hu letocho o letoch hakkos kede lehafshiran hailpas vehakkedera sheheeviran meruttachin lo yitten letochan tevalin aval noten hu letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy rabbi yehuda omer lakkol hu noten chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir
Shabbat 3:6: En notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo et hashshemen veim notno mibbeod yom muttar veen neotin mimmennu lefi sheeno min hammuchan metaltelin ner chadash aval lo yashan rabbi shimon omer kal hannerot metaltelin chutz min hanner haddolek beshabbat notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe
Shabbat 4:1: Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin en tomnin lo vegefet velo vezevel lo vemelach velo vesid velo vechol ben lachim ben yeveshim lo veteven velo vezagim velo vemochim velo vaasavim bizman shehen lachim aval tomnin bahen keshehen yeveshin tomnin bichsut uvferot bechanfe yona uvinsoret shel charashim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka rabbi yehuda oser bedakka umattir begassa
Shabbat 4:2: Tomnin bishlachin umtaltelin otan begizze tzemer veen metaltelin otan ketzad hu ose notel et hakkissuy vehen noflot rabbi elazar ben azarya omer kuppa mattah al tziddah venotel shemma yittol veeno yachol lehachazir vachachamim omrim notel umachazir lo chissahu mibbeod yom lo yechassennu mishshettechshach kissahu venitgalla muttar lechassoto memalle et hakkiton venoten letachat hakkar o tachat hakkaset
Shabbat 5:1: Bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza yotze haggamal beafsar venaka vachatam veluvdekis bifrumbeya vesus besher vechal baale hashsher yotzim bashsher venimshachim bashsher umazzin alehen vetovlin bimkoman
Shabbat 5:2: Chamor yotze vemardaat bizman shehi keshura lo zecharim yotzin levuvin rechelot yotzot shechuzot kevulot uchvunot haizzim yotzot tzerurot rabbi yose oser bechullan chutz min harchelin hakkevunot rabbi yehuda omer izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh aval lo lechalav
Shabbat 5:3: Uvamma enah yotza lo yetze gamal bimtutelet lo akud velo ragul vechen shear kal habbehemot lo yikshor gemallim ze vaze veyimshoch aval machnis chavalim letoch yado veyimshoch uvilvad shello yichroch
Shabbat 5:4: En chamor yotze vemardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo velo vezog af al pi shehu fakuk velo vesullam shebbetzavaro velo virtzua shebberaglo veen hattarnegolin yotzin bechutin velo virtzuot shebberaglehem veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala shettachat haalya shellahen veen harchelim yotzot chanunot veen haegel yotze vegimon velo fara beor hakkuppar velo virtzua shebben karneha parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayeta yotza virtzua shebben karneha shello virtzon chachamim
Shabbat 6:1: Bamme ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza lo tetze ishsha lo vechute tzemer velo vechute fishtan velo virtzuot shebberoshah velo titbol bahen ad shetterappem velo vetotefet velo vesanbutin bizman sheenan tefurin velo vechavul lirshut harabbim velo veir shel zahav velo vekatla velo vinzamim velo vetabbaat sheen aleha chotam velo vemachat sheenah nekuva veim yatzat enah chayyevet chattat
Shabbat 6:2: Lo yetze haish besandal hamsummar velo veyachid bizman sheen beraglo makka velo vitfillin velo vekamea bizman sheeno min hammumche velo veshiron velo vekasda velo vemaggafayim veim yatza eno chayyav chattat
Shabbat 6:3: Lo tetze ishsha vemachat hannekuva velo vetabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam velo vecholyar velo vechovelet velo vitzlochit shel palyaton veim yatzta chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir vachachamim potrin bechovelet uvitzlochit shel palyaton
Shabbat 6:4: Lo yetze haish lo vesayif velo vekeshet velo vitris velo vealla velo veromach veim yatza chayyav chattat rabbi eliezer omer tachshitin hen lo vachachamim omrim enan ella lignay shenneemar yeshaya be vechittetu charvotam leittim vachanitotehem lemazmerot lo yissa goy el goy cherev velo yilmedu od milchama birit tehora veotzin bah beshabbat kevalim temein veen yotzin bahem beshabbat
Shabbat 6:5: Yotza ishsha vechute sear ben mishshellah ben mishshel chavertah ben mishshel behema uvtotefet uvsanbutin bizman shehen tefurin bechavul uvfea nachrit lechatzer bemoch shebbeaznah uvmoch shebbesandalah uvmoch shehitkina leniddatah befilpel uvgargir melach uvchal davar shettitten letoch piha uvilvad shello titten lechattechilla veshabbat veim nafal lo tachazir shen totevet veshen shel zahav rabbi mattir vachachamim osrim
Shabbat 6:6: Yotza vesela sheal hatztzinit habbanot ketannot yotzot bechutin vaafillu vekismin shebbeaznehem arviyyot yotzot reulot umadiyyot perufot vechal adam ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove
Shabbat 6:7: Porefet al haeven veal haegoz veal hammatbea uvilvad shello tifrof lechattechilla veshabbat
Shabbat 6:8: Hakkittea yotze vekav shello divre rabbi meir verabbi yose oser veim yesh lo vet kibbul ketutim tame samochot shello temein midras veotzin bahen beshabbat venichnasin bahen baazara kisse vesamochot shello temein midras veen yotzin bahen beshabbat veen nichnasin bahen baazara ankatmin tehorin veen yotzin bahen
Shabbat 6:9: Habbanim yotzin biksharim uvne melachim bezogin vechal adam ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove
Shabbat 6:10: Yotzin bevetzat hachargol uvshen shual uvmasmer min hatztzaluv mishshum refua divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim af bechol asur mishshum darche haemori
Shabbat 7:1: Kelal gadol amru vashshabbat kal hashshocheach ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harbe veshabbatot harbe eno chayyav ella chattat echat hayyodea ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harbe beshabbatot harbe chayyav al kal shabbat veshabbat hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harbe beshabbatot harbe chayyav al kal av melacha umlacha haose melachot harbe meen melacha achat eno chayyav ella chattat echat
Shabbat 7:2: Avot melachot arbaim chaser echat hazzorea vehachoresh vehakkotzer vehamammer haddash vehazzore habborer hattochen vehamrakked vehallash vehaofe haggozez et hatztzemer hamlabbeno vehamnappetzo vehatztzovo vehattove vehammesech vehaose shene vatte nirin vehaoreg shene chutin vehappotzea shene chutin hakkosher vehammattir vehattofer shette tefirot hakkorea al menat litpor shette tefirot hatztzad tzevi hashshochato vehammafshito hammolcho vehamabbed et oro vehammochako vehamchattecho hakkotev shette otiyyot vehammochek al menat lichtov shette otiyyot habbone vehassoter hamchabbe vehammavir hammakke vappattish hammotzi mershut lirshut hare ellu avot melachot arbaim chaser echat
Shabbat 7:3: Veod kelal acher amru kal hakkasher lehatznia umatzniin kamohu vehotzio veshabbat chayyav alav chattat vechal sheeno chasher lehatznia veen matzniin kamohu vehotzio veshabbat eno chayyav ella hammatznio
Shabbat 7:4: Hammotzi teven kimlo fi fara atza kimlo fi gamal amir kimlo fi tale asavim kimlo fi gedi ale shum vaale vetzalim lachim kigrogeret yeveshim kimlo fi gedi veen mitztarfin ze im ze mippene shello shau veshiurehen hammotzi ochalim kigrogeret chayyav umitztarfin ze im ze mippene sheshshau veshiurehen chutz mikkelippehen vegarinehen veuktzehen vesubban umursanan rabbi yehuda omer chutz mikkelippe adashim shemmitbashshelot immahen
Shabbat 8:1: Hammotzi yayin kede mezigat hakkos chalav kede gemia devash kede litten al hakkatit shemen kede lasuch ever katan mayim kede lashuf bahem et hakkilor ushar kal hammashkin birviit vechal hashshofachin birviit rabbi shimon omer kullan birviit velo amru chal hashshiurin hallalu ella lematzniehen
Shabbat 8:2: Hammotzi chevel kede laasot ozen lekuppa gemi kede laasot telay lenafa velichvara rabbi yehuda omer kede littol mimmennu middat minal lekatan neyar kede lichtov alav kesher mochsin vehammotzi kesher mochsin chayyav neyar machuk kede lichroch al pi tzelochit ketanna shel palyaton
Shabbat 8:3: Or kede laasot kamea kelaf kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna shebbattefillin shehi shema yisrael deo kede lichtov shette otiyyot kechol kede lichchol ayin echat
Shabbat 8:4: Devek kede litten berosh hashshavshevet zefet vegafrit kede laasot nekev shaava kede litten al pi nekev katan charsit kede laasot pi kor shel tzorfe zahav rabbi yehuda omer kede laasot pitput subbin kede litten al pi kor shel tzorfe zahav sid kede lasud ketanna shebbabbanot rabbi yehuda omer kede laasot kilkul rabbi nechemya omer kede laasot andife
Shabbat 8:5: Adama kechotam hammartzufim divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim kechotam haiggerot zevel vechol haddak kede lezabbel kelach shel keruv divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim kede lezabbel keresha chol haggas kede litten al melo chaf sid kane kede laasot kulmos veim haya av o merussas kede levashshel vo vetza kalla shebbabbetzim terufa untuna vailpas
Shabbat 8:6: Etzem kede laasot tarvad rabbi yehuda omer kede laasot mimmennu chaf zechuchit kede ligror bo rosh hakkarkar tzeror o even kede lizrok beof rabbi eliezer bar yaakov omer kede lizrok bivhema
Shabbat 8:7: Cheres kede litten ben patztzim lachavero divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer kede lachtot bo et haur rabbi yose omer kede lekabbel bo reviit amar rabbi meir af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar yeshaya l velo yimmatze vimchittato cheres lachtot esh miyyakud amar lo rabbi yose mishsham reaya velachsof mayim miggeve shm
Shabbat 9:1: Amar rabbi akiva minnayin laavoda zara shehi metammea vemassa kannidda shenneemar yeshaya l tizrem kemo dava tze tomar lo ma nidda metammea vemassa af avoda zara metammea vemassa
Shabbat 9:2: Minnayin lisfina shehi tehora shenneemar mshly l derech oniyya velev yam minnayin laaruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim shezzorin betochah chamishsha zeronin arbaa vearba ruchot haaruga veechad baemtza shenneemar yeshaya s ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah uchganna zerueha tatzmiach zarah lo neemar ella zerueha
Shabbat 9:3: Minnayin lefoletet shichvat zera bayyom hashshelishi shehi temea shenneemar shmt yt heu nechonim lishloshet yamim minnayin shemmarchitzin et hammila vayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat shenneemar vrsht led vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihotam koavim minnayin shekkoshrin lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach shenneemar yeshaya im yihu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu
Shabbat 9:4: Minnayin lesicha shehi chashshetiyya veom hakkippurim af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar shenneemar tehillim kt vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav
Shabbat 9:5: Hammotzi etzim kede levashshel betza kalla tevalin kede letabbel betza kalla umitztarfin ze im ze kelippe egozim kelippe rimmonim istis ufua kede litzboa bahen beged katan bassevacha me raglayim neter uvorit kimmonya veashlag kede lechabbes bahen beged katan bassevacha rabbi yehuda omer kede lehaavir al hakkatem
Shabbat 9:6: Pilpelet kal shehu veitran kal shehu mine vesamim umine mattachot kal shehen meavne hammizbeach umeafar hammizbeach mekek sefarim umekek mitpechotehem kal shehu shemmatzniin otan leganzan rabbi yehuda omer af hammotzi mimmeshammeshe avodat kochavim kal shehu shenneemar dvrm yg velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem
Shabbat 9:7: Hammotzi kuppat harochlin af al pi sheyyesh bah minin harbe eno chayyav ella chattat echat zerone ginna pachot mikkaggerogeret rabbi yehuda ben betera omer chamishsha zera kishshuin shenayim zera deluin shenayim zera pol hammitzri shenayim chagav chay tahor kal shehu met kaggerogeret tzipporet keramim ben chayya ben meta kal shehu shemmatzniin otah lirfua rabbi yehuda omer af hammotzi chagav chay tame kal shehu shemmatzniin oto lekatan lischok bo
Shabbat 10:1: Hammatznia lezera uldugma velirfua vehotzio beshabbat chayyav bechal shehu vechal adam en chayyav alav ella cheshiuro chazar vehichniso eno chayyav alav ella cheshiuro
Shabbat 10:2: Hammotzi ochalin untanan al haaskuppa ben shechazar vehotzian ben shehotzian acher patur mippene shello asa melachto bevat echat kuppa shehi melea ferot untanah al haaskuppa hachitzona af al pi sherov happerot mibbachutz patur ad sheyyotzi et kal hakkuppa
Shabbat 10:3: Hammotzi ben bimino ben bismolo betoch cheko o al ketefo chayyav shekken massa vene kehat kilachar yado beraglo befiv uvmarpeko beazno uvisaro uvfundato ufiha lematta ben pundato lachaluko uvisfat chaluko beminalo besandalo patur shello hotzi kederech hammotziin
Shabbat 10:4: Hammitkaven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav patur leacharav uva lo lefanav chayyav beemet amru haishsha hachogeret besinar ben millefaneha uven milleachareha chayyevet shekken rauy lihot chozer rabbi yehuda omer af mekabbele fitkin
Shabbat 10:5: Hammotzi chikkar lirshut harabbim chayyav hotziuhu shenayim peturin lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim chayyavim verabbi shimon poter hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkashshiur bichli patur af al hakkeli shehakkeli tefela lo et hachay bammitta patur af al hammitta shehammitta tefela lo et hammet bammitta chayyav vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz chayyav verabbi shimon poter
Shabbat 10:6: Hannotel tzipparnav zo vazo o veshinnav vechen searo vechen sefamo vechen zekano vechen haggodelet vechen hakkochelet vechen happokeset rabbi eliezer mechayyev vachachamim osrin mishshum shevut hattolesh meatzitz nakuv chayyav vesheeno nakuv patur verabbi shimon poter baze uvaze
Shabbat 11:1: Hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid chayyav mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid urshut harabbim baemtza rabbi akiva mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Shabbat 11:2: Ketzad shette gezuzteraot zo cheneged zo virshut harabbim hammoshit vehazzorek mizzo lazo patur hau shettehen bidota achat hammoshit chayyav vehazzorek patur shekkach hayeta avodat halviyyim shette agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim moshitin hakkerashim mizzo lazo aval lo zorkin chulyat habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara verachban arbaa hannotel mehen vehannoten al gabban chayyav pachot mikken patur
Shabbat 11:3: Hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel lemala measara tefachim kezorek baavir lematta measara tefachim kezorek baaretz hazzorek baaretz arba ammot chayyav zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot patur chutz learba ammot venitgalgel letoch arba ammot chayyav
Shabbat 11:4: Hazzorek bayyam arba ammot patur im haya rekak mayim urshut harabbim mehallechet bo hazzorek letocho arba ammot chayyav vechamma hu rekak mayim pachot measara tefachim rekak mayim urshut harabbim mehallechet bo hazzorek betocho arba ammot chayyav
Shabbat 11:5: Hazzorek min hayyam layyabbasha umin hayyabbasha layyam umin hayyam lassefina umin hassefina layyam umin hassefina lachavertah patur sefinot keshurot zo vazo metaltelin mizzo lazo im enan keshurot af al pi shemmukkafot en metaltelin mizzo lazo
Shabbat 11:6: Hazzorek venizkar leachar sheyyatzta miyyado kelatah acher kelatah kelev o shennisrefa patur zarak laasot chabbura ben beadam ben bivhema venizkar ad shello naasa chabbura patur ze hakkelal kal chayyave chattaot enan chayyavin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga techillatan shegaga vesofan zadon techillatan zadon vesofan shegaga peturin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga
Shabbat 12:1: Habbone kamma yivne vihe chayyav habbone kal shehu vehamsattet vehammakke vappattish uvmaatzad hakkodeach kal shehu chayyav ze hakkelal kal haose melacha umlachto mitkayyemet beshabbat chayyav rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af hammakke vekurnas al hassaddan bishat melacha chayyav mippene shehu chimtakken melacha
Shabbat 12:2: Hachoresh kal shehu hamnakkesh vehamkarsem vehamzared kal shehu chayyav hamlakket etzim im letakken kal shehen im lehessek kede levashshel betza kalla hamlakket asavim im letakken kal shehu im livhema kimlo fi haggedi
Shabbat 12:3: Hakkotev shette otiyyot ben bimino ben bismolo ben mishshem echad ben mishshene shemot ben mishshene sammaniyyot bechal lashon chayyav amar rabbi yose lo chiyevu shette otiyyot ella mishshum roshem shekkach hau chotvin al karshe hammishkan leda ezo ven zugo amar rabbi matzinu shem katan mishshem gadol shem mishshimon ushmuel noach minnachor dan middaniyyel gad miggaddiel
Shabbat 12:4: Hakkotev shette otiyyot behelem echad chayyav katav bido besam besikra bekomos uvkankantom uvchal davar shehu roshem al shene chatle zaviyyot veal shene luche finkas vehen nehgin ze im ze chayyav hakkotev al besaro chayyav hamsaret al besaro rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Shabbat 12:5: Katav bemashkin beme ferot baavak derachim baavak hassofrim uvchal davar sheeno mitkayyem patur leachar yado beraglo befiv uvmarpeko katav ot achat samuch lichtav uchtav al gabbe chetav nitkaven lichtov chet vechatav shene zayenin echad baaretz veechad bakkora katav al shene chatle habbayit al shene dappe finkas veen nehgin ze im ze patur katav ot achat notarikon rabbi yehoshua ben betera mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Shabbat 12:6: Hakkotev shette otiyyot bishne helemot achat shacharit veachat ben haarbayim rabban gamliel mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Shabbat 13:1: Rabbi eliezer omer haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veachat al haarig chayyav vachachamim omrim ben battechilla ben bassof shiuro shene chutin
Shabbat 13:2: Haose shene vatte nirin bannirin bakkeros bannafa bakkevara uvassal chayyav vehattofer shette tefirot vehakkorea al menat litpor shette tefirot
Shabbat 13:3: Hakkorea bachamato veal meto vechal hamkalkelin peturin vehamkalkel al menat letakken shiuro chamtakken
Shabbat 13:4: Shiur hamlabben vehamnappetz vehatztzovea vehattove kimlo rochav hassit kaful vehaoreg shene chutin shiuro kimlo hassit
Shabbat 13:5: Rabbi yehuda omer hatztzad tzippor lammigdal utzvi labbayit chayyav vachachamim omrim tzippor lammigdal utzvi labbayit velechatzer velabbevarin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo chal habbevarin shavin ze hakkelal mechussar tzida patur vesheeno mechussar tzida chayyav
Shabbat 13:6: Tzevi shennichnas labbayit venaal echad befanav chayyav naalu shenayim peturin lo yachol echad linol venaalu shenayim chayyavin verabbi shimon poter
Shabbat 13:7: Yashav haechad al happetach velo milleahu yashav hashsheni umilleahu hashsheni chayyav yashav harishon al happetach umilleahu uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo harishon chayyav vehashsheni patur ha lema ze dome lenoel et beto leshamro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho
Shabbat 14:1: Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora hatztzadan vehachovel bahen chayyav ushar shekatzim urmasim hachovel bahen patur hatztzadan letzorech chayyav shello letzorech patur chayya veof shebbirshuto hatztzadan patur vehachovel bahen chayyav
Shabbat 14:2: En osin hilmi veshabbat aval ose hu et me hammelach vetovel bahen pitto venoten letoch hattavshil amar rabbi yose vahalo hu hilmi ben merubbe uven muat veelu hen me melach hammuttarin noten shemen battechilla letoch hammayim o letoch hammelach
Shabbat 14:3: En ochlin ezov yon beshabbat lefi sheeno maachal beriim aval ochel hu et yoezer veshote abbuv roe kal haochalin ochel adam lirfua vechal hammashkin shote chutz mimme dekalim vechos ikkarim mippene shehen layeroka aval shote hu me dekalim litzmao vesach shemen ikkarin shello lirfua
Shabbat 14:4: Hachoshesh beshinnav lo yigma bahen et hachometz aval metabbel hu chedarko veim nitrappe nitrappe hachoshesh bematnav lo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen velo shemen vered bene melachim sachin shemen vered al makkotehen shekken darkam lasuch bachol rabbi shimon omer kal yisrael bene melachim hem
Shabbat 15:1: Ellu kesharim shechayyavin alehen kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin uchshem shehu chayyav al kishshuran kach hu chayyav al hetteran rabbi meir omer kal kesher shehu yachol lehattiro veachat miyyadav en chayyavin alav
Shabbat 15:2: Yesh lecha kesharim sheen chayyavin alehen kekesher haggammalin uchkesher hassappanin kosheret ishsha miftach chalukah vechute sevacha veshel pesikya urtzuot minal vesandal venodot yayin vashemen ukdera shel basar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer koshrin lifne habbehema bishvil shello tetze koshrin deli bifsikya aval lo vechevel rabbi yehuda mattir kelal amar rabbi yehuda kal kesher sheeno shel keyama en chayyavin alav
Shabbat 15:3: Mekappelin et hakkelim afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim umatztziin et hammittot millele shabbat leshabbat aval lo mishshabbat lemotzae shabbat rabbi yishmael omer mekappelin et hakkelim umatztziin et hammittot miyyom hakkippurim leshabbat vechelve shabbat kerevin beom hakkippurim aval lo shel yom hakkippurim beshabbat rabbi akiva omer lo shel shabbat kerevin beom hakkippurim velo shel yom hakkippurim kerevin beshabbat
Shabbat 16:1: Kal kitve hakkodesh matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka ben shekkorin bahen uven sheen korin bahen veaf al pi shekketuvim bechal lashon teunim geniza umippene ma en korin bahen mippene vittul bet hammidrash matztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer vetik hattefillin im hattefillin veaf al pi sheyyesh betochan maot ulhechan matztzilin otan lemavoy sheeno mefullash ben betera omer af limfullash
Shabbat 16:2: Matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot harauy leadam leadam harauy livhema livhema ketzad nafla deleka velele shabbat matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot beshacharit matztzilin mezon shette seuddot bemincha mezon seudda echat rabbi yose omer leolam matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot
Shabbat 16:3: Matztzilin sal male chikkarot veaf al pi sheyyesh bo mea seuddot veiggul shel devela vechavit shel yayin veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem veim hau fikchin osin immo cheshbon achar hashshabbat lehechan matztzilin otan lechatzer hamorevet ben betera omer af lesheenah meoravet
Shabbat 16:4: Ulsham motzi chal kele tashmisho velovesh kal ma sheyyachol lilbosh veotef kal ma sheyyachol laatof rabbi yose omer shemona asar kelim vechozer velovesh umotzi veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu immi
Shabbat 16:5: Rabbi shimon ben nannas omer porsin or shel gedi al gabbe shidda teva umigdal sheachaz bahen et haur mippene shehu mecharech veosin mechitztza bechal hakkelim ben meleim ben rekanim bishvil shello taavor haddeleka rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim melein mayim lefi sheen yecholin lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umchabbin et haddeleka
Shabbat 16:6: Nachri shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alehen aval katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo mippene sheshshevitato alehen
Shabbat 16:7: Kofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teechoz bakkora veal tzoa shel katan veal akrav shello tishshoch amar rabbi yehuda maase va lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav veamar choshshani lo mechattat
Shabbat 16:8: Nachri shehidlik et hanner mishtammesh leoro yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur mille mayim lehashkot behemto mashke acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur asa goy kevesh lered bo yored acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur maase verabban gamliel uzkenim shehau vain bisfina veasa goy kevesh lered bo veyardu vo rabban gamliel uzkenim
Shabbat 17:1: Kal hakkelim nittalin beshabbat vedaltotehen immahen af al pi shennitparku veshabbat sheenan domin ledaltot habbayit lefi sheenan min hammuchan
Shabbat 17:2: Notel adam kurnas lefatztzea bo et haegozim vekurdom lachtoch et haddevela megera ligror bah et haggevina magrefa ligrof bah et haggerogarot et harachat veet hammazleg latet alav lekatan et hakkush veet hakkarkar litchov bo machat shel yad littol bo et hakkotz veshel sakkaim liftoach bo et haddalet
Shabbat 17:3: Kane shel zetim im yesh kesher berosho mekabbel tuma veim lav en mekabbel tuma ben kach uven kach nittal beshabbat
Shabbat 17:4: Rabbi yose omer kal hakkelim nittalin chutz min hammassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha kal hakkelim nittalin letzorech veshello letzorech rabbi nechemya omer en nittalin ella letzorech
Shabbat 17:5: Kal hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shivrehen nittalin immahen uvilvad sheyyihu osin meen melacha shivre areva lechassot bahen et pi hechavit shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen et pi happach rabbi yehuda omer uvilvad sheyyihu osin meen melachtan shivre areva litztzok letochan mikpa veshel zechuchit litztzok letochan shamen
Shabbat 17:6: Haeven shebbekeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet memallein bah veim lav en memallein bah zemora shehi keshura vetafiach memallein bah beshabbat
Shabbat 17:7: Pekak hachallon rabbi eliezer omer bizman shehu kashur vetaluy pokkin bo veim lav en pokkin bo vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach pokkin bo
Shabbat 17:8: Kal kissuye hakkelim sheyyesh lahem bet achiza nittalim beshabbat amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bechissuy karka aval bechissuy hakkelim ben kach uven kach nittalim beshabbat
Shabbat 18:1: Mefannin afillu arba vechamesh kuppot shel teven veshel tevua mippene haorchim umippene vittul bet hammidrash aval lo et haotzar mefannin teruma tehora udmay umaaser rishon shennittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehatturmos hayyavesh mippene shehu maachal laaniyyim aval lo et hattevel velo maaser rishon shello nittela terumato velo et maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu velo et halluf velo hachardal rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir beluf mippene shehu maachal orvin
Shabbat 18:2: Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim im hitkinan lemaachal behema metaltelin otan veim lav en metaltelin otan kofin et hassal lifne haefrochim kede sheyyaalu veyerdu tarnegolet shebbarcha dochin otah ad shettikkanes medaddin agalin usyachin birshut harabbim ishsha medadda et benah amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehu notel achat umeniach achat aval im haya gorer asur
Shabbat 18:3: En meyalledin et habbehema veom tov aval mesaadin umyalledin et haishsha beshabbat vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat vekoshrin et hattabbur rabbi yose omer af chotchin vechal tzarche mila osin beshabbat
Shabbat 19:1: Rabbi eliezer omer im lo hevi cheli meerev shabbat mevio veshabbat megulle uvassakkana mechassehu al pi edim veod amar rabbi eliezer kortin etzim laasot pechamin velaasot keli varzel kelal amar rabbi akiva kal melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat veshei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat
Shabbat 19:2: Osin kal tzarche mila veshabbat mohalin uforin umotztzin venotnin aleha ispelanit vechammon im lo shachak meerev shabbat loes beshinnav venoten im lo taraf yayin veshemen meerev shabbat yinnaten ze veatzmo veze veatzmo veen osin lah chaluk lechattechilla aval korech aleha semartut im lo hitkin meerev shabbat korech al etzbao umevi vaafillu mechatzer acheret
Shabbat 19:3: Marchitzin et hakkatan ben lifne hammila uven leachar hammila umzallefin alav bayyad aval lo vichli rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat shenneemar vrsht led vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihotam koavim safek veanderoginos en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat verabbi yehuda mattir beanderoginos
Shabbat 19:4: Mi shehau lo shette tinokot echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul beshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat beshabbat chayyav echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul beshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat beshabbat rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Shabbat 19:5: Katan nimmol lishmona letisha velaasara ulachad asar velishnem asar lo fachot velo yoter ha ketzad kedarko lishmona nolad leven hashshemashot nimmol letisha ben hashshemashot shel erev shabbat nimmol laasara yom tov leachar hashshabbat nimmol leachad asar shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana nimmol lishnem asar katan hachole en mohalin oto ad sheyyavri
Shabbat 19:6: Ellu hen tzitzin hamakkevin et hammila basar hachofe et rov haatara veeno ochel batteruma veim haya vaal basar metakkeno mippene marit haayin mal velo fara et hammila keillu lo mal
Shabbat 20:1: Rabbi eliezer omer tolin et hamshammeret beom tov venotnin latteluya veshabbat vachachamim omrim en tolin et hamshammeret beom tov veen notnin latteluya veshabbat aval notnin latteluya veom tov
Shabbat 20:2: Notnin mayim al gabbe hashshemarim bishvil sheyyitztzallu umsannenin et hayyayin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit venotnin betza vimsannenet shel chardal veosin enumlin beshabbat rabbi yehuda omer beshabbat bechos beom tov belagin uvammoed bechavit rabbi tzadok omer hakkol lefi haorchin
Shabbat 20:3: En shorin et hachiltit befoshrin aval noten letoch hachometz veen shorin et hakkarshinin velo shafin otan aval noten letoch hakkevara o letoch hakkalkalla en kovrin et hatteven bichvara velo yittenennu al gabbe makom gavoha bishvil sheyyered hammotz aval notel hu vichvara venoten letoch haevus
Shabbat 20:4: Gorfin millifne happetam umsallekin litzdadin mippene hari divre rabbi dosa vachachamim osrin notlin millifne vehema zo venotnin lifne vehema zo beshabbat
Shabbat 20:5: Hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta lo yenaneo veyado ella menaneo vegufo veim haya maachal behema o shehaya alav kar o sadin menaneo veyado machbesh shel baale vattim mattirin aval lo chovshin veshel kovsin lo yigga bo rabbi yehuda omer im haya muttar meerev shabbat mattir et kullo veshomto
Shabbat 21:1: Notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado vechalkalla vehaeven betochah umtaltelin teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin rabbi yehuda omer af maalin et hamdumma beechad umea
Shabbat 21:2: Haeven sheal pi hechavit mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet hayeta ven hechaviyyot magbiha umattah al tziddah vehi nofelet maot sheal hakkar noer et hakkar vehen noflot hayeta alav lashleshet mekannechah bismartut hayeta shel or notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle
Shabbat 21:3: Bet shammay omrim magbihin min hashshulchan atzamot uklippin uvet hillel omrim notel et hattavla chullah umnaarah maavirin millifne hashshulchan perurin pachot mikkazzayit vesear shel afunin vesear shel adashim mippene shehu maachal behema sefog im yesh lo or bet achiza mekannechin bo veim lav en mekannechin bo vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach nittal beshabbat veeno mekabbel tuma
Shabbat 22:1: Chavit shennishbera matztzilin hemenna mezon shalosh seuddot veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem uvilvad shello yispog en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin veim yatzu meatzman asurin rabbi yehuda omer im leochalin hayyotze mehen muttar veim lemashkin hayyotze mehen asur challot devash sherissekan meerev shabbat veyatzu meatzman asurin verabbi eliezer mattir
Shabbat 22:2: Kol shebba vechammin meerev shabbat shorin oto vechammin beshabbat vechol shello va vechammin meerev shabbat medichin oto vechammin beshabbat chutz min hammaliach hayyashan vedagim meluchim ketannim vekulyas haispanin shehadachatan zo hi gemar melachtan
Shabbat 22:3: Shover adam et hechavit leechol hemenna gerogarot uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot keli veen nokvim megufa shel chavit divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim mattirin velo yikkevenna mitztziddah veim hayeta nekuva lo yitten aleha shaava mippene shehu memareach amar rabbi yehuda maase va lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav veamar choshshani lo mechattat
Shabbat 22:4: Notnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyehe shamur veet hammayim hayyafim baraim bishvil sheyyitztzannu veet hatztzonen bachamma bishvil sheyyechammu mi shennashru chelav badderech bemayim mehallech bahen veeno choshesh higgia lechatzer hachitzona shotchan bachamma aval lo cheneged haam
Shabbat 22:5: Harochetz beme meara uvme teverya venistappeg afillu veeser aluntiot lo yeviem beyado aval asara vene adam mistappegin baaluntit achat penehem yedehem veraglehem umviin otah beyadan
Shabbat 22:6: Sachin ummashmeshin bivne meayim aval lo mitammelin velo mitgardin en yordin lekordima veen osin appiktevizin veen meatztzevin et hakkatan veen machazirin et hashshever mi shennifreka yado veraglo lo yitrefem betzonen aval rochetz hu chedarko veim nitrappa nitrappa
Shabbat 23:1: Shoel adam mechavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen uvilvad shello yomar lo halveni vechen haishsha mechavertah kikkarot veim eno maamino manniach tallito etzlo veose immo cheshbon leachar shabbat vechen erev pesach birushalayim shechal lihot beshabbat manniach tallito etzlo venotel et pischo veose immo cheshbon leachar yom tov
Shabbat 23:2: Mone adam et orchav veet parperotav mippiv aval lo min hakketav umefis im banav veim bene veto al hashshulchan uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot mana gedola keneged ketanna mishshum kuvya umattilin chalashim al hakkadashim beom tov aval lo al hammanot
Shabbat 23:3: Lo yiskor adam poalim beshabbat velo yomar adam lachavero liskor lo foalim en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim ulhavi ferot aval machshich hu lishmor umevi ferot beyado kelal amar abba shaul kol sheani zakkay baamirato rashshay ani lehachshich alav
Shabbat 23:4: Machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske challa veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin goy shehevi chalilin beshabbat lo yispod bahen yisrael ella im ken bau mimmakom karov asu lo aron vechafru lo kever yikkaver bo yisrael veim bishvil yisrael lo yikkaver bo olamit
Shabbat 23:5: Osin kal tzarche hammet sachin umdichin oto uvilvad shello yazizu vo ever shomtin et hakkar mittachtav umattilin oto al hachol bishvil sheyyamtin koshrim et hallechi lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif vechen kora shennishbera somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta lo shettaale ella shello tosif en meammetzin et hammet beshabbat velo vechol im yetziat nefesh vehamammetz im yetziat nefesh hare ze shofech damim
Shabbat 24:1: Mi shehechshich badderech noten kiso lenachri veim en immo nachri menicho al hachamor higgia lechatzer hachitzona notel et hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat vesheenan nittalin beshabbat mattir et hachavalim vehassakkin noflin mealehem
Shabbat 24:2: Mattirin pekie amir lifne vehema umfaspesim et hakkefin aval lo et hazzerin en merassekin lo et hashshachat velo et hecharuvin lifne vehema ben dakka ben gassa rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin laddakka
Shabbat 24:3: En ovsin et haggamal velo dorsin aval malitin veen mamrim et haagalim aval malitin umhalketin lattarnegolin venotnin mayim lammursan aval lo govlim veen notnin mayim lifne devorim velifne yonim shebbashshovach aval notnin lifne avazim vetarnegolim velifne yone hardesiyyot
Shabbat 24:4: Mechattechin et haddeluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta nevela meerev shabbat asura lefi sheenah min hammuchan
Shabbat 24:5: Mefirin nedarim beshabbat venishalin lidvarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat pokkin et hammaor umoddin et hammatlit veet hammikve umaase vime aviv shel rabbi tzadok uvime abba shaul ben batnit sheppakku et hammaor betafiach vekashru et hammekeda vegemi leda im yesh baggigit poteach tefach im lav umiddivrehen lamadnu sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat
Eruvin 1:1: Mavoy shehu gavoha lemala meesrim amma yemaet rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich veharachav meeser ammot yemaet veim yesh lo tzurat happetach af al pi shehu rachav meeser ammot en tzarich lemaet
Eruvin 1:2: Hechsher mavoy bet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim lechi o kora rabbi eliezer omer lechayayin mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu fachot mearba ammot shehu o velechi o vekora al ma nechleku al rachav mearba ammot vead eser shebbet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim o lechi o kora amar rabbi akiva al ze veal ze nechelaku
Eruvin 1:3: Hakkora sheamru rechava kede lekabbel ariach veariach chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim dayya lakkora shettehe rechava tefach kede lekabbel ariach learko
Eruvin 1:4: Rechava kede lekabbel ariach uvria kede lekabbel ariach rabbi yehuda omer rechava af al pi sheen beria
Eruvin 1:5: Hayeta shel kash o shel kanim roin otah keillu hi shel mattechet akumma roin otah keillu hi feshuta agulla roin otah keillu hi merubbaat kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo rochav tafach
Eruvin 1:6: Lechayayin sheamru gavhan asara tefachim verachban veavyan kal shehu rabbi yose omer rachban shelosha tefachim
Eruvin 1:7: Bakkol osin lechayayin afillu vedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim verabbi yose oser umtamme mishshum golel verabbi meir metaher vechotvin alav gitte nashim verabbi yose haggelili fosel
Eruvin 1:8: Shayyara shechanta bevika vehikkifuha vichle vehema metaltelin betochah uvilvad sheyehe gader gavoha asara tefachim velo yihu feratzot yeterot al habbinyan kal pirtza shehi cheeser ammot mutteret mippene shehi chefetach yater mikkan asur
Eruvin 1:9: Makkifin shelosha chavalim ze lemala mizze veze lemala mizze uvilvad shello yehe ben chevel lachavero shelosha tefachim shiur chavalim veavyan yater al tefach kede sheyehe hakkol asara tefachim
Eruvin 1:10: Makkifin bekanim uvilvad shello yehe ven kane lachavero shelosha tefachim beshayyara dibberu divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim lo dibberu veshayyara ella vahove kal mechitztza sheenah shel sheti veshel erev enah mechitztza divre rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim echad mishshene devarim arbaa devarim patru vammachane meviin etzim mikkal makom ufturim merchitzat yadayim umiddemay umillearev
Eruvin 2:1: Osin passin labberaot arbaa deumdin nirin kishmona divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer shemona nirin kishnem asar arbaa deumdin vearbaa feshutin gavhan asara tefachim verachban shishsha veavyan kal shehu uvenehen kimlo shette revakot shel shalosh shalosh bakar divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer shel arba arba keshurot velo muttarot achat nichneset veachat yotzet
Eruvin 2:2: Muttar lehakriv labbeer uvilvad shettehe fara roshah verubbah bifnim veshota muttar leharchik kal shehu uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin
Eruvin 2:3: Rabbi yehuda omer ad bet satayim amru lo lo amru vet satayim ella leginna ulkarpef aval im haya dir o sachar o muktze o chatzer afillu vet chameshet korin afillu vet asara korin muttar umuttar leharchik kal shehu uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin
Eruvin 2:4: Rabbi yehuda omer im hayeta derech harabbim mafsaktan yesallekenna latztzedadin vachachamim omrim eno tzarich echad bor harabbim uver harabbim uver hayyachid osin lahen passin aval levor hayyachid osin lo mechitztza gavoha asara tefachim divre rabbi akiva rabbi yehuda ven bava omer en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad velashshear osin chagora gavoha asara tefachim
Eruvin 2:5: Veod amar rabbi yehuda ven bava hagginna vehakkarpef shehen shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim mukkefet gader gavoha asara tefachim metaltelin betochah uvilvad sheyehe vah shomera o vet dira o shettehe semucha lair rabbi yehuda omer afillu en bah ella vor veshiach umara metaltelin betochah rabbi akiva omer afillu en bah achat mikkal ellu metaltelin betochah uvilvad sheyehe vah shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim rabbi eliezer omer im haya arkah yater al rachbah afillu amma achat en metaltelin betochah rabbi yose omer afillu arkah pi shenayim berachbah metaltelin betochah
Eruvin 2:6: Amar rabbi illaiy shamati merabbi eliezer vaafillu hi kevet kor vechen shamati mimmennu anshe chatzer sheshshachach achad mehen velo erev beto asur millehachnis ulhotzi lo aval lahem muttar vechen shamati mimmennu sheyyotzin beakravnim befesach vechizzarti al kal talmidav uvikkashti li chaver velo matzati
Eruvin 3:1: Bakkol mearvin umishtattefim chutz min hammayim umin hammelach vehakkol nikkach bechesef maaser chutz min hammayim umin hammelach hannoder min hammazon muttar bemayim uvmelach mearvin lenazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma sumchos omer bechullin ulchohen bevet happeras rabbi yehuda omer afillu bevet hakkevarot mippene sheyyachol lelech lachotz veleechol
Eruvin 3:2: Mearvin bidmay uvmaaser rishon shenittela terumato uvmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehakkohanim bechalla uvitruma aval lo vetevel velo vemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato velo vemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu hashsholeach eruvo beyad cheresh shote vekatan o veyad mi sheeno mode vaeruv eno eruv veim amar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu hare ze eruv
Eruvin 3:3: Netano veilan lemala measara tefachim en eruvo eruv lematta measara tefachim eruvo eruv netano bevor afillu amok mea amma eruvo eruv netano verosh hakkane o verosh hakkundas bizman shehu talush venautz afillu gavoha mea amma hare ze eruv netano vemigdal veavad hammafteach hare ze eruv rabbi eliezer omer im eno yodea shehammafteach bimkomo eno eruv
Eruvin 3:4: Nitgalgel chutz lattechum venafal alav gal o nisraf o teruma venitmet mibbeod yom eno eruv mishshechashecha hare ze eruv im safek rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim hare ze chammar gammal rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim sefek eruv kasher amar rabbi yose avtolmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim al sefek eruv shekkasher
Eruvin 3:5: Matne adam al eruvo veomer im bau goyim min hammizrach eruvi lammaarav min hammaarav eruvi lammizrach im bau mikkan umikkan limkom sheertze elech lo vau lo mikkan velo mikkan hareni chivne iri im ba chacham min hammizrach eruvi lammizrach min hammaarav eruvi lammaarav ba lechan ulchan limkom sheertze elech lo lechan velo lechan hareni chivne iri rabbi yehuda omer im haya echad mehen rabbo holech etzel rabbo veim hau shenehem rabbotav limkom sheyyirtze yelech
Eruvin 3:6: Rabbi eliezer omer yom tov hassamuch leshabbat ben millefaneha uven milleachareha mearev adam shene eruvin veomer eruvi harishon lammizrach vehashsheni lammaarav harishon lammaarav vehashsheni lammizrach eruvi harishon vehashsheni kivne iri eruvi hashsheni veharishon kivne iri vachachamim omrim mearev leruach achat o eno mearev kal ikkar o mearev lishne yamim o eno mearev kal ikkar ketzad yaase molicho varishon umachshich alav venotlo uva lo bashsheni machshich alav veochlo venimtza mistakker bahalichato umistakker beeruvo neechal barishon eruvo larishon veeno eruv lashsheni amar lahem rabbi eliezer modim attem li shehen shette kedushshot
Eruvin 3:7: Rabbi yehuda omer rosh hashshana shehaya yare shemma titabber mearev adam shene eruvin veomer eruvi varishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach eruvi barishon uvashsheni kivne iri eruvi bashsheni uvarishon kivne iri velo hodu lo chachamim
Eruvin 3:8: Veod amar rabbi yehuda matne adam al hakkalkala beom tov rishon veochlah bashsheni vechen betza shennolda varishon teachel bashsheni velo hodu lo chachamim
Eruvin 3:9: Rabbi dosa ven harkinas omer haover lifne hatteva beom tov shel rosh hashshana omer hachalitzenu elohenu et yom rosh chodesh hazze im hayyom im lemachar ulmachar hu omer im hayyom im emesh velo hodu lo chachamim
Eruvin 4:1: Mi shehotziuhu goyim o ruach raa en lo ella arba ammot hecheziruhu keillu lo yatza holichuhu leir acheret netanuhu vedir o vesahar rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim mehallech et kullah rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim en lo ella arba ammot maase shebbau mipperandisin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya hillechu et kullah rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot sheratzu lehachamir al atzman
Eruvin 4:2: Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha amru lo lerabban gamliel ma anu lered amar lahen muttar attem shekkevar hayiti mistakkel vehayinu vetoch hattechum ad shello chashecha
Eruvin 4:3: Mi sheyyatza virshut veamru lo kevar naasa maase yesh lo alpayim amma lechal ruach im haya vetoch hattechum keillu lo yatza shekkal hayyotzim lehatztzil chozrin limkoman
Eruvin 4:4: Mi sheyyashav badderech veamad veraa vahare hu samuch lair hoil velo hayeta chavanato lechach lo yikkanes divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer yikkanes amar rabbi yehuda maase haya venichnas rabbi tarfon belo mitkaven
Eruvin 4:5: Mi sheyyashen badderech velo yada shechashecha yesh lo alpayim amma lechal ruach divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri vachachamim omrim en lo ella arba ammot rabbi eliezer omer vehu veemtzaan rabbi yehuda omer leeze ruach sheyyirtze yelech umode rabbi yehuda sheim berer lo sheeno yachol lachazor bo
Eruvin 4:6: Hau shenayim miktzat ammotav shel ze betoch ammotav shel ze meviin veochlin baemtza uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero hau shelosha vehaemtzai muvla benehen hu muttar immahen vehen muttarin immo ushnayim hachitzonim asurim ze im ze amar rabbi shimon lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim ervu shettehen im haemtzait hi mutteret immahem vehen muttarot immah ushtayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo
Eruvin 4:7: Mi shebba vadderech vechashcha lo vehaya makkir ilan o gader veamar shevitati tachtav lo amar kelum shevitati veikkaro mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikkaro alpayim amma umeikkaro vead beto alpayim amma nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma
Eruvin 4:8: Im eno makkir o sheeno vaki vahalacha veamar shevitati vimkomi zacha lo mekomo alpayim amma lechal ruach agullot divre rabbi chanina ven antignos vachachamim omrim merubbaot ketavla merubbaat kede sheyehe niskar lazzaviyyot
Eruvin 4:9: Vezo hi sheamru heani mearev beraglav amar rabbi meir anu en lanu ella ani rabbi yehuda omer echad ani veechad ashir lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir shello yetze viarev beraglav
Eruvin 4:10: Mi sheyyatza lelech beir shemmearvin bah vehecheziro chavero hu muttar lelech vechal bene hair asurin divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer kol shehu yachol learev velo erev hare ze chammar gammal
Eruvin 4:11: Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum afillu amma achat lo yikkanes rabbi eliezer omer shettayim yikkanes shalosh lo yikkanes mi shehechshich chutz lattechum afillu amma achat lo yikkanes rabbi shimon omer afillu chamesh esre ammot yikkanes sheen hammashochot mematztzin et hammiddot mippene hattoin
Eruvin 5:1: Ketzad meabberin et hearim bayit nichnas bayit yotze pagum nichnas pagum yotze hau sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim ugsharim unfashot sheyyesh bahen bet dira motziin et hammidda chenegdan veosin otah kemin tavla merubbaat kede sheyehe niskar et hazzaviyyot
Eruvin 5:2: Notnin karpef lair divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo amru karpef ella ven shette ayarot im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim velazo shivim amma veshirayim ose karpef lishtehen lihotan keechat
Eruvin 5:3: Vechen shelosha chefarim hammeshullashin im yesh ben shenayim hachitzonim mea vearbaim veechad ushlish asa emtzai et shelashtan lihotan keechad
Eruvin 5:4: En moddin ella vechevel shel chamishshim amma lo fachot velo yoter velo yimdod ella cheneged libbo haya moded vehiggia legaye o legader mavlio vechozer lemiddato higgia lehar mavlio vechozer lemiddato uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum im eno yachol lehavlio bazo amar rabbi dostay bar rabbi yannay mishshum rabbi meir shamati shemmekadderin beharim
Eruvin 5:5: En moddin ella min hammumche ribba lemakom echad umiet lemakom acher shomin limkom sheribba ribba leechad umiet leacher shomin lamrubbe afillu eved afillu shifcha neemanin lomar ad kan techum shabbat shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir ella lehakel
Eruvin 5:6: Ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim mearvin et kullah veshel rabbim venaaset shel yachid en mearvin et kullah ella im ken asa chutza lah keir chadasha shebbihuda sheyyesh bah chamishshim diurim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim
Eruvin 5:7: Mi shehaya vammizrach veamar livno arev li vammaarav bammaarav veamar livno arev li vammizrach im yesh hemennu ulveto alpayim ammot uleruvo yoter mikkan muttar leveto veasur leeruvo leeruvo alpayim amma ulveto yoter mikkan asur leveto umuttar leeruvo hannoten et eruvo veibburah shel ir lo asa velo chelum netano chutz lattechum afillu amma achat ma shenniskar hu mafsid
Eruvin 5:8: Anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kal ir ketanna veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kal ir gedola ketzad mi shehaya veir gedola venatan et eruvo veir ketanna beir ketanna venatan et eruvo veir gedola mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma verabbi akiva omer en lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma
Eruvin 5:9: Amar lahen rabbi akiva i attem modim li venoten eruvo vimara sheen lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma amru lo ematay bizman sheen bah diurin aval yesh bah diurin mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma nimtza kal tochah meal gabbah velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim sheafillu sof middato kale vimara
