Eruvin 6:1: Haddar im hannachri vechatzer o im mi sheeno mode vaeruv hare ze oser alav divre rabbi meir rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer leolam eno oser ad sheyehu shene yisreelim osrin ze al ze
Eruvin 6:2: Amar rabban gamliel maase vitzdoki echad shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim veamar lanu abba maharu vehotziu et kal hakkelim lammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem rabbi yehuda omer belashon acher maharu vaasu tzarchechem bammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem

Ketubot 1:6: Hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim hi omeret mishsheerastani neenasti venistachafa sadecha vehalla omer lo chi ella ad shello erastich vehaya mikkachi mekkach taut rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet rabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo vechezkat beula ad shello titares vehitattu ad shettavi reaya lidvareha

Ketubot 1:8: Rauha medabberet im echad bashshuk amru lah ma tivo shel ze ish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo vechezkat beula lenatin ulmamzer ad shettavi reaya lidvareha

Nazir 1:4: Hareni nazir kisar roshi vechaafar haaretz uchchol hayyam hare ze nezir olam umgalleach achat lishloshim yom rabbi omer en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom veezehu shemmegalleach achat lishloshim yom haomer hare alay nezirut kisar roshi vechaafar haaretz uchchol hayyam
Nazir 1:5: Hareni nazir melo habbayit o melo hakkuppa bodkin oto im amar achat gedola nazarti nazir sheloshim yom veim amar setam nazarti roin et hakkuppa keillu hi melea chardal venazir kal yamav
Nazir 1:6: Hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni omdin kamma yamim mikkan ad makom peloni im pachot mishsheloshim yom nazir sheloshim yom veim lav nazir keminyan hayyamim
Nazir 1:7: Hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma mone nezirut keminyan yemot hachamma amar rabbi yehuda maase haya kevan shehishlim met
Nazir 2:1: Hareni nazir min haggerogarot umin haddevela bet shammay omrim nazir uvet hillel omrim eno nazir amar rabbi yehuda af kesheamru vet shammay lo amru ella veomer hare hen alay karban
Nazir 2:2: Amar amra fara zo hareni nezira im omedet ani amar haddelet hazze hareni nazir im niftach ani bet shammay omrim nazir uvet hillel omrim eno nazir amar rabbi yehuda af kesheamru vet shammay lo amru ella veomer hare fara zo alay karban im omedet hi
Nazir 2:3: Mazgu lo et hakkos veamar hareni nazir mimmenu hare ze nazir maase veishsha achat shehayeta shikkora umazgu lah et hakkos veamra hareni nezira mimmennu amru chachamim lo nitkavvena ella lomar hare hu alay karban
Nazir 2:4: Hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umittamme lemetim hare ze nazir veasur bechullan yodea ani sheyyesh nezirut aval eni yodea shehannazir asur beyyayin hare ze asur verabbi shimon mattir yodea ani shehannazir asur beyyayin aval savur hayiti shechachamim mattirim li mippene sheen ani yachol lichot ella veyyayin o mippene sheani kover et hammetim hare ze muttar verabbi shimon oser
Nazir 2:5: Hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach nazir im hau fikkechim megallechim ze et ze veim lav megallechim nezirim acherim
Nazir 2:6: Hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir ze megalleach nazir shalem veze megalleach nazir shalem divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ze megalleach chatzi nazir veze megalleach chatzi nazir
Nazir 2:7: Hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ven venolad lo ven hare ze nazir nolad lo vat tumtum veanderoginos eno nazir im amar kesheere kesheyyihye li valad afillu nolad lo vat tumtum veanderoginos hare ze nazir
Nazir 2:8: Hippila ishto eno nazir rabbi shimon omer yomar im haya ven keyama hare ani nezir chova veim lav hare ani nezir nedava chazra veyalda hare ze nazir rabbi shimon omer yomar im harishon ben keyama harishon chova vezo nedava veim lav harishon nedava vezo chova
Nazir 2:9: Hareni nazir venazir kesheyyihye li ven hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven mashlim et shello veachar kach mone et shel beno hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ven venazir hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven manniach et shello umone et shel beno veachar kach mashlim et shello
Nazir 2:10: Hareni nazir lichsheyehe li ven venazir mea yom nolad lo ven ad shivim lo hifsid kelum leachar shivim soter shivim sheen tiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom
Nazir 3:1: Mi sheamar hareni nazir megalleach yom sheloshim veechad veim gillach leom sheloshim yatza hareni nazir sheloshim yom im gillach leom sheloshim lo yatza
Nazir 3:2: Mi shennazar shette neziriyyot megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad veet hashsheniyya yom shishshim veechad veim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad yatza vezo edut heid rabbi pappeyas al mi shennazar shette neziriyyot sheim gillach et harishona sheloshim yom megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim veim gillach leom shishshim chaser echad yatza sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan
Nazir 3:3: Mi sheamar hareni nazir nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva hareni nazir sheloshim yom nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol
Nazir 3:4: Hareni nazir mea yom nitma yom mea soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella sheloshim nitma yom mea veechad soter sheloshim yom rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva
Nazir 3:5: Mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot afillu haya sham sheloshim yom en olin lo min hamminyan veeno mevi karban tuma yatza venichnas olin lo min hamminyan umevi karban tuma rabbi eliezer omer lo vo vayyom shenneemar vmdvr v vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ad sheyyihu lo yamim rishonim
Nazir 3:6: Mi shennazar nezirut harbe vehishlim et neziruto veachar kach ba laaretz bet shammay omrim nazir sheloshim yom uvet hillel omrim nazir battechilla maase vehilni hammalka shehalach benah lammilchama veamra im yavo veni min hammilchama veshalom ehe nezira sheva shanim uva venah min hammilchama vehayeta nezira sheva shanim uvsof sheva shanim alta laaretz vehoruha vet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot uvsof sheva shanim nitmet venimtzet nezira esrim veachat shana amar rabbi yehuda lo hayeta nezira ella arba esre shana
Nazir 3:7: Mi shehau shette chitte edim meidot oto ellu meidim shennazar shettayim veellu meidim shennazar chamesh bet shammay omrim nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal chamesh shettayim sheyehe nazir shettayim
Nazir 4:1: Mi sheamar hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vaani kullam nezirin huttar harishon hutteru chullan huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullam asurin amar hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar pi chefiv usari chisaro hare ze nazir hareni nazir veshama ishto veamra vaani mefer et shellah veshello kayyam hareni nezira veshama balah veamar vaani eno yachol lehafer
Nazir 4:2: Hareni nazir vaatte veamra amen mefer et shellah veshello kayyam hareni nezira vaatta veamar amen eno yachol lehafer
Nazir 4:3: Haishsha shennadra venazir vehayeta shota veyayin umittammea lemetim hare zo sofeget et haarbaim hefer lah balah vehi lo yada shehefer lah balah vehayeta shota veyayin umittammea lemetim enah sofeget et haarbaim rabbi yehuda omer im enah sofeget et haarbaim tispog makkat mardut
Nazir 4:4: Haishsha shennadra venazir vehifrisha et behemtah veachar kach hefer lah balah im shello hayeta vehemtah tetze vetire vaeder veim shellah hayeta vehemtah hachattat tamut veola tikrav ola vehashshelamim yikrevu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lachem hau lah maot setumim yippelu lindava maot meforashim deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach lo nehenim velo moalim bahen deme ola yaviu ola umoalim bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lachem
Nazir 4:5: Nizrak aleha echad min haddamim eno yachol lehafer rabbi akiva omer afillu nishchata aleha achat mikkal habbehemot eno yachol lehafer bamme devarim amurim betiglachat hattahora aval betiglachat hattuma yafer shehu yachol lomar i efshi veishsha menuvalet rabbi omer af betiglachat hattahora yafer shehu yachol lomar i efshi beishsha megullachat
Nazir 4:6: Haish maddir et beno venazir veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir ketzad gillach o sheggillechuhu kerovav micha o shemmichu kerovav hayeta lo vehema mufreshet hachattat tamut veola tikrav ola vehashshelamim yikrevu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lachem hau lo maot setumin yippelu lindava maot meforashin deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lachem
Nazir 4:7: Haish megalleach al nezirut aviv veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha ketzad mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish maot setumim al neziruto umet veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagallach al meot abba amar rabbi yose hare ellu yippelu lindava en ze megalleach al nezirut aviv ezehu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot setumim linziruto umet zehu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv
Nazir 5:1: Bet shammay omrim hekdesh taut hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh ketzad amar shor shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hare hu hekdesh veyatza lavan bet shammay omrim hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh
Nazir 5:2: Dinar zahav sheyyaale veyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh veala shel kesef bet shammay omrim hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh chavit shel yayin shettaale veyadi rishona hare hi hekdesh vealta shel shemen bet shammay omrim hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh
Nazir 5:3: Mi shennadar benazir venishal lechacham vaasaro mone mishshaa shennadar nishal lechacham vehittiro hayeta lo vehema mufreshet tetze vetire vaeder amru vet hillel levet shammay i attem modim baze shehu hekdesh taut shettetze vetire vaeder amru lahen bet shammay i attem modim bemi shettaa vekara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shehu mekuddash amru lahem bet hillel lo hashshevet kiddesho uma illu taa vehinniach et hashshevet al shemini veal shenem asar shemma asa chelum ella katuv shekkiddesh et haasiri hu kiddesh et hatteshii veet achad asar
Nazir 5:4: Mi shennadar benazir vehalach lehavi et behemto umtzaah shennigneva im ad shello nigneva vehemto nazar hare ze nazir veim mishshennigneva vehemto nazar eno nazir vezo taut taa nachum hammadi keshealu nezirim min haggola umatzu vet hammikdash charev amar lahem nachum hammadi illu heyitem yodim shebbet hammikdash charev heyitem nozrim amru lo lo vehittiran nachum hammadi uchshebba haddavar etzel chachamim amru lo kol shennazar ad shello charav bet hammikdash nazir umishshecharav bet hammikdash eno nazir
Nazir 5:5: Hau mehallechin badderech veechad ba chenegdan amar echad mehen hareni nazir shezze feloni veechad amar hareni nazir sheen ze feloni hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir sheshshenechem nezirim shekkullechem nezirim bet shammay omrim kullam nezirim uvet hillel omrim eno nazir ella mi shello nitkayemu devarav verabbi tarfon omer en echad mehem nazir
Nazir 5:6: Hirtia laachorav eno nazir rabbi shimon omer yomar im haya chidvaray hareni nezir chova veim lav hareni nezir nedava
Nazir 5:7: Raa et hakkoy veamar hareni nazir shezze chayya hareni nazir shezze eno chayya hareni nazir shezze vehema hareni nazir sheen ze vehema hareni nazir shezze chayya uvhema hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo vehema hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir hareni nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir hareni nazir shekkullechem nezirim hare chullam nezirim
Nazir 6:1: Shelosha minin asurin bannazir hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggafen vechal hayyotze min haggefen mitztarfin ze im ze veeno chayyav ad sheyyochal min haanavim kazzayit mishna rishona ad sheyyishte reviit yayin rabbi akiva omer afillu shara fitto veyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kazzayit chayyav
Nazir 6:2: Vechayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo veal haanavim bifne atzman veal hachartzannim bifne atzman veal hazzaggim bifne atzman rabbi elazar ben azarya omer eno chayyav ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezaggan ellu hen chartzannim veellu hen zaggim hachartzannim ellu hachitzonim hazzaggim ellu happenimim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer shello tite kezog shel behema hachitzon zog vehappenimi inbal
Nazir 6:3: Setam nezirut sheloshim yom gillach o sheggillechuhu listim soter sheloshim yom nazir sheggillach ben bezug ben betaar o shessifsef kal shehu chayyav nazir chofef umfaspes aval lo sorek rabbi yishmael omer lo yachof baadama mippene shemmashsheret et hassear
Nazir 6:4: Nazir shehaya shote yayin kal hayyom eno chayyav ella echat amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kal achat veechat haya megalleach kal hayyom eno chayyav ella echat amru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach vehu megalleach chayyav al kal achat veechat haya mittamme lemetim kal hayyom eno chayyav ella echat amru lo al tittamma al tittamma vehu mittamme chayyav al kal achat veechat
Nazir 6:5: Shelosha minin asurin bannazir hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggafen chomer battuma uvattiglachat mibbayyotze min haggefen shehattuma vehattiglachat sotrin vehayyotze min haggefen eno soter chomer bayyotze min haggefen mibbattuma uvattiglachat shehayyotze min haggefen lo huttar mikkelalo vetuma vetiglachat hutteru mikkelalan betiglachat mitzva uvmet mitzva vechomer battuma mibbattiglachat shehattuma soteret et hakkol vechayyavin aleha karban vetiglachat enah soteret ella sheloshim yom veen chayyavin aleha karban
Nazir 6:6: Tiglachat hattuma ketzad haya mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umgalleach bashshevii umevi karbenotav bashshemini veim gillach bashshemini mevi karbenotav bo vayyom divre rabbi akiva amar lo rabbi tarfon ma ben ze lammetzora amar lo ze tahorato teluya veyamav umtzora tahorato teluya vetiglachto veeno mevi karban ella im ken haya meorav shamesh
Nazir 6:7: Tiglachat hattahora ketzad haya mevi shalosh behemot chattat ola ushlamim veshochet et hashshelamim umgalleach alehem divre rabbi yehuda rabbi elazar omer lo haya megalleach ella al hachattat shehachattat kodemet bechal makom veim gillach al achat mishshelashtan yatza
Nazir 6:8: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hevi shalosh behemot velo feresh haruya lechattat tikrav chattat leola tikrav ola lishlamim tikrav shelamim haya notel sear rosh nizro umshalleach tachat haddud veim gillach bammedina haya meshalleach tachat haddud bamme devarim amurim betiglachat hattahora aval betiglachat hattuma lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud rabbi meir omer hakkol meshallechin tachat haddud chutz min hattame shebbammedina bilvad
Nazir 6:9: Haya mevashshel et hashshelamim o sholkan hakkohen notel et hazzeroa beshela min haayil vechallat matztza achat min hassal urkik matztza echad venoten al kappe hannazir umnifan veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulhittamme lemetim rabbi shimon omer kevan shennizrak alav echad min haddamim huttar hannazir lishtot beyayin ulhittamme lemetim
Nazir 6:10: Gillach al hazzevach venimtza fasul tiglachto fesula uzvachav lo alu lo gillach al hachattat shello lishmah veachar kach hevi karbenotav lishman tiglachto fesula uzvachav lo alu lo gillach al haola o al hashshelamim shello lishman veachar kach hevi karbenotav lishman tiglachto fesula uzvachav lo alu lo rabbi shimon omer oto hazzevach lo ala lo aval shear zevachim alu lo veim gillach al shelashtan venimtza echad mehen kasher tiglachto cheshera veyavi shear hazzevachim
Nazir 6:11: Mi shennizrak alav echad min haddamim venitma rabbi eliezer omer soter et hakkol vachachamim omrim yavi shear karbenotav veyithar amru lo maase vemiryam hattarmodit shennizrak aleha echad min haddamim uvau veamru lah al bittah shehayeta mesukkenet vehalcha umtzatah shemmeta veamru chachamim tavi shear karbenoteha vetithar
Nazir 7:1: Kohen gadol venazir enan mittammein likrovehen aval mittammein lemet mitzva hau mehallechin badderech umatzu met mitzva rabbi eliezer omer yittamma chohen gadol veal yittamma nazir vachachamim omrim yittamma nazir veal yittamma chohen gadol amar lahem rabbi eliezer yittamma chohen sheeno mevi karban al tumato veal yittamma nazir shehu mevi karban al tumato amru lo yittamma nazir sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam veal yittamma chohen shekkedushshato kedushshat olam
Nazir 7:2: Al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach al hammet veal kazzayit min hammet veal kazzayit netzel veal melo tarvad rakav al hashshidra veal haggulgolet veal ever min hammet veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alav basar karauy veal chatzi kav atzamot veal chatzi log dam al maggaan veal massaan veal aholan veal etzem kasseora al maggao veal massao al ellu hannazir megalleach umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii vesoter et hakkodmin veeno matchil limnot ella ad sheyyithar umevi et karbenotav
Nazir 7:3: Aval hassechachot vehapperaot uvet happeras veeretz haammim vehaggolel vehaddofek urviit dam veohel verova atzamot vechelim hannogim bemet vime safro vime gamro al ellu en hannazir megalleach umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii veeno soter et hakkodmin umatchil umone miyyad vekarban en lo beemet amru yeme hazzav vehazzava vime hesgero shel metzora hare ellu olin lo
Nazir 7:4: Amar rabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua kal tuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash vechal tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha en chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash amar rabbi meir lo tehe zo kalla min hashsheretz amar rabbi akiva danti lifne rabbi eliezer ma im etzem kasseora sheeno metamme adam beohel hannazir megalleach al maggao veal massao reviit dam shehu metamme adam beohel eno din sheyehe hannazir megalleach al maggaah veal massaah amar li ma ze akiva en danin kan mikkal vachomer uchshebbati vehirtzeti et haddevarim lifne rabbi yehoshua amar li yafe amarta ella ken amru halacha
Nazir 8:1: Shene nezirim sheamar lahen echad raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea eze mikkem megallechin umviin karban tuma vekarban tahora veomer im ani hu hattame karban tuma shelli vekarban tahora shellecha veim ani hu hattahor karban tahora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha vesofrin sheloshim yom umviin karban tahora veomer im ani hu hattame karban tuma shelli vekarban tahora shellecha veze karban tahorati veim ani hu hattahor karban tahora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha veze karban tahoratcha met echad mehen amar rabbi yehoshua yevakkesh echad min hashshuk sheyyiddor kenegdo venazir veomer im tame hayiti hare atta nazir miyyad veim tahor hayiti hare atta nazir achar sheloshim yom vesofrin sheloshim yom umviin karban tuma vekarban tahora veomer im ani hu hattame karban tuma shelli vekarban tahora shelleche veim ani hu hattahor karban tahora shelli vekarban tuma besafek vesofrin sheloshim yom umviin karban tahora veomer im ani hu hattame karban tuma shelli vekarban tahora shellecha veze karban tahorati veim ani hu hattahor karban tahora shelli vekarban tuma besafek vezehu karban tahoratcha amar lo ven zoma umi shomea lo sheyyiddor kenegdo venazir ella mevi chattat haof veolat behema veomer im tame hayiti hachattat mechovati vehaola nedava veim tahor hayiti haola mechovati vehachattat besafek vesofer sheloshim yom umevi karban tahora veomer im tame hayiti haola harishona nedava vezo chova veim tahor hayiti haola harishona chova vezo nedava veze shear karbani amar rabbi yehoshua nimtza ze mevi karbenotav lachatzaim aval hodu lo chachamim leven zoma
Nazir 8:2: Nazir shehaya tame vesafek umuchlat besafek ochel bakkadashim achar shishshim yom veshote yayin umittamme lemetim achar mea veesrim yom shettiglachat hannega docha tiglachat hannazir bizman shehu vadday aval bizman shehu safek enah docha
Nazir 9:1: Haggoyim en lahem nezirut nashim vaavadim yesh lahem nezirut chomer bannashim mibbaavadim shehu chofe et avdo veeno chofe et ishto chomer baavadim mibbannashim shehu mefer nidre ishto veeno mefer nidre avdo hefer leishto hefer olamit hefer leavdo yatza lecherut mashlim neziruto avar mikkeneged panav rabbi meir omer lo yishte verabbi yose omer yishte
Nazir 9:2: Nazir sheggillach venoda lo shehu tame im tuma yedua soter veim tumat hattehom eno soter im ad shello gillach ben kach uven kach soter ketzad yarad litbol bimara venimtza met tzaf al pi hammeara tame nimtza meshukka bekarka hammeara yarad lehaker tahor littaher mittumat met tame shechezkat tame tame vechezkat tahor tahor sheraglayim laddavar

Bava Metzia 7:2: Veellu ochlin min hattora haose vimchubbar lakkarka bishat gemar melacha uvtalush min hakkarka ad shello nigmera melachto bedavar sheggiddulo min haaretz veellu sheen ochlin haose vimchubbar lakkarka beshaa sheen gemar melacha uvtalush min hakkarka meachar shennigmera melachto uvdavar sheen giddulo min haaretz
Bava Metzia 7:3: Haya ose veyadav aval lo veraglav beraglav aval lo veyadav afillu vichtefo hare ze ochel rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaase veyadav uvraglav
Bava Metzia 7:4: Haya ose vitenim lo yochal baanavim baanavim lo yochal bitenim aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel vechullan lo amru ella vishat melacha aval mishshum hashev aveda labbealim amru poalim ochlin bahalichatan meumman leumman uvachaziratan min haggat uvachamor keshehi foraket
Bava Metzia 7:5: Ochel poel kishshut afillu vedinar vechotevet afillu vedinar rabbi elazar chisma omer lo yochal poel yater al secharo vachachamim mattirin aval melammedin et haadam shello yehe raavtan vihe sotem et happetach befanav
Bava Metzia 7:6: Kotzetz adam al yede atzmo al yede veno uvitto haggedolim al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim al yede ishto mippene sheyyesh bahen daat aval eno kotzetz al yede veno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim velo al yede vehemto mippene sheen bahen daat
Bava Metzia 7:7: Hassocher et happoalim laasot beneta revai shello hare ellu lo yochlu im lo hodian pode umaachilan nitparsu iggulav nitpattechu chaviyyotav hare ellu lo yochlu im lo hodian measser umaachilan
Bava Metzia 7:8: Shomre ferot ochlin mehilchot medina aval lo min hattora arbaa shomrin hen shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol venose sachar vehassocher nishbaim al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta umshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva
Bava Metzia 7:9: Zeev echad eno ones shene zeevim ones rabbi yehuda omer bishat mishlachat zeevim af zeev echad ones shene chelavim eno ones yaddua habbavli omer mishshum rabbi meir meruach achat eno ones mishshette ruchot ones hallistim hare ze ones haari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash hare ze ones ematay bizman shebbau mealehen aval im holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim eno ones
Bava Metzia 7:10: Meta chedarkah hare ze ones siggefah vameta eno ones alta lerashe tzukin venafla vameta hare ze ones heelah lerashe tzukin venafla vameta eno ones matne shomer chinnam lihot patur mishshevua vehashshoel lihot patur milleshallem nose sachar vehassocher lihot peturin mishshevua umilleshallem
Bava Metzia 7:11: Kal hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao vatel vechal tenay sheyyesh maase vitchillato tenao vatel vechal sheefshar lo lekayemo vesofo vehitna alav mittechillato tenao kayyam
Bava Metzia 8:1: Hashshoel et happara veshaal bealeha immah o sachar bealeha imma shaal habbealim o secharan ulachar kach shaal et happara vameta patur shenneemar shmt chv im bealav immo lo yeshallem aval shaal et happara veachar kach shaal et habbealim o secharan vameta chayyav shenneemar shm bealav en immo shallem yeshallem
Bava Metzia 8:2: Hashshoel et happara shealah chatzi hayyom uscharah chatzi hayyom shealah hayyom uscharah lemachar sachar achat veshaal achat vameta hammashil omer sheula meta bayyom shehayeta sheula meta bashshaa shehayeta sheula meta vehalla omer eni yodea chayyav hassocher omer sechura meta bayyom shehayeta sechura meta bashshaa shehayeta sechura meta vehalla omer eni yodea patur ze omer sheula veze omer sechura yishshava hassocher shessechura meta ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachaloku
Bava Metzia 8:3: Hashshoel et happara veshillechah lo beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho o veyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho shel shoel vameta patur amar lo hashshoel shallechah li beyad beni beyad avdi beyad sheluchi o beyad bincha beyad avdecha beyad sheluchacha o sheamar lo hammashil hareni meshallechah lecha beyad beni beyad avdi beyad sheluchi o beyad bincha beyad avdecha beyad sheluchacha veamar lo hashshoel shallach veshillechah vameta chayyav vechen beshaa shemmachazirah
Bava Metzia 8:4: Hammachalif para bachamor veyalda vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda ze omer ad shello macharti veze omer mishshellakachti yachaloku hau lo shene avadim echad gadol veechad katan vechen shette sadot achat gedola veachat ketanna hallokeach omer gadol lakachti vehalla omer eni yodea zacha vaggadol hammocher omer katan macharti vehalla omer eni yodea en lo ella katan ze omer gadol veze omer katan yishshava hammocher shehakkatan machar ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachaloku
Bava Metzia 8:5: Hammocher zetav leetzim veasu pachot merviit lisa hare ellu shel baal hazzetim asu reviit lisa ze omer zetay giddelu veze omer artzi giddela yachaloku shataf nahar zetav untanam letoch sede chavero ze omer zetay giddelu veze omer artzi giddela yachaloku
Bava Metzia 8:6: Hammaskir bayit lachavero bimot haggeshamim eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach bimot hachamma sheloshim yom uvakkerakkim echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim shenem asar chodesh uvachanuot echad ayarot veechad kerakkim shenem asar chodesh rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chanut shel nachtomim veshel tzabbaim shalosh shanim
Bava Metzia 8:7: Hammaskir bayit lachavero hammaskir chayyav baddelet banneger uvmanul uvchal davar shemmaase umman aval davar sheeno maase umman hassocher osehu hazzevel shel baal habbayit veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad
Bava Metzia 8:8: Hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana nitabbera hashshana nitabbera lassocher hiskir lo lechodashim nitabbera hashshana nitabbera lammaskir maase vetzippori beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zahav leshana middinar zahav lechodesh uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose veamru yachaloku et chodesh haibbur
Bava Metzia 8:9: Hammaskir bayit lachavero venafal chayyav lehaamid lo bayit haya katan lo yaasennu gadol gadol lo yaasennu katan echad lo yaasennu shenayim shenayim lo yaasennu echad lo yifchot mehachallonot velo yosif alehen ella middaat shenehem
Bava Metzia 9:1: Hamkabbel sade mechavero mekom shennahagu liktzor yiktzor laakor yaakor lacharosh acharav yacharosh hakkol keminhag hammedina keshem shecholkin battevua kach cholkin batteven uvakkash keshem shecholkin bayyayin kach cholkin bazzemorot uvakkanim ushnehem mesappekin et hakkanim
Bava Metzia 9:2: Hamkabbel sade mechavero vehi vet hashshelachin o vet hailan yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan eno menakke lo min chachoro im amar lo chachor li sede vet hashshelachin ze o sede vet hailan ze yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan menakke lo min chachoro
Bava Metzia 9:3: Hamkabbel sade mechavero vehovirah shamin otah kamma reuya laasot venoten lo shekkach kotev lo im ovir velo aaved ashallem bemetva
Bava Metzia 9:4: Hamkabbel sade mechavero velo ratza lenakkesh veamar lo ma ichpat lecha hoil vaani noten lecha chachorah en shomin lo mippene sheyyachol lomar lo lemachar atta yotze mimmenna umaala lefanay asavim
Bava Metzia 9:5: Hamkabbel sade mechavero velo asta im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri chayyav letappel bah amar rabbi yehuda ma kitzba vakkeri ella im yesh bah kede nefila
Bava Metzia 9:6: Hamkabbel sade mechavero vaachalah chagav o nishdefa im makkat medina hi menakke lo min chachoro im eno makkat medina eno menakke lo min chachoro rabbi yehuda omer im kibbelah hemennu vemaot ben kach uven kach eno menakke lo mechachoro
Bava Metzia 9:7: Hamkabbel sade mechavero baasara kor chittim leshana lakta noten lo mittochah hau chitteha yafot lo yomar lo hareni lokeach min hashshuk ella noten lo mittochah
Bava Metzia 9:8: Hamkabbel sade mechavero lezarah seorim lo yizraenna chittim chittim yizraenna seorim rabban shimon ben gamliel oser tevua lo yizraenna kitnit kitnit yizraenna tevua rabban shimon ben gamliel oser
Bava Metzia 9:9: Hamkabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot lo yizraenna fishtan veen lo vekorat shikma kibbelah hemennu lesheva shanim shana rishona yizraenna fishtan veyesh lo vekorat shikma
Bava Metzia 9:10: Hamkabbel sade mechavero leshavua achat bishva meot zuz hashsheviit min hamminyan kibbelah hemennu sheva shanim bishva meot zuz en hashsheviit min hamminyan
Bava Metzia 9:11: Sechir yom gove chal hallayela sechir layela gove chal hayyom sechir shaot gove chal hallayela vechal hayyom sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua yatza vayyom gove chal hayyom yatza vallayela gove chal hallayela vechal hayyom
Bava Metzia 9:12: Echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim yesh bo mishshum dvrm kad beomo titten secharo veyesh bo mishshum vkr yt lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker ematay bizman shettevao lo tevao eno over alav himchahu etzel chenvani o etzel shulchani eno over alav sachir bizmanno nishba venotel avar zemanno eno nishba venotel im yesh edim shettevao hare ze nishba venotel ger toshav yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo veen bo mishshum lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker
Bava Metzia 9:13: Hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din velo yikkanes leveto littol mashkono shenneemar dvrm kad bachutz taamod hau lo shene chelim notel echad umanniach echad umachazir et hakkar ballayela veet hammacharesha vayyom veim met eno machazir leorshav rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af leatzmo eno machazir ella ad sheloshim yom umishsheloshim yom ulhallan mochran bevet din almana ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira en memashkenin otah shenneemar dvrm kad velo tachavol beged almana hachovel et harechayim over belo taase vechayyav mishshum shene chelim shenneemar shm lo yachavol rechayim varachev velo rechayim varechev bilvad amru ella chal davar sheosin bo ochel nefesh shenneemar dvrm kad ki nefesh hu chovel
Bava Metzia 10:1: Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu shenehem cholkim baetzim uvaavanim uveafar veroim elu avanim haruot lehishtabber im haya echad mehen makkir miktzat avanav notlan veolot lo min hacheshbon
Bava Metzia 10:2: Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim nifchata haaliyya veen baal habbayit rotze letakken hare vaal haaliyya yored vedar lematta ad sheyetakken lo et haaliyya rabbi yose omer hattachton noten et hattikra vehaelon et hammaaziva
Bava Metzia 10:3: Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot vehu eno rotze livnot hare vaal haaliyya bone et habbayit vedar betocho ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav rabbi yehuda omer af ze dar betoch shel chavero tzarich lehaalot lo sachar ella vaal haaliyya bone et habbayit veet haaliyya umkare et haaliyya veoshev babbayit ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav
Bava Metzia 10:4: Vechen bet habbad shehu vanuy besela veginna achat al gabbav venifchat hare vaal hagginna yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase levet baddo kippin hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku patur milleshallem natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel venaflu betoch hazzeman patur leachar hazzeman chayyav
Bava Metzia 10:5: Mi shehaya chotlo samuch leginnat chavero venafal veamar lo panne avanecha veamar lo higgiucha en shomin lo mishshekkibbel alav amar lo helach et yetziotecha vaani ettol et shelli en shomin lo hassocher et happoel laasot immo beteven uvkash veamar lo ten li sechari veamar lo tol ma sheasita bischarecha en shomin lo mishshekkibbel alav veamar lo helach secharcha vaani ettol et shelli en shomin lo hammotzi zevel lirshut harabbim hammotzi motzi vehamzabbel mezabbel en shorin tit birshut harabbim veen lovnim levenim aval govlin tit birshut harabbim aval lo levenim habbone virshut harabbim hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom
Bava Metzia 10:6: Shette ginnot zo al gav zo vehayyarak bentayim rabbi meir omer shel elon rabbi yehuda omer shel tachton amar rabbi meir im yirtze haelon likkach et afaro en kan yarak amar rabbi yehuda im yirtze hattachton lemalleot et ginnato en kan yarak amar rabbi meir meachar sheshshenehen yecholin limchot ze al ze roin mehechan yarak ze chay amar rabbi shimon kal shehaelon yachol lifshot et yado velittol hare hu shello vehashshear shel tachton
Bava Batra 1:1: Hashshuttafin sheratzu laasot mechitztza bechatzer bonin et hakkotel baemtza mekom shennahagu livnot gavil gazit kefisin levenim bonim hakkol keminhag hammedina begavil ze noten shelosha tefachim veze noten shelosha tefachim begazit ze noten tefachayim umechetza veze noten tefachayim umechetza bichfisin ze noten tefachayim veze noten tefachayim bilvenim ze noten tefach umechetza veze noten tefach umechetza lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem
Bava Batra 1:2: Vechen beginna mekom shennahagu ligdor mechayevin oto aval bevika mekom shennahagu shello ligdor en mechayevin oto ella im rotze kones letoch shello uvone veose chazit mibbachutz lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shello im asu middaat shenehen bonin et hakkotel baemtza veosin chazit mikkan umikkan lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem
Bava Batra 1:3: Hammakkif et chavero mishshelosh ruchotav vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit en mechayevin oto rabbi yose omer im amad vegadar et harviit megalgelin alav et hakkol
Bava Batra 1:4: Kotel chatzer shennafal mechayevin oto livnoto ad arba ammot bechezkat shennatan ad sheyyavi reaya shello natan mearba ammot ulmala en mechayevin oto samach lo chotel acher af al pi shello natan alav et hattikra megalgelin alav et hakkol bechezkat shello natan ad sheyyavi reaya shennatan
Bava Batra 1:5: Kofin oto livnot bet shaar vedelet lechatzer rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo chal hachatzerot reuot levet shaar kofin oto livnot lair choma udlatayim uvriach rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo chal haayarot reuot lechoma kamma yehe vair vihe cheanshe hair shenem asar chodesh kana vah bet dira hare hu cheanshe hair miyyad
Bava Batra 1:6: En cholkin et hechatzer ad sheyehe arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze velo et hassade ad sheyehe vah tisha kabbin laze vetisha kabbin laze rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyehe vah tishat chatzae kabbin laze vetishat chatzae kabbin laze velo et hagginna ad sheyehe vah chatzi kav laze vachatzi kav laze rabbi akiva omer bet rova velo et hatteraklin velo et hammoran velo et hashshovach velo et hattallit velo et hammerchatz velo et bet habbad ad sheyehe vahen kede laze uchde laze ze hakkelal kal sheyyechalek ushmo alav cholkin veim lav en cholkin ematay bizman sheen shenehem rotzim aval bizman sheshshenehem rotzim afillu vefachot mikkan yachaloku vechitve hakkodesh af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim lo yachaloku
Bava Batra 2:1: Lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chavero velo shiach velo meara velo ammat hammayim velo nivrechet kovsin ella im ken hirchik mikkotel chavero shelosha tefachim vesad besid marchikin et haggefet veet hazzevel veet hammelach veet hassid veet hasselaim mikkatlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim vesad besid marchikin et hazzeraim veet hammacharesha veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim umarchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev shehen arbaa min harachev veet hattanur shelosha min hakkilya shehen arbaa min hassafa
Bava Batra 2:2: Lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit ella im ken yesh al gabbav govah arba ammot haya maamido vaaliyya tzarich sheyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim uvakkira tefach veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik rabbi shimon omer lo amru chal hashshiurin haellu ella sheim hizzik patur milleshallem
Bava Batra 2:3: Lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero velo refet bakar beemet beyayin hittiru aval lo refet bakar chanut shebbechatzer yachol limchot beyado velomar lo eni yachol lishon mikkol hannichnasin umikkol hayyotzin aval ose chelim yotze umocher betoch hashshuk aval eno yachol limchot beyado velomar lo eni yachol lishon lo mikkol happattish velo mikkol harechayim velo mikkol hattinokot
Bava Batra 2:4: Mi shehaya chatlo samuch lechotel chavero lo yismoch lo chotel acher ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot vehachallonot millemalan umillemattan umikkenegdan arba ammot
Bava Batra 2:5: Marchikin et hassullam min hashshovach arba ammot kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya veet hakkotel min hammazchila arba ammot kede sheyehe zokef et hassullam marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma velo yaase adam shovach betoch shello ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechal ruach rabbi yehuda omer bet arbaat korin melo sheger hayyona veim lekacho afillu vet rova hare hu vechezkato
Bava Batra 2:6: Nippul hannimtza vetoch chamishshim amma hare hu shel baal hashshovach chutz mechamishshim amma hare hu shel motzo nimtza ven shene shovachot karov laze shello karov laze shello mechetza al mechetza shenehem yachaloku
Bava Batra 2:7: Marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma uvcharuv uvshikma chamishshim amma abba shaul omer kal ilan serak chamishshim amma im hair kadma kotzetz veeno noten damim veim hailan kadam kotzetz venoten damim safek ze kadam safek ze kadam kotzetz veeno noten damim
Bava Batra 2:8: Marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechal ruach umarchik minnetiotav shel chavero uminniro kede shello yazzik
Bava Batra 2:9: Marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habburseki min hair chamishshim amma en osin burseki ella lemizrach hair rabbi akiva omer lechal ruach hu ose chutz mimmaaravah umarchik chamishshim amma
Bava Batra 2:10: Marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak veet hakkereshin min habbetzalim veet hachardal min haddevorim rabbi yose mattir bachardal
Bava Batra 2:11: Marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma uvcharuv uvshikma chamishshim amma ben milmala ben min hatztzad im habbor kadam kotzetz venoten damim veim ilan kadam lo yakotz safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam lo yakotz rabbi yose omer af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan lo yakotz shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello
Bava Batra 2:12: Lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot echad gefanim veechad kal ilan haya gader bentayim ze somech laggader mikkan veze somech laggader mikkan hau sharashim yotzin letoch shel chavero maamik shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev et hammacharesha haya chofer bor shiach umara kotzetz veored vehaetzim shello
Bava Batra 2:13: Ilan shehu note lisde chavero kotzetz melo hammardea al gabbe hammacharesha uvcharuv uvshikma keneged hammishkolet bet hashshelachin kal hailan keneged hammishkolet abba shaul omer kal ilan serak keneged hammishkolet
Bava Batra 2:14: Ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim kotzetz kede sheyehe gamal over verochvo rabbi yehuda omer gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot rabbi shimon omer kal hailan keneged hammishkolet mippene hattuma
Bava Batra 3:1: Chezkat habbattim vehabborot vehashshichin vehammearot vehashshovachot vehammerchatzaot uvet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin vehaavadim vechal shehu ose ferot tadir chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leom sede habbaal chezkatah shalosh shanim veenah miyyom leom rabbi yishmael omer shelosha chodashim barishona ushlosha baacharona ushnem asar chodesh vaemtza hare shemona asar chodesh rabbi akiva omer chodesh barishona vechodesh baacharona ushnem asar chodesh baemtza hare arbaa asar chodesh amar rabbi yishmael bamme devarim amurim bisde lavan aval bisde ilan kanas et tevuato masak et zetav kanas et ketzo hare ellu shalosh shanim
Bava Batra 3:2: Shalosh aratzot lachazaka yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil haya vihuda vehechezik baggalil baggalil vehechezik bihuda enah chazaka ad sheyehe immo vammedina amar rabbi yehuda lo amru shalosh shanim ella chede sheyehe veaspamya veyachazik shana veyelchu veodiuhu shana veyavo leshana acheret
Bava Batra 3:3: Kal chazaka sheen immah taana enah chazaka ketzad amar lo ma atta ose vetoch shelli vehu amar lo shello amar li adam davar meolam enah chazaka shemmacharta li shennatatta li vemattana avicha mecharah li avicha netanah li vemattana hare zo chazaka vehabba mishshum yerushsha eno tzarich taana haummanin vehashshuttafim vehaarisin vehaappotroppin en lahem chazaka en laish chazaka benichse ishto velo laishsha chazaka benichse valah velo laav benichse habben velo labben benichse haav bamme devarim amurim bemachazik aval benoten mattana vehaachin shechalku vehammachazik benichse hagger naal vegadar ufaratz kal shehu hare zo chazaka
Bava Batra 3:4: Hau shenayim meidin oto sheachalah shalosh shanim venimtzeu zommin meshallemin lo et hakkol shenayim barishona ushnayim bashsheniyya ushnayim bashshelishit meshalshin benehem shelosha achim veechad mitztaref immahem hare ellu shalosh eduyyot vehen edut achat lahazama
Bava Batra 3:5: Ellu devarim sheyyesh lahem chazaka veellu devarim sheen lahem chazaka haya maamid behema vechatzer tannur vechirayim verechayim umgaddel tarnegolin venoten zivlo vechatzer enah chazaka aval asa mechitztza livhemto gevoha asara tefachim vechen lattannur vechen lakkirayim vechen larechayim hichnis tarnegolin letoch habbayit veasa makom lezivlo amok shelosha o gavoha shelosha hare zo chazaka
Bava Batra 3:6: Hammarzev en lo chazaka veyesh limkomo chazaka hammazchila yesh lah chazaka sullam hammitzri en lo chazaka velatztzori yesh lo chazaka challon hammitzrit en lah chazaka velatztzorit yesh lah chazaka ezo hi challon hammitzrit kal sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah rabbi yehuda omer im yesh lah malben af al pi sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah hare zo chazaka hazziz ad tefach yesh lo chazaka veyachol limchot pachot mittefach en lo chazaka veen yachol limchot
Bava Batra 3:7: Lo yiftach adam challonotav lachatzar hashshuttafin lakach bayit bechatzer acheret lo yiftechenna lachatzar hashshuttafin bana aliyya al gabbe veto lo yiftachenna lachatzar hashshuttafin ella im ratza bone et hacheder lifnim mibbeto uvone aliyya al gabbe veto ufotchah letoch beto lo yiftach adam lachatzar hashshuttafin petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon haya katan lo yaasennu gadol echad lo yaasennu shenayim aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon haya katan ose oto gadol echad ose oto shenayim
Bava Batra 3:8: En osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim borot shichin umarot rabbi eliezer mattir kede shettehe agala mehallechet utuna avanim en motziin zizin ugzuzteraot lirshut harabbim ella im ratza kones letoch shello umotzi lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugzuzteraot hare zo vechezkatah
Bava Batra 4:1: Hammocher et habbayit lo machar hayyatzia veaf al pi shehi fetucha letocho velo et hacheder shellifnim mimmennu velo et haggag bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoha asara tefachim rabbi yehuda omer im yesh lo tzurat petach af al pi sheeno gavoha asara tefachim eno machur
Bava Batra 4:2: Lo et habbor velo et haddut af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma vetzarich likkach lo derech divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim eno tzarich likkach lo darech umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu sheeno tzarich likkach lo darech mecharan leacher rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich likkach lo derech vachachamim omrim tzarich likkach lo darech
Bava Batra 4:3: Hammocher et habbayit machar et haddelet aval lo et hammafteach machar et hammachteshet hakkevua aval lo et hammittaltelet machar et haitzterubbal aval lo et hakkelet velo et hattannur velo et hakkirayim bizman sheamar lo hu vechal ma shebbetocho hare chullan mechurin
Bava Batra 4:4: Hammocher et hechatzer machar battim borot shichin umarot aval lo et hammittaltelin bizman sheamar lo hi vechal ma shebbetochah hare chullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar et hammerchatz velo et bet habbad shebbetochah rabbi eliezer omer hammocher et hechatzer lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer
Bava Batra 4:5: Hammocher et bet habbad machar et hayyam veet hammammal veet habbetulot aval lo machar et haachirin veet haggalgal veet hakkora bizman sheamar lo hu vechal ma shebbetocho hare chullan mechurin rabbi eliezer omer hammocher bet habbad machar et hakkora
Bava Batra 4:6: Hammocher et hammerchatz lo machar et hannesarim veet hassafsalim veet havilaot bizman sheamar lo hu vechal ma shebbetocho hare chullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar et hammegurot shel mayim velo et haotzarot shel etzim
Bava Batra 4:7: Hammocher et hair machar battim borot shichin umarot merchatzaot veshovachot bet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin aval lo et hammittaltelin uvizman sheamar lo hi vechal ma shebbetochah afillu hau vah behema vaavadim hare chullan mechurin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hammocher et hair machar et hassanter
Bava Batra 4:8: Hammocher et hassade machar et haavanim shehem letzarkah veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehem letzarko veet hattevua shehi mechubberet lakkarka veet mechitztzat hakkanim shehi fechuta mibbet rova veet hashshomera sheenah asuya vetit veet hecharuv sheeno murkav veet betulat hashshikma
Bava Batra 4:9: Aval lo machar lo et haavanim sheenan letzarkah velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzarko velo et hattevua shehi telusha min hakkarka bizman sheamar lo hi vechal ma shebbetochah hare chullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et mechitztzat hakkanim shehi vet rova velo et hashshomera shehi asuya vetit velo et hecharuv hammurkav velo et saddan hashshikma velo et habbor velo et haggat velo et hashshovach ben charevin ben yeshuvin vetzarich likkach lo darech divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim eno tzarich umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu sheeno tzarich likkach lo darech mecharan leacher rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich likkach lo darech vachachamim omrim tzarich likkach lo darech bamme devarim amurim bemocher aval benoten mattana noten et kullam haachin shechalku zachu vassade zachu vechullam hammachazik benichse hagger hechezik bassade hechezik bechullam hammakdish et hassade hikdish et kullam rabbi shimon omer hammakdish et hassade lo hikdish ella et hecharuv hammurkav veet saddan hashshikma
Bava Batra 5:1: Hammocher et hassefina machar et hattoren veet hannes veet haogin veet kal hammanhigin otah aval lo machar lo et haavadim velo et hammartzufin velo et haantiki uvizman sheamar lo hi vechal ma shebbetochah hare chullan mechurin machar et hakkaron lo machar et happeradot machar et happeradot lo machar et hakkaron machar et hatztzemed lo machar et habbakar machar et habbakar lo machar et hatztzemed rabbi yehuda omer haddamim modiin ketzad amar lo mechor li tzimdecha bematayim zuz haddavar yadua sheen hatztzemed bematayim zuz vachachamim omrim en haddamim reaya
Bava Batra 5:2: Hammocher et hachamor lo machar kelav nachum hammadi omer machar kelav rabbi yehuda omer peamim mechurin ufamim enan mechurin ketzad haya chamor lefanav vechelav alav veamar lo mechor li chamorcha ze hare chelav mechurin chamorcha hu en kelav mechurin
Bava Batra 5:3: Hammocher et hachamor machar et hasseyach machar et happara lo machar et benah machar ashpa machar zivlah machar bor machar memav machar kaveret machar devorim machar shovach machar yonim hallokeach perot shovach mechavero mafriach berecha rishona perot kaveret notel shelosha nechilin umsares challot devash manniach shette challot zetim lakotz manniach shette gerofiyyot
Bava Batra 5:4: Hakkone shene ilanot betoch sede chavero hare ze lo kana karka rabbi meir omer kana karka higdilu lo yeshappe vehaole min haggeza shello umin hashsharashim shel baal hakkarka veim metu en lo karka kana shelosha kana karka higdilu yeshappe vehaole min haggeza umin hashsharashin shello veim metu yesh lo karka
Bava Batra 5:5: Hammocher rosh behema gassa lo machar et haraglayim machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh machar et hakkane lo machar et hakkaved machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane aval bedakka machar et harosh machar et haraglayim machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh machar et hakkane machar et hakkaved machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane
Bava Batra 5:6: Arba middot bammochrin machar lo chittim yafot venimtzeu raot hallokeach yachol lachazor bo raot venimtzeu yafot mocher yachol lachazor bo raot venimtzeu raot yafot venimtzeu yafot en echad mehem yachol lachazor bo shechamtit venimtzet levana levana venimtzet shechamtit etzim shel zayit venimtzeu shel shikma shel shikma venimtzeu shel zayit yayin venimtza chometz chometz venimtza yayin shenehem yecholin lachazor bahen
Bava Batra 5:7: Hammocher perot lachavero mashach velo madad kana madad velo mashach lo kana im haya fikkeach socher et mekoman hallokeach pishtan mechavero hare ze lo kana ad sheyetaltelennu mimmakom lemakom veim haya vimchubbar lakkarka vetalash kal shehu kana
Bava Batra 5:8: Hammocher yayin vashemen lachavero vehukru o shehuzlu im ad shello nitmallea hammidda lammocher mishshennitmallea hammidda lallokeach veim haya sarsur benehen nishbera hechavit nishbera lassarsur vechayyav lehattif lo shalosh tippin hirkinah umitztza hare hu shel mocher vehachenvani eno chayyav lehattif shalosh tippin rabbi yehuda omer erev shabbat im chashecha patur
Bava Batra 5:9: Hashsholeach et beno etzel chenvani ufundeon beyado umadad lo beissar shemen venatan lo et haissar shavar et hatztzelochit veibbed et haissar chenvani chayyav rabbi yehuda poter sheal menat ken shelacho umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok umadad chenvani letochah chenvani fatur
Bava Batra 5:10: Hassiton mekanneach middotav achat lishloshim yom uvaal habbayit achat lishnem asar chodesh rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chilluf haddevarim chenvani mekanneach middotav paamayim bashshabbat ummache mishkelotav paam achat bashshabbat umkanneach moznayim al kal mishkal umishkal
Bava Batra 5:11: Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim ballach aval bayyavesh eno tzarich vechayyav lehachria lo tefach haya shokel lo ayin beayin noten lo gerumav echad laasara ballach veechad leesrim bayyavesh mekom shennahagu lamod baddakka lo yamod baggassa baggassa lo yamod baddakka limchok lo yigdosh ligdosh lo yimchok
Bava Batra 6:1: Hammocher perot lachavero velo tzimmechu vaafillu zera pishtan eno chayyav beacharautan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer zerone ginna sheenan neechalin chayyav beacharautan
Bava Batra 6:2: Hammocher perot lachavero hare ze mekabbel alav rova tinnofet lisa teenim mekabbel alav eser metullaot lemea martef shel yayin mekabbel alav eser kossot lemea kankannim bashsharon mekabbel alav eser pitasyaot lemea
Bava Batra 6:3: Hammocher yayin lachavero vehechmitz eno chayyav beacharauto veim yadua sheyyeno machmitz hare ze mikkach taut veim amar lo yayin mevussam ani mocher lecha chayyav lehaamid lo ad haatzeret veyashan mishshel eshtakad umyushshan mishshel shalosh shanim
Bava Batra 6:4: Hammocher makom lachavero livnot lo vayit vechen hamkabbel mechavero livnot lo vet chatnut livno uvet almenut levitto bone arba ammot al shesh divre rabbi akiva rabbi yishmael omer refet bakar hu ze harotze laasot refet bakar bone arba ammot al shesh bayit katan shesh al shemone gadol shemone al eser teraklin eser al eser rumo kachatzi arko vechachatzi rachbo reaya laddavar hechal rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol kevinyan hechal
Bava Batra 6:5: Mi sheyyesh lo vor lifnim mibbeto shel chavero nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasin veotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin veeno machnis behemto umashkah mibboro ella memalle umashkah mibbachutz veze ose lo fotachat veze ose lo fotachat
Bava Batra 6:6: Mi sheyyesh lo ginna lifnim migginnato shel chavero nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasim veotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin veeno machnis letochah taggarin velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret vehachitzon zorea et haddarech natnu lo derech min hatztzad middaat shenehem nichnas beshaa shehu rotze veotze beshaa shehu rotze umachnis letochah taggarin velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret veze vaze enam rashshaim lezarah
Bava Batra 6:7: Mi shehayeta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu netalah venatan lahem min hatztzad ma shennatan natan veshello lo higgio derech hayyachid arba ammot derech harabbim shesh esre amma derech hammelech en lah shiur derech hakkever en lah shiur hammaamad dayyane tzippori amru bet arbaat kabbin
Bava Batra 6:8: Hammocher makom lachavero laasot lo kever vechen hamkabbel mechavero laasot lo kever ose tochah shel meara arba ammot al shesh ufoteach letochah shemona chuchin shelosha mikkan ushlosha mikkan ushnayim mikkenegdan vechuchin arkan arba ammot veruman shiva verachban shishsha rabbi shimon omer ose tochah shel meara shesh ammot al shemone ufoteach letochah shelosha asar kuch arbaa mikkan vearbaa mikkan ushlosha mikkenegdan veechad mimin happetach veechad min hassemol veose chatzer al pi hammeara shesh al shesh kimlo hammitta vekovreha ufoteach letochah shette mearot achat mikkan veachat mikkan rabbi shimon omer arba learba ruchoteha rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol lefi hassala
Bava Batra 7:1: Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha hau sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim enan nimdadin immah pachot mikkan nimdadin immah veim amar lo kevet kor afar afillu hau sham nekaim amukkim yoter measara tefachim o selaim gevohin yoter measara tefachim hare ellu nimdadin immah
Bava Batra 7:2: Bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda vachevel pichet kal shehu yenakke hotir kal shehu yachazir im amar hen chaser hen yater afillu fichet rova lassea o hotir rova lassea higgio yoter mikkan yaase cheshbon ma hu machazir lo maot veim ratza machazir lo karka velamma amru machazir lo maot leyappot kocho shel mocher sheim shiyyer bassade bet tisha kabbin uvagginna bet chatzi kav uchdivre rabbi akiva bet rova machazir lo et hakkarka velo et harova bilvad hu machazir ella et kal hammotar
Bava Batra 7:3: Midda vachevel ani mocher lecha hen chaser hen yater bittel hen chaser hen yater midda vachevel hen chaser hen yater midda vachevel bittel midda vachevel hen chaser hen yater divre ven nannas besimanav uvimtzarav pachot mishshetut higgio ad shetut yenakke
Bava Batra 7:4: Haomer lachavero chatzi sade ani mocher lecha meshammenin benehen venotel chatzi sadehu chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lecha meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom vehu mekabbel alav mekom haggader charitz uven charitz vechamma hu charitz shishsha tefachim uven charitz shelosha
Bava Batra 8:1: Yesh nochalin umanchilin veyesh nochalin velo manchilin manchilin velo nochalin lo nochalin velo manchilin veellu nochalin umanchilin haav et habbanim vehabbanim et haav vehaachin min haav nochalin umanchilin haish et immo vehaish et ishto uvne achaot nochalin velo manchilin haishsha et baneha vehaishsha et balah vaache haem manchilin velo nochalin vehaachim min haem lo nochalin velo manchilin
Bava Batra 8:2: Seder nechalot kach hu vmdvr chz ish ki yamut uven en lo vehaavartem et nachalato levitto ben kodem labbat vechal yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat bat kodemet laachin yotze yerechah shel bat kodmin laachin achin kodmin laache haav yotze yerechan shel achin kodmin laache haav ze hakkelal kal hakkodem bannachala yotze yerecho kodmin vehaav kodem lechal yotze yerecho
Bava Batra 8:3: Benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala chelek avihen shehaya im yotze mitzrayim vechelko im echav benichse chefer veshehaya vechor notel shene chalakim
Bava Batra 8:4: Echad habben veechad habbat bannachala ella shehabben notel pi shenayim benichse haav veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem vehabbanot nizzonot minnichse haav veenan nizzonot minnichse haem
Bava Batra 8:5: Haomer ish peloni veni bechor lo yittol pi shenayim ish peloni veni lo yirash im echav lo amar kelum shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora hamchallek nechasav levanav al piv ribba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahen et habbechor devarav kayyamin veim amar mishshum yerushsha lo amar kelum katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof mishshum mattana devarav kayyamin haomer ish peloni yirasheni bimkom sheyesh bat bitti tirasheni bimkom sheyyesh ben lo amar kelum shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer im amar al mi shehu rauy leyarsho devarav kayyamin veal mi sheen rauy leyarsho en devarav kayyamin hakkotev et nechasav laacherim vehinniach et banav ma sheasa asuy aval en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im lo hau vanav nohagin kashshura zachur letov
Bava Batra 8:6: Haomer ze beni neeman ze achi eno neeman venotel immo bechelko met yachzeru nechasim limkoman naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher yirshu echav immo mi shemmet venimtzet deyateke keshura al yerecho hare zo enah kelum zikka vah leacher ben min hayyorshin ben sheeno min hayyorshin devarav kayyamin
Bava Batra 8:7: Hakkotev nechasav levanav tzarich sheyyichtov mehayyom ulachar mita divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer eno tzarich hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto haav eno yachol limkor mippene shehen ketuvin labben vehabben eno yachol limkor mippene shehen birshut haav machar haav mechurin ad sheyyamut machar habben en lallokeach bahen kelum ad sheyyamut haav haav tolesh umaachil lechal mi sheyyirtze uma shehinniach talush hare hu shel yorshin hinniach banim gedolim uktannim en haggedolim mitparnesim al hakketannim velo hakketannim nizzonin al haggedolim ella cholkin beshave nasu haggedolim yisu hakketannim veim amru ketannim hare anu nosim kederech shennesatem attem en shomin lahem ella ma shennatan lahem avihem natan
Bava Batra 8:8: Hinniach banot gedolot uktannot en haggedolot mitparnesot al hakketannot velo hakketannot nizzonot al haggedolot ella cholkot beshave nasu gedolot yisu ketannot veim amru ketannot hare anu nosot kederech shennesatem attem en shomin lahen ze chomer babbanot mibbabbanim shehabbanot nizzonot al habbanim veen nizzonot al habbanot
Bava Batra 9:1: Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot bizman shehannechasim merubbim habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu nechasim muatin habbanot yizzonu vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim admon omer bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti amar rabban gamliel roe ani et divre admon
Bava Batra 9:2: Hinniach banim uvanot vetumtum bizman shehannechasim merubbim hazzecharim dochin oto etzel nekevot nechasim muatin hannekevot dochot oto etzel zecharim haomer im teled ishti zachar yittol mane yalda zachar notel mane nekeva matayim yalda nekeva notelet matayim im zachar mane im nekeva matayim veyalda zachar unkeva zachar notel mane vehannekeva notelet matayim yalda tumtum eno notel im amar kal ma shetteled ishti yittol hare ze yittol veim en sham yoresh ella hu yoresh et hakkol
Bava Batra 9:3: Hinniach banim gedolim uktannim hishbichu gedolim et hannechasim hishbichu laemtza im amru reu ma shehinniach lanu abba hare anu osim veochlin hishbichu leatzman vechen haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim hishbicha laemtza im amra reu ma shehinniach li bali hare ani osa veochelet hishbicha leatzmah
Bava Batra 9:4: Haachin hashshuttafin shennafal echad mehen laummanut nafal laemtza chala venitrappa nitrappa mishshel atzmo haachin sheasu miktzatan shushvinut bechayye haav chazra shushvinut chazra laemtza shehashshushvinut nigbet bevet din aval hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen enan nigbin bevet din mippene shehen gemilut chasadim
Bava Batra 9:5: Hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv shalach sham mea mane veachal sham seudat chatan afillu vedinar enan nigbin lo achal sham seudat chatan hare ellu nigbin shalach sivlonot merubbin sheyyachzeru immah levet balah hare ellu nigbin sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha enan nigbin
Bava Batra 9:6: Shechiv mera shekkatav kal nechasav laacherim veshiyyer karka kal shehu mattenato kayyemet lo shiyyer karka kal shehu en mattenato kayyemet lo chatav bah shechiv mera hu omer shechiv mera haya vehen omrim bari haya tzarich lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Bava Batra 9:7: Hamchallek nechasav al piv rabbi eliezer omer echad bari veechad mesukkan nechasim sheyyesh lahen acharaut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka vesheen lahen acharaut en niknin ella vimshicha amru lo maase veimman shel bene rochel shehayeta chola veamra tenu chevinati levitti vehi vishnem asar mane vameta vekiyemu et devareha amar lahen bene rochel tekabberem imman vachachamim omrim beshabbat devarav kayyamin mippene sheeno yachol lichtov aval lo vechol rabbi yehoshua omer beshabbat amru kal vachomer bechol kayyotze vo zachin lakkatan veen zachin laggadol rabbi yehoshua omer lakkatan amru kal vachomer laggadol
Bava Batra 9:8: Nafal habbayit alav veal aviv o alav veal morishav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov yorshe haav omrim habben met rishon veachar kach met haav baale hachov omrim haav met rishon veachar kach met habben bet shammay omrim yachaloku uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan
Bava Batra 9:9: Nafal habbayit alav veal ishto yorshe habbaal omrim haishsha meta rishona veachar kach met habbaal yorshe haishsha omrim habbaal met rishon veachar kach meta haishsha bet shammay omrim yachaloku uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzin immah bechezkat yorshe haav

Kelim 26:3: Kaf lokte kotzim tehora hazzon vehabbirkeyar temein vehashsharulim temein vehapperaklimin tehorin vechal bet etzbaot tehorot chutz mishshel kayyatzin mippene shehi mekabbelet et haog nikrea im enah mekabbelet et rov haog tehora
Kelim 26:4: Sandal shennifseka achat meaznav vetikkenah tame midras nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennifseka sheniyya tehora nifsak akevo nittal chotmo o shennechelak lishnayim tahor solyam shennifsak mikkal makom tahor minal shennifchat im eno mekabbel et rov haregel tahor minal sheal haemum rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammeim kal chamatot tzerurot tehorot chutz mishshel arviyyin rabbi meir omer tzeror shaa tehorot tzeror olam temeot rabbi yose omer kal chamatot tzerurot tehorot
Kelim 26:5: Ellu orot temein midras or shechishshav alav leshatiach or sekorteya or katavolya or hachammar or hakkattan or hakkattaf or harofe or haarisa or hallev shel katan or hakkar or hakkeset midras or hassarok or hassorek rabbi eliezer omer midras vachachamim omrim teme met
Kelim 26:6: Av kesut vetachrich kesut midras av argaman vetachrich argaman bet shammay omrim midras uvet hillel omrim teme met or sheasao chippuy lichli tahor lemishkalot tame rabbi yose metaher mishshum aviv
Kelim 26:7: Kal makom sheen chesron melacha machashava metammetan vechal makom sheyyesh chesron melacha en machashava metammetan ella hautzba
Kelim 26:8: Orot baal habbayit machashava metammetan veshel abbedan en machashava metammetan veshel gannav machashava metammetan veshel gazlan en machashava metammetan rabbi shimon omer chilluf haddevarim shel gazlan machashava metammetan veshel gannav en machashava metammetan mippene shello nityaashu habbealim
Kelim 26:9: Or shehu tame midras vechishshav alav lirtzuot ulsandalin kevan shennatan bo et haizmel tahor divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim ad sheyemaatennu fachot mechamishsha tefachim rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer af haose mitpachat min haor temea umin hakkeset tehora
Kelim 27:1: Habbeged mittamme mishshum chamishsha shemot hassak mishshum arbaa haor mishshum shelosha haetz mishshum shenayim uchli cheres mishshum echad keli cheres mittamme mishshum keli kibbul kol sheen lo toch bichle cheres en lo achorayim musaf alav haetz shehu mittamme mishshum moshav vechen tavla sheen lah lizbez bichle etz temea uvichle cheres tehora musaf alav haor shehu mittamme mishshum ohalim musaf alav hassak shehu mittamme mishshum arig musaf alav habbeged shehu mittamme mishshum shalosh al shalosh
Kelim 27:2: Habbeged mittamme mishshum shelosha al shelosha lemidras umishshum shalosh al shalosh litme met hassak arbaa al arbaa haor chamishsha al chamishsha mappatz shishsha al shishsha shavin lemidras velitme met rabbi meir omer hassak sheyarav arbaa utchillato mishsheyyiggamer
Kelim 27:3: Haose shenayim min habbeged veechad min hassak shelashtan min hassak veechad min haor arbaa min haor veechad min hammappatz tahor chamishsha min hammappatz veechad min haor arbaa min haor veechad min hassak shelosha min hassak veechad min habbeged tame ze hakkelal kol shechibber lo min hechamur mimmennu tame min hakkal mimmennu tahor
Kelim 27:4: Hamkatztzea mikkullam tefach al tefach tame mishshule hakkuppa tefach al tefach tame mitztzedade hakkuppa rabbi shimon metaher vachachamim omrim hamkatztzea tefach al tefach bechal makom tame
Kelim 27:5: Beloye nafa uchvara shehitkinan lishiva rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin ad sheyekatztzea kisse shel katan sheyyesh lo raglayim af al pi sheen bo gavoha tefach tame chaluk shel katan rabbi eliezer omer kal shehu vachachamim omrim ad sheyyihye vo chashshiur venimdad kaful
Kelim 27:6: Ellu nimdadin kefulin ampalya ufmolinya umichnasayim vechova vechis shel pundiyya umatlit shettelayah al hassafa im peshuta nimdedet peshuta veim kefula nimdedet kefula
Kelim 27:7: Habbeged shearag bo shelosha al shelosha venitma midras vehishlim alav et kal habbeged veachar kach natal chut echad mittechillato tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim alav et kal habbeged tame magga midras
Kelim 27:8: Vechen beged shearag bo shalosh al shalosh venitma teme met vehishlim alav et kal habbeged veachar kach natal chut echad mittechillato tahor mitteme met aval tame magga teme met natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim alav et kal habbeged tahor mippene sheamru shalosh al shalosh shennitmaet tahor aval shelosha al shelosha shennitmaet af al pi shettahor mimmidras tame vechal hattumot
Kelim 27:9: Sadin shehu tame midras vaasao vilon tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras amar rabbi yose vechi veeze midras naga ze ella im ken naga bo hazzav tame vemagga hazzav
Kelim 27:10: Shelosha al shelosha shennechelak tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras amar rabbi yose vechi veeze midras naga ze ella im ken naga bo hazzav tame magga hazzav
Kelim 27:11: Shelosha al shelosha baashpot bari vetzorer melach babbayit o vari o tzorer melach kamma melach yehe tzorer rova rabbi yehuda omer bedakka vachachamim omrim begassa ellu vaellu mitkavvenim lehakel rabbi shimon omer shavim shelosha al shelosha vaashpot leshalosh al shalosh babbayit
Kelim 27:12: Shelosha al shelosha shennikra im netano al hakkisse uvsaro nogea bakkisse tahor veim lav tame shalosh al shalosh shennimha mimmenna chut echad o shennimtza vo kesher o shene chutin matimin tehora shalosh al shalosh shehishlichah baashpot tehora hechezirah temea leolam hashlachatah metaharatta vachazaratah metammetah chutz mishshel argaman veshel zehorit tova rabbi eliezer omer af matlit chadasha kayyotze vahen rabbi shimon omer kullan tehorin lo huzkeru ella mippene hashavat aveda
Kelim 28:1: Shalosh al shalosh shennetanah bechaddur o sheasaah kaddur bifne atzmah tehora aval shelosha al shelosha shennetano vechaddur tame asao chaddur bifne atzmo tahor mippene shehattefer memaato
Kelim 28:2: Pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lafok bo et hammerchatz lenaer bo et hakkedera lekanneach bo et harechayim ben muchan ben sheeno muchan tame divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer ben min hammuchan ben sheeno min hammuchan tahor rabbi akiva omer min hammuchan tame sheeno min hammuchan tahor
Kelim 28:3: Haose ispelanit ben beveged ben beor tehora rabbi yose omer al haor tahor melugma beveged tehora uvor temea rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af beveged temea mippene shehi ninaret
Kelim 28:4: Mitpechot sefarim ben metzuyyarot ben sheenan metzuyyarot temeot kedivre vet shammay bet hillel omrim metzuyyarot tehorot vesheenam metzuyyarot temeot rabban gamliel omer ellu vaellu tehorot
Kelim 28:5: Kippa shehu tame midras untano al hassefer tahor min hammidras aval tame teme met chemet sheasaah shatiach veshatiach sheasao chemet tahor chemet sheasaah turmel veturmel sheasao chemet kar sheasao sadin vesadin sheasao kar keset sheasaah mitpachat umitpachat sheasaah keset tame ze hakkelal kol sheshshinnahu lishmo tame leshem acher tahor
Kelim 28:6: Matlit shettelayah al hakkuppa metammea echad ufoselet echad hifrishah min hakkuppa hakkuppa metamma echad ufoselet echad vehammatlit tehora telayah al habbeged metamma shenayim ufoselet echad hifrishah min habbeged habbeged metamme echad ufosel echad vehammatlit metammea shenayim ufoselet echad vechen hattole al hassak o al haor divre rabbi meir rabbi shimon metaher rabbi yose omer al haor tahor al hassak tame mippene shehu arig
Kelim 28:7: Shalosh al shalosh sheamru chutz min hammelal divre rabbi shimon vachachamim omrim shalosh al shalosh mechuvanet telayah al habbeged meruach achat eno chibbur mishshette ruchot zo cheneged zo chibbur asao chemin gam rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim betallit aval bechaluk milmalan chibbur umillemattan eno chibbur
Kelim 28:8: Bigde aniyyim af al pi sheen bahem shalosh al shalosh hare ellu temein midras tallit shehitchil bah lekarah kevan shennikra rubbah eno chibbur heavim veharakkim en bahem mishshum shalosh al shalosh
Kelim 28:9: Keset hassabbalin temea midras meshammeret shel yayin en bah mishshum moshav sevacha shel zekena temea mishshum moshav chaluk shel yotzet hachutz heasuy kisvacha tahor haose veged min hacherem tahor umizzuto tame rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer af haose veged min hacherem uchfalo tame
Kelim 28:10: Sevacha shehitchil bah mippiha tehora ad sheyyigmor et kurkurtah hitchil bah mikkurkurtah tehora ad sheyyigmor et piha shavis shellah tame vifne atzmo hachutin shellah temein mishshum chibbur sevacha shennikrea im enah mekabbelet et rov hassear tehora
Kelim 29:1: Nome hassadin vehassudarin vehattartin vehappilon shel rosh shesh etzbaot shel afkarsin eser nime sagos vehardid vehechaluk vehattallit shalosh etzbaot nime chippa shel zekena vehaggumdin shel arviyyin vehakkulkin vehappunda vehammaaforet vehappargod nimehen kal shehen
Kelim 29:2: Shalosh kesatot shel tzemer shesh shel pishtan shelosha sedinin shettem esre mitpachot shene suvrikin chaluk echad tallit echad keluvkarin echad chibbur lattuma velahazzaya yater mikkan chibbur lattuma veen chibbur lahazzaya rabbi yose omer af lo lattuma
Kelim 29:3: Chut hammishkolet shenem asar shel charashin shemona asar shel bannayin chamishshim amma yater mikkan im ratza lekayyem tahor shel sayyadin veshel tzayyarin kal shehen
Kelim 29:4: Chut moznayim shel zehavim veshel shokle argaman tov shalosh etzbaot yad hakkurdom meacharav shalosh etzbaot rabbi yose omer tefach tahor
Kelim 29:5: Chut moznayim shel chenvanim shel baale vattim tefach yad hakkurdom millefanav tefach sheyare yad happargol tefach yad makkevet shel yad shel mefatteche avanim tafach
Kelim 29:6: Chut moznayim shel tzammarim veshel shokle zechuchit tefachayim yad hammakkor tefachayim yad hammaatzad shel ligonot tefachayim yad hakkurnas shel zehavim tefachayim veshel charashin shelosha tefachim
Kelim 29:7: Sheyare haddarvan milmalan arbaa yad habbadid arbaa yad hakkurdom shel nikkush chamishsha yad ben happattish chamishsha veshel happattish shishsha yad hakkurdom shel bikkua veshel adir shishsha veyad makkevet shel sattatin shishsha
Kelim 29:8: Sheyare charchur millemattan shiva yad magrefa shel baale vattim bet shammay omrim shiva bet hillel omrim shemona shel sayyadin bet shammay omrim tisha bet hillel omrim asara yater mikkan im ratza lekayyem tame veyad meshammeshe haur kal shehu
Kelim 30:1: Kele zechuchit peshutehen tehorin umkabbelehen temeim nishberu taharu chazar veasa mehen kelim mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulhabba hattavla vehaiskutla shel zechuchit tehorin im yesh lahen lizbez temeim shule keara veshule iskutla shel zechuchit shehitkinan letashmish tehorin kirtesan o shafan beshufin temein
Kelim 30:2: Aspaklarya tehora vetamchuy sheasao aspaklarya tame veim mittechilla asao leshem aspaklarya tahor tarvad shehu notno al hashshulchan im mekabbel kal shehu tame veim lav rabbi akiva metamme rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher
Kelim 30:3: Kos shennifgam rubbo tahor nifgam bo shalosh berubbo tahor rabbi shimon omer im mefazzer hu et rov hammayim tahor nikkav vaasao ben bevaatz ben bezefet tahor rabbi yose omer bevaatz tame uvzefet tahor
Kelim 30:4: Tzelochit ketanna shennittal piha temea ugdola shennittal piha tehora shel palyaton shennittal piha tehora mippene shehi sorachat et hayyad leginin gedolim shennittal pihen temein mippene shehu metakkenan lichvashin vehaafarkes shel zechuchit tehora amar rabbi yose ashrayich kelim shennichnaste betuma veyatzat betahora
Oholot 1:1: Shenayim temeim bemet echad tame tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev shelosha temein bemet shenayim temein tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev arbaa temein bemet shelosha temein tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev ketzad shenayim adam hannogea bemet tame tumat shiva veadam hannoge bo tame tumat arev
Oholot 1:2: Ketzad shelosha kelim hannogim bemet vechelim bakkelim temein tumat shiva hashshelishi ben adam uven kelim temein tumat arev
Oholot 1:3: Ketzad arbaa kelim nogin bemet veadam bakkelim vechelim baadam temein tumat shiva harvii ben adam ben kelim tame tumat arev amar rabbi akiva yesh li chamishi hashshappud hattachuv baohel haohel vehashshappud veadam hannogea bashshappud vechelim baadam temein tumat shiva hachamishi ben adam ben kelim tame tumat arev amru lo en haohel mitchashshev
Oholot 1:4: Adam vechelim mittammein bemet chomer baadam mibbakkelim vechelim mibbaadam shehakkelim shelosha vehaadam shenayim chomer baadam shekkal zeman shehu vaemtza hen arbaa vesheeno vaemtza hen shelosha
Oholot 1:5: Adam uvgadim mittammeim bezav chomer baadam mibbabbegadim uvabbegadim mibbaadam shehaadam hannogea bezav metamme vegadim veen begadim hannogin bezav metammein begadim chomer babbegadim shehabbegadim hannosin et hazzav metammein adam veen adam hannose et hazzav metamme adam
Oholot 1:6: Adam eno metamme ad shettetze nafsho vaafillu meguyyad vaafillu goses zokek layyibbum ufoter min hayyibbum maachil batteruma ufosel batteruma vechen behema vechayya enan metammein ad shettetze nafsham huttezu rashehem af al pi shemmefarkesim temeim kegon zanav shel letaa shehi mefarkaset
Oholot 1:7: Haevarin en lahen shiur afillu pachot mikkazzayit min hammet ufachot mikkazzayit min hannevela ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz metammein tumatan
Oholot 1:8: Matayim vearbaim ushmona evarim baadam sheloshim befissat haregel shishsha vechal etzba asara vakkursal shenayim bashshok chamishsha vaarkubba echad bayyarech shelosha vakkatlit achat esre tzelaot sheloshim befissat hayyad shishsha vechal etzba shenayim bakkane ushnayim bammarpek echad bazzeroa vearbaa vakkatef mea veechad mizze umea veechad mizze ushmone esre chulot bashshidra tisha varosh shemona vatztzavar shishsha vammafteach shel lev vachamishsha vinkavav kal echad veechad metamme vemagga uvmassa uvohel ematay bizman sheyyesh alehen basar karauy aval im en alehen basar karauy metammein bemagga uvmassa veen metammein beohel
Oholot 2:1: Ellu metammein beohel hammet vechazzayit min hammet vechazzayit netzel umlo tarvad rakav hashshidra vehaggulgolet evar min hammet veevar min hachay sheyyesh alehen basar karauy rova atzamot merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan verov binyano verov minyano shel met af al pi sheen bahem rova temein kamma hu rov minyano mea veesrim vachamishsha
Oholot 2:2: Reviit dam urviit dam tevusa mimmet echad rabbi akiva omer mishshene metim dam katan sheyyatza chullo rabbi akiva omer kal shehu vachachamim omrim reviit kazzayit rimma ben chayya ben meta rabbi eliezer metamme chivsaro vachachamim metaharim efer serufim rabbi eliezer omer shiuro verova vachachamim metaharin melo tarvad veod afar kevarot tame rabbi shimon metaher melo tarvad rakav sheggevalo vemayim eno chibbur letuma
Oholot 2:3: Ellu metammein bemagga uvmassa veenan metammein beohel etzem kasseora veeretz haammim uvet happeras evar min hammet veevar min hachay sheen alehen basar karauy hashshidra vehaggulgolet shechasaru kamma hu chesron bashshidra bet shammay omrim shette chulot uvet hillel omrim afillu chulya echat uvaggulgolet bet shammay omrim kimlo makdeach uvet hillel omrim kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut beeze makdeach amru bakkatan shel rofim divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim baggadol shel lishka
Oholot 2:4: Haggolel vehaddofek metammein bemagga uvohel veenan metammein bemassa rabbi eliezer omer metammein bemassa rabbi yehoshua omer im yesh tachtehen afar kevarot metammein bemassa veim lav enan metammein bemassa ezehu haddofek et shehaggolel nishan alav aval dofek dofkin tahor
Oholot 2:5: Ellu sheim chasru tehorin kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit netzel umlo tarvad rakav urviit dam veetzem kasseora veevar min hachay shechasar atzmo
Oholot 2:6: Hashshidra vehaggulgolet mishshene metim urviit dam mishshene metim verova atzamot mishshene metim veevar min hammet mishshene metim veevar min hachay mishshene anashim rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin
Oholot 2:7: Etzem kasseora shennechelak lishnayim rabbi akiva metamme verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri lo amru atzamot kasseora ella etzem kasseora rova atzamot shenniddakdeku veen bechal echad veechad etzem kasseora rabbi shimon metaher vachachamim metammein evar min hachay shennechelak lishnayim tahor rabbi yose metamme umode sheim nittal chatzaim shehu tahor
Oholot 3:1: Kal hamtammein beohel shennechleku vehichnisan letoch habbayit rabbi dosa ven harkinas metaher vachachamim metammeim ketzad hannogea bechishne chatzaye zetim min hannevela o nosan uvammet hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al kachatzi zayit o noge bechachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav maahil al kishne chatzaye zetim maahil al kachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav rabbi dosa ven harkinas metaher vachachamim metammein aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit o maahil al kachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit tahor amar rabbi meir af baze rabbi dosa ven harkinas metaher vachachamim metammein hakkol tame chutz min hammagga im hammassa vehammassa im haohel ze hakkelal kol shehu mishshem echad tame mishshene shemot tahor
Oholot 3:2: Melo tarvad rakav shennitpazzer betoch habbayit habbayit tame verabbi shimon metaher reviit dam shennivlea vetoch habbayit habbayit tahor nivlea vichsut im mitkabbeset veotze mimmenna reviit dam temea veim lav tehora shekkol habbalua sheeno yachol latzet tahor
Oholot 3:3: Nishpach baavir im haya mekomo ketafres veheehil al miktzato tahor haya ashboren o shekkarash tame nishpach al haaskuppa vehi ketafres ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz vehabbayit maahil alav tahor haya ashboren o shekkarash tame kol shebbammet tame chutz min hashshinnayim vehassear vehatztzipporen uvishat chibburo hakkol tame
Oholot 3:4: Ketzad hammet mibbachutz usaro vifnim habbayit tame etzem sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar hichnis miktzato mibbifnim vehabbayit maahil alav tame shene atzamot vaalehen kishne chatzae zetim basar hichnis miktzatam mibbifnim vehabbayit maahil alehem tame hau techuvim bide adam tahor sheen chibbure adam chibbur
Oholot 3:5: Ezehu dam tevusa hammet sheyyatza mimmennu sheminit bechayyav ushminit bemoto divre rabbi akiva rabbi yishmael omer reviit bechayyav urviit bemoto nittal mizze umizze reviit rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda omer ze vaze chammayim ezehu dam tevusa tzaluv sheddamo shotet venimtza tachtav reviit dam tame aval hammet sheddamo menattef venimtza tachtav reviit dam tahor rabbi yehuda omer lo chi ella hashshotet tahor vehamnattef tame
Oholot 3:6: Kazzayit min hammet pitcho vetefach vehammet pitcho vearbaa tefachim lehatztzil hattuma al happetachim aval lehotzi hattuma befoteach tefach gadol mikkazzayit kammet rabbi yose omer hashshidra vehaggulgolet kammet
