Oholot 4:1: Migdal shehu omed baavir tuma vetocho kelim shebbeavo tehorim tuma veavo kelim shebbetocho tehorim rabbi yose omer mechetza lemechetza haya omed betoch habbayit tuma vetocho habbayit tame tuma vabbayit ma shebbetocho tahor shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes kelim shebbeno leven haaretz shebbeno leven hakkotel shebbeno leven hakkorot im yesh sham poteach tefach temein veim lav tehorin tuma sham habbayit tame
Oholot 4:2: Tevat hammigdal yesh bah poteach tefach veen bitziatah poteach tefach tuma vetochah habbayit tame tuma vabbayit ma shebbetochah tahor shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes rabbi yose metaher mippene shehu yachol lehotziah lachatzaim o lesarfah bimkomah

Parah 5:1: Hammevi keli cheres lechattat tovel velan al hakkivshan rabbi yehuda omer af min habbayit hu mevi vechasher shehakkol neemanim al hachattat uvatteruma poteach et hakkivshan venotel rabbi shimon omer min hasseder hashsheni rabbi yose omer min hasseder hashshelishi
Parah 5:2: Hammatbil keli lechattat bemayim sheenam reuyim lekaddesh tzarich lenaggev bemayim shehem reuyim lekaddesh eno tzarich lenaggev im lehosif letocho mayim mekuddashin ben kach uven kach tzarich lenaggev
Parah 5:3: Keruya shehitbiluha vemayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh mekaddeshin bah ad shettitma nitmea en mekaddeshin bah rabbi yehoshua omer im mekaddesh hu vah battechilla af bassof yekaddesh bah im eno mekaddesh bah bassof af lo vattechilla ben kach uven kach lo yosif letochah mayim mekuddashim
Parah 5:4: Shefoferet shechatachah lechattat rabbi eliezer omer yatbil miyyad rabbi yehoshua omer yetamme veyatbil hakkol kesherim lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan ufosel beishsha uvanderoginos
Parah 5:5: Bechal hakkelim mekaddeshim afillu vichle gelalim bichle avanim uvichle adama uvisfina mekaddeshin bah en mekaddeshin lo vedafnot hakkelim velo veshule hammachatz velo vimgufat hechavit velo vechafnav mippene sheen memallein veen mekaddeshin veen mazzin me chattat ella vecheli en matztzilin betzamid patil ella chelim sheen matztzilim miyyad kele cheres ella chelim
Parah 5:6: Betzat hayyotzrim keshera rabbi yose fosel betzat hattarnegolet rabbi meir verabbi yehuda machshirin vachachamim poslin
Parah 5:7: Hashshoket shebbassela en memallein bah veen mekaddeshin bah veen mazzin mimmenna veenah tzericha tzamid patil veenah poselet et hammikve hayeta cheli vechibberah besid memallein bah umkaddeshin bah umazzin mimmenna utzricha tzamid patil ufoselet et hammikve nikkeva millemattan ufkakah bismartut hammayim shebbetochah pesulin mippene sheenan agullim keli min hatztzad ufkakah bismartut hammayim shebbetochah kesherim mippene shehem agullim keli asu lah atara shel tit vehalchu hammayim lesham pesulin im haya vari kede sheyyinnatel immah kesherim
Parah 5:8: Shette shekatot shebbeeven achat kiddesh achat mehem hammayim shebbashsheniyya enan mekuddashin hau nekuvot zo lazo kishfoferet hannod o shehau hammayim tzafin al gabbehen afillu chiklippat hashshum vekiddesh et achat mehen hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin
Parah 5:9: Shette avanim shehikkifan zo lazo vaasaan shoket vechen shette arevot vechen hashshoket shennechleka hammayim shebbenehem enan mekuddashin asaan besid o vegifsim vehen yecholot lehinnatel keachat hammayim shebbenehem mekuddashin
Parah 6:1: Hamkaddesh venafal hakkiddush al yado o al hatztzad veachar kach nafal al hashshoket pasul nafal min hashshefoferet lashshoket pasul natal mishshefoferet vechissa o shehegif et haddelet hakkiddush kasher vehammayim pesulim zekafah baaretz pasul letoch yado kasher mippene sheefshar
Parah 6:2: Haya kiddush tzaf al pene hammayim rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim notel umkaddesh vachachamim omrim kol shennaga bammayim en mekaddeshin bo zalaf et hammayim venimtza kiddush millemattan rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim menaggev umkaddesh vachachamim omrim kol shennaga bammayim en mekaddeshin bo
Parah 6:3: Hamkaddesh bashshoket vehattefi vetochah af al pi sheppiv tzar kal shehu hammayim shebbetocho mekuddashin im haya sefog hammayim shebbetocho fesulim ketzad yaase yezallef ad shehu maggia lassefog naga bassefog af al pi shehammayim tzafin al gabbav kal shehen pesulin
Parah 6:4: Natan yado o raglo o ale yerakot kede sheyyaavru hammayim lechavit pesulim ale kanim vaale egoz kesherim ze hakkelal davar shehu mekabbel tuma pasul vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma kasher
Parah 6:5: Hamfanne et hammayan letoch haggat o letoch haggevim pesulim lazzavim velamtzoraim ulkaddesh bahen me chattat mippene shello nitmalleu vecheli
Parah 7:1: Chamishsha shemmilu chamishsha chaviyyot lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin venimlechu lekaddeshan kiddush echad o lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlechu lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin hare chullan kesherim yachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin venimlach lekaddeshan kiddush echad en kasher ella acharon lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlach lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin en kasher ella ze shekkiddesh rishon amar leechad kaddesh lecha et ellu en kasher ella rishon kaddesh li et ellu hare chullam kesherim
Parah 7:2: Hammalle veachat yado veose melacha veachat yado hammalle lo ulacher o shemmille lishnayim keachat shenehen pesulin shehammelacha foselet bammilluy ben lo ben leacher
Parah 7:3: Hamkaddesh beachat yado veose melacha veachat yado im lo pasul veim leacher kasher hamkaddesh lo ulacher shello pasul veshel acher kasher hamkaddesh lishnayim keechad shenehen kesherin
Parah 7:4: Kaddesh li vaakaddesh lach harishon kasher malle li vaamalle lach haacharon kasher kaddesh li vaamalle lach shenehem kesherim malle li vaakaddesh lach shenehem pesulim
Parah 7:5: Hammalle lo ulchattat memalle et shello techilla vekoshro vaesel veachar kach memalle et shel chattat veim mille shel chattat techilla veachar kach mille et shello pasul noten et shello laachorav veet shel chattat lefanav veim natan et shel chattat laachorav pasul hau shenehen shel chattat noten echad lefanav veechad laachorav vechasher mippene shei efshar
Parah 7:6: Hammolich et hachevel beyado ledarko kasher veshello ledarko pasul ze halach leyavne shelosha moadot uvmoed shelishi hichshiru lo horaat shaa
Parah 7:7: Hamchannen et hachevel al yad al yad kasher veim kinneno vaacharona pasul amar rabbi yose laze hichshiru horaat shaa
Parah 7:8: Hammatznia et hechavit shello tishshaver o shekkefaah al piha al menat lenaggevah lemallot bah kasher leholich bah et hakkiddush pasul hamfanne charasin mittoch hashshoket bishvil shettachazik mayim harbe kesherin veim bishvil shello yihu meakkevin oto veshaa shehu zolef et hammayim pasul
Parah 7:9: Mi shehau memav al ketefo vehora horaa vehera laacherim et hadderech veharag nachash veakrav venatal ochalim lehatzniam pasul ochalin leachlan kasher hannachash vehaakrav shehau meakkevim oto kasher amar rabbi yehuda ze hakkelal kal davar shehu mishshum melacha ben amad ben lo amad pasul davar sheeno mishshum melacha amad pasul veim lo amad kasher
Parah 7:10: Hammoser memav letame pesulin ultahor kesherin rabbi eliezer omer af letame kesherin im lo asu habbealim melacha
Parah 7:11: Shenayim shehau memallein lechattat vehigbihu ze al ze venatal ze laze kotzo bekiddush echad kasher bishne kiddushin pasul rabbi yose omer af bishne kiddushin kasher im hitnu venehen
Parah 7:12: Happoretz al menat ligdor kasher veim gadar pasul haochel al menat liktzot kasher veim katza pasul haya ochel vehotir vezarak ma shebbeyado letachat hatteena o letoch hammuktze bishvil shello yovad pasul
Parah 8:1: Shenayim shehau shomrim et hashshoket nitma achad mehem kesherim mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni tahar venitma sheni kesherim mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon nitmeu shenehen keachat pesulin asa achad mehen melacha kesherin mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni amad veasa hashsheni melacha kesherin mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon asu shenehen keechad pesulin
Parah 8:2: Hamkaddesh me chattat lo yinol et hassandal sheim naflu mashkin al hassandal nitma vetimmeahu hare hu omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani naflu mashkin al besaro tahor naflu al kesuto nitmet vetimmeattu hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Parah 8:3: Hassoref para ufarim vehamshalleach et hassair metamme vegadim para ufarim vesair hammishtalleach atzman en metammein begadim hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Parah 8:4: Haochel minnivlat haof hattahor vehi bevet habbelia metamme vegadim hannevela atzmah enah metammea vegadim hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Parah 8:5: Kal velad hattumot eno metamme chelim ella mashke nitma mashke timmean hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Parah 8:6: En keli cheres metamme chavero ella mashke nitma mashke timmeattu hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Parah 8:7: Kal happosel et hatteruma metamme et hammashkin lihot techilla letamme echad velifsol echad chutz mittevul yom hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Parah 8:8: Kal hayyammim kemikve shenneemar vrsht ulmikve hammayim kara yammim divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer hayyam haggadol kemikve lo neemar yammim ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harbe rabbi yose omer kal hayyammim metaharin bezochalin ufsulin lazzavim velamtzoraim ulkaddesh mehen me chattat
Parah 8:9: Hammayim hammukkim pesulim ellu hen hammukkim hammeluchim vehapposhrim hammayim hamchazzevim pesulin ellu hem hammayim hamchazzevim hamchazzevim echad bashshavua hamchazzevim befulmesaot uvishne vitztzaron kesherim rabbi yehuda fosel
Parah 8:10: Me karmeon ume fuga pesulin mippene shehem me vitztzim me hayyarden ume yarmuch pesulim mippene shehem me taarovot veelu hen me taarovot echad kasher veechad pasul shennitarvu shenehen kesherin venitarvu kesherin rabbi yehuda fosel
Parah 8:11: Beer achav umarat pamyas keshera hammayim shennishtannu veshinnuyan mechamat atzman kesherin ammat hammayim habbaa merachok keshera uvilvad sheyyishmerenna shello yafsikenna adam rabbi yehuda omer hare hi vechezkat mutteret beer shennafal letochah charsit o adama yamtin lah ad shettitztzal divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich lehamtin
Parah 9:1: Tzelochit shennafal letochah mayim kal shehen rabbi eliezer omer yazze shette hazzaot vachachamim poslin yarad letochah tal rabbi eliezer omer yannichenna vachamma vehattal ole vachachamim poslin nafal letochah mashkin ume ferot yeare vetzarich lenaggev deo komos vekankantom vechal davar shehu roshem yeare veeno tzarich lenaggev
Parah 9:2: Nafal letochah shekatzim urmasim venitbakkeu o shennishtannu marehem pesulin chippushit ben kach uven kach poselet mippene shehi chishfoferet rabbi shimon verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim haddira vehakkinna shebbattevua kesherim mippene sheen bahem lecha
Parah 9:3: Shatat mehen behema o chayya pesulin kal haofot poslin chutz min hayyona mippene shehi motzetzet kal hashsheratzim enam poslin chutz min hachulda mippene shehi malleket rabban gamliel omer af hannachash mippene shehi mekia rabbi eliezer omer af haachbar
Parah 9:4: Hachoshev al me chattat lishtot rabbi eliezer omer pasul rabbi yehoshua omer kesheyyatte amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bemayim sheenam mekuddashim aval bemayim hamkuddashin rabbi eliezer omer kesheyyatte rabbi yehoshua omer kesheyyishte veim girger kasher
Parah 9:5: Me chattat shennifselu lo yegabbelem betit shello yaasem takkala laacherim rabbi yehuda omer batlu para sheshshatat me chattat besarah tame meet leet rabbi yehuda omer batlu vemeeha
Parah 9:6: Me chattat veefer chattat lo yaavirem benahar uvisfina velo yeshitem al pene hammayim velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrekem letzad ze aval over hu vammayim ad tzavaro over hu hattahor lechattat uvyadav keli rekam hattahor lechattat uvmayim sheenam mekuddashin
Parah 9:7: Efer kasher shennitarev beefer mikle holchin achar harov letamme veen mekaddeshin bo rabbi eliezer omer mekaddeshin bechullan
Parah 9:8: Me chattat shennifselu metammein et hattahor litruma veyadav uvgufo veet hattahor lechattat lo veyadav velo vegufo nitmeu metammeim et hattahor litruma veyadav uvgufo veet hattahor lechattat beyadav aval lo vegufo
Parah 9:9: Efer kasher shennetano al gabbe hammayim sheenan reuyin lekaddesh metammein et hattahor litruma beyadav uvgufo et hattahor lechattat lo veyadav velo vegufo
Parah 10:1: Kol harauy littamme midras maddaf lechattat ben tame ben tahor veadam kayyotze vo kol harauy littamme teme met ben tame ben tahor rabbi eliezer omer eno maddaf rabbi yehoshua omer maddaf vachachamim omrim hattame maddaf vehattahor eno maddaf
Parah 10:2: Hattahor lechattat shennaga bemaddaf tame lagin shel chattat shennaga bemaddaf tame hattahor lechattat shennaga beochalim umashkim beyado tame uvraglo tahor hesitan beyado rabbi yehoshua metamme vachachamim metaharim

Parah 10:4: Hattahor lechattat shennaga betannur beyado tame uvraglo tahor haya omed al gabbe tannur ufashat yado chutz lattannur vehallagin betocho vechen haesel shehu natun al gabbe hattannur uvo shene kelalot echad mikkan veechad mikkan rabbi akiva metaher vachachamim metammein

Parah 10:6: Lagin shel chattat shennaga beshel kodesh veshel teruma shel chattat tame veshel kodesh veshel teruma tehorin shenehen bishte yadav shenehen temeim shenehem bishne neyarot shenehem tehorim shel chattat binyar veshel teruma beyado shenehen temein shel teruma binyar veshel chattat beyado shenehen tehorin rabbi yehoshua omer shel chattat tame hau netunin al gabbe haaretz venaga bahem shel chattat tame shel kodesh veshel teruma tehorim hesitan rabbi yehoshua metamme vachachamim metaharin
Parah 11:1: Tzelochit shehinnichah megulla uva umtzaah mechussa pesula hinnichah mechussa uva umtzaah megulla im yechola hachulda lishtot hemenna o nachash ledivre rabban gamliel o sheyyarad bah tal ballayela pesula hachattat enah nitztzola betzamid patil umayim sheenan mekuddashin nitztzolin betzamid patil

Parah 11:3: Devela shel teruma shennafla letoch me chattat untalah vaachalah im yesh bah kabbetza ben temea ben tehora hammayim temein vehaochlah chayyav mita en bah kabbetza hammayim tehorin vehaochlah chayyav mita rabbi yose omer bithora hammayim tehorim hattahor lechattat shehichnis rosho verubbo letoch me chattat nitma
Parah 11:4: Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre tora metamme et hakkodesh veet hatteruma veet hachullin veet hammaaser veasur al biat hammikdash leachar biato metamme et hakkodesh ufosel et hatteruma divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim posel bakkodesh uvatteruma umuttar bachullin uvammaaser veim ba el hammikdash ben lifne viato ben leachar biato chayyav
Parah 11:5: Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim metamme et hakkodesh ufosel et hatteruma umuttar bachullin uvammaaser divre rabbi meir vachachamim osrim bammaaser leachar biato muttar bechullan veim ba el hammikdash ben lifne viato uven leachar biato patur
Parah 11:6: Kol hattaun biat mayim ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim metamme et me chattat veet efer chattat veet hammazze me chattat bemagga uvmassa haezov hammuchshar vehammayim sheenan mekuddashim uchli rekam hattahor lechattat bemagga uvmassa divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim bemagga aval lo vemassa

Parah 11:8: Ezov shehizza vo kasher letaher bo et hammetzora likketo leetzim venaflu alav mashkin menaggevo vehu chasher likketo leochalin venaflu alav mashkin af al pi shenniggevo pasul likketo lechattat kimlukkat leochalin divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim kimlukkat leetzim

Parah 12:4: Hammazze mechallon shel rabbim venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulim patur mechallon shel yachid venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulin chayyav aval kohen gadol ben mechallon shel yachid ben mechallon shel rabbim patur sheen kohen gadol chayyav al biat hammikdash machalikin hau lifne challon shel rabbim vedorsin velo nimnain mippene sheamru me chattat sheasu mitzvatan enan metammein
Parah 12:5: Ochez hu hattahor bakkardom hattame bichnafo umazze alav af al pi sheyyesh alav kede hazzaya tahor kamma yehe vammayim veyihye vahem kede hazzaya kede sheyyatbil rashe givolin veyazze rabbi yehuda omer roim otam keillu hen al ezov shel nechoshet
Parah 12:6: Hammazze veezov tame im yesh bo chabbetza hammayim pesulim vehazzayato fesula en bo chabbetza hammayim kesherim vehazzayato fesula umtamme et chavero vachavero et chavero afillu hen mea
Parah 12:7: Hattahor lechattat shennitmeu yadav nitma gufo umtamme et chavero vachavero et chavero afillu hen mea

Tahorot 8:3: Hamabbed bayyom umatza vayyom tahor bayyom umatza vallayela ballayela umatza vayyom bayyom umatza vayyom shelleacharav tame ze hakkelal kol sheyyaavor alav hallayela o miktzato tame hashshoteach kelim birshut harabbim tehorin uvirshut hayyachid temein veim haya meshammeran tehorim naflu vehalach lahavian temeim nafal dalo letoch boro shel am haaretz vehalach lehavi vema yaalennu tame mippene shehunnach birshut am haaretz shaa echat
Tahorot 8:4: Hammanniach et beto fatuach umtzao fatuach naul umtzao naul patuach umtzao naul tahor naul umtzao fatuach rabbi meir metamme vachachamim metaharin shehau gannavim venimlechu vehalchu lahen
Tahorot 8:5: Eshet am haaretz shennichnesa letoch beto shel chaver lehotzi veno o vitto o vehemto habbayit tahor mippene shennichnesa shello virshut
Tahorot 8:6: Kelal amru vattahorot kol hamyuchad leochel adam tame ad sheyyippasel meochel hakkelev vechol sheeno meyuchad leochel adam tahor ad sheyeyachadennu leadam ketzad gozal shennafal legat vechishshav alav lehaaloto lenachri tame lechelev tahor rabbi yochanan ben nuri metamme chishshav alav cheresh shote vekatan tahor im heelahu tame sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava
Tahorot 8:7: Achore chelim shennitmeu vemashkim rabbi eliezer omer metammein et hammashkin veen poslin et haochalin rabbi yehoshua omer metammein et hammashkin ufoslin et haochalin shimon achi azarya omer lo chach velo chach ella mashkin shennitmeu vaachore hakkelim metammein echad ufoslin echad hare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani
Tahorot 8:8: Areva shehi ketafres vehabbatzek millemalan umashke tofeach millemattan shalosh chatichot bechabbetza enan mitztarfot ushtayim mitztarfot rabbi yose omer af shettayim enan mitztarfot ella im ken hau rotztzot mashke veim haya mashke omed afillu cheen hachardal mitztaref rabbi dosa omer ochel parud eno mitztaref
Tahorot 8:9: Makkel shehi melea mashkin temein kevan shehishshikah lammikve tehora divre rabbi yehoshua vachachamim omrim ad sheyyatbil et kullah hannitztzok vehakketafres umashke tofeach enan chibbur lo lattuma velo lattahora vehaeshboren chibbur lattuma velattahora
Tahorot 9:1: Zetim meematay mekabbelin tuma mishsheyyazziu zeat hammaatan aval lo zeat hakkuppa kedivre vet shammay rabbi shimon omer shiur zea shelosha yamim bet hillel omrim mishsheyyitchabberu shelosha ze laze rabban gamliel omer mishshettiggamer melachtan vachachamim omrim kidvarav
Tahorot 9:2: Gamar millimsok aval atid likkach gamar millikkach aval atid lilot ero evel o mishte o ones afillu zavim vezavot mehallechim alehen tehorin naflu alehen mashkin temein en tame ella mekom maggaan vehammochal hayyotze mehen tahor
Tahorot 9:3: Nigmera melachtan hare ellu muchsharin naflu alehen mashkin temein hammochal hayyotze mehen rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammein amar rabbi shimon lo nechleku al hammochal hayyotze min hazzetim shehu tahor veal ma nechleku al hayyotze min habbor sherabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammein
Tahorot 9:4: Haggomer et zetav veshiyyer kuppa achat yittenenna leani hakkohen divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer yolich et hammafteach miyyad rabbi shimon omer meet leet
Tahorot 9:5: Hammanniach zetim bakkotesh sheyyimtonu sheyehu nochin lichtosh hare ellu muchsharim sheyyimtonu sheyyimlachem bet shammay omrim muchsharim uvet hillel omrim enan muchsharim happotzea zetim beyadayim temeot timmean
Tahorot 9:6: Hammanniach zetav baggag legargeram afillu hen rum amma enan muchsharim netanan babbayit sheyyilku veatid lehaalotam laggag netanan baggag sheyyilku o sheyyiftechem hare ellu muchsharin netanan babbayit ad sheyeshammer et gaggo o ad sheyyolichem lemakom acher enan muchsharin
Tahorot 9:7: Ratza littol mehen bad echad o shene vaddin bet shammay omrim kotze vetuma umchappe vetahora bet hillel omrim af mechappe vetuma rabbi yose omer chofer bekardummot shel mattechet umolich levet habbad betuma
Tahorot 9:8: Hashsheretz shennimtza varechayim en tame ella mekom maggao im haya mashke mehallech hakkol tame nimtza al gabbe healim yishshaalu habbaddadim lomar lo naganu im haya nogea baom afillu vesaara tame
Tahorot 9:9: Nimtza al gabbe ferudim vehu nogea bechabbetza tame perudim al gabbe ferudim af al pi shehu nogea bechabbetza en tame ella mekom maggao nimtza ven kotel lazzetim tahor nimtza vaggag hammaatan tahor nimtza vammaatan haggag tame nimtza saruf al hazzetim vechen matlit mehuha tehora shekkal hattumot kishat metziatan
Tahorot 10:1: Hannoel bet habbad mippene habbaddadin vehau lesham kelim temein midras rabbi meir omer bet habbad tame rabbi yehuda omer bet habbad tahor rabbi shimon omer im tehorin lahen bet habbad tame veim temein lahen bet habbad tahor amar rabbi yose vechi mippene ma temeot ella sheen amme haaretz bekiin behesset
Tahorot 10:2: Habbaddadin shehau nichnasin veotzin umashkin temein betoch bet habbad im yesh ben mashkin lazzetim kede sheyenaggevu et raglehem baaretz hare ellu tehorin habbaddadin vehabbotzrin shennimtzet tuma lifnehem neemanin lomar lo naganu vechen hattinokot shebbenehem yotzim chutz lefetach bet habbad ufonin laachore haggader vehen tehorin ad kamma yarchiku veyihu tehorin ad kede sheyehe roan
Tahorot 10:3: Habbaddadin vehabbotzrin kevan shehichnisan lirshut hammeara dayyo divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer tzarich laamod alehen ad sheyyitbolu rabbi shimon omer im tehorin lahen tzarich laamod alehem ad sheyyitbolu im temeim lahen eno tzarich laamod alehem ad sheyyitbolu
Tahorot 10:4: Hannoten min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama bet shammay omrim noten beyadayim tehorot veim natan beyadayim temeot timmean bet hillel omrim noten beyadayim temeot umafrish terumato betahora min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim hakkol shavim shehu noten beyadayim tehorot veim natan beyadayim temeot timmean
Tahorot 10:5: Haochel min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama af al pi shemmevukkaot umnattefot laggat hare haggat tehora min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim venafal mimmennu garger yechidi im yesh lo chotam tahor im en lo chotam tame naflu mimmennu anavim udrachan bemakom hammufne kabbetza mechuvan tahor yoter mikkabbetza tame shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa harishona nitmet bechabbetza
Tahorot 10:6: Mi shehaya omed umdabber al sefat habbor venitteza tzinnora mippiv safek higgia labbor safek lo higgia sefeko tahor
Tahorot 10:7: Hazzolef et habbor nimtza sheretz barishona kullan temeot baacharona hi temea vechullan tehorot ematay bizman shehu zolef bechal achat veachat aval im haya zolef bemachatz nimtza sheretz beachat mehen hi temea bilvad ematay bizman shehu vodek velo mechasse o mechasse velo vodek haya vodek umchasse venimtza sheretz bechavit hakkol tame babbor hakkol tame bammachatz hakkol tame
Tahorot 10:8: Ben haiggulim lazzaggin reshut harabbim kerem shellifne habbotzrim reshut hayyachid shelleachar habbotzrim reshut harabbim ematay bizman sheharabbim nichnasim bazo veotzim bazo kele vet habbad veshel gat vehaekel bizman shehen shel etz menaggevan vehen tehorin bizman shehen shel gemi meyashshenan kal shenem asar chodesh o choltan bechammim rabbi yose omer im netanan beshibbolet hannahar dayyo
Mikvaot 1:1: Shesh maalot bammikvaot zo lemala mizzo vezo lemala mizzo me gevaim shata tame veshata tahor tame shata tame umille vichli tahor tame shata tame venafal kikkar shel teruma im hediach tame veim lo hediach tahor
Mikvaot 1:2: Mille vichli tame veshata tahor tame mille vichli tame umille vichli tahor tame mille vichli tame venafal kikkar shel teruma im hediach tame veim lo hediach tahor
Mikvaot 1:3: Naflu mayim temeim veshata tahor tame naflu mayim temeim umille vichli tahor tame naflu mayim temeim venafal kikkar shel teruma im hediach tame veim lo hediach tahor rabbi shimon omer ben shehediach ben shello hediach tame
Mikvaot 1:4: Nafal letochan met o shehalach bahen hattame veshata tahor tahor echad me gevaim me vorot me shichim me mearot me tamtziyyot sheppasku umikvaot sheen bahem arbaim sea bishat haggeshamim hakkol tahor pasku haggeshamim hakkerovim lair veladderech temeim veharchokim tehorin ad sheyehallechu rov bene adam
Mikvaot 1:5: Meematay tahoratan bet shammay omrim mishsheyyirbu veyishtofu uvet hillel omrim rabbu af al pi shello shatfu rabbi shimon omer shatfu af al pi shello rabbu kesherin lachalla velittol mehen layyadayim
Mikvaot 1:6: Lemala mehen me tamtziyyot shello fasku shata tame veshata tahor tahor shata tame umille vichli tahor tahor shata tame venafal kikkar shel teruma af al pi shehediach tahor mille vichli tame veshata tahor tahor mille vichli tame umille vichli tahor tahor mille vichli tame venafal kikkar shel teruma af al pi shehediach tahor naflu mayim temeim veshata tahor tahor naflu mayim temeim umille vichli tahor tahor naflu mayim temeim venafal kikkar shel teruma af al pi shehediach tahor kesherim latteruma velittol mehem layyadayim
Mikvaot 1:7: Lemala mehen mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea shebbo tovlin umatbilin lemala mehen mayan shemmemav muatin verabbu alav mayim sheuvin shave lammikve letaher beashboren velammayan lehatbil bo bechal shehu
Mikvaot 1:8: Lemala mehen mayim mukkin shehen metaharin bezochalin lemala mehen mayim chayyim shebbahen tevila lazzavim vehazzaya lamtzoraim uchsherim lekaddesh mehen me chattat
Mikvaot 2:1: Hattame sheyyarad litbol safek taval safek lo taval afillu taval safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo shene mikvaot echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad sheen bo taval beachad mehem veeno yodea beeze mehen taval sefeko tame
Mikvaot 2:2: Mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser kal tahorot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim temeot bamme devarim amurim betuma chamura aval betuma kalla kegon achal ochalim temeim veshata mashkin temeim ba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvim o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin veyarad litbol safek taval safek lo taval afillu taval safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo shene mikvaot echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad sheen bo taval beachad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen taval sefeko tahor rabbi yose metamme sherabbi yose omer kal davar shehu vechezkat tuma leolam hu vifsulo ad sheyyivada shettahar aval sefeko littame ultamme tahor
Mikvaot 2:3: Sefek mayim sheuvin shettiharu chachamim safek naflu safek lo naflu afillu naflu safek yesh bahem arbaim sea safek en bahem shene mikvaot echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad en bo nafal leachad mehen veeno yodea leeze mehen nafal sefeko tahor mippene sheyyesh lo vamme yitle hau shenehem pechutim mearbaim sea venafal leachad mehem veeno yodea leeze mehen nafal sefeko tame mippene sheen lo vamme yitle
Mikvaot 2:4: Rabbi eliezer omer reviit mayim sheuvin battechilla poslin et hammikve ushlosha luggin al pene hammayim vachachamim omrim ben battechilla ben bassof shiuro shelosha luggin
Mikvaot 2:5: Mikve sheyyesh bo shalosh gummot shel mayim sheuvin shel log log im yadua shennafal letocho arbaim sein mayim kesherin ad shello higgiu laggumma hashshelishit kasher veim lav pasul verabbi shimon machshir mippene shehu chemikve samuch lemikve
Mikvaot 2:6: Hamsannek et hattit latztzedadin umashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin kasher haya tolesh umashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin pasul verabbi shimon machshir mippene shello nitkaven lishov
Mikvaot 2:7: Hammanniach kankannim berosh haggag lenaggevan venitmalleu mayim rabbi eliezer omer im onat geshamim hi im yesh bo chimat mayim babbor yeshabber veim lav lo yeshabber rabbi yehoshua omer ben kach uven kach yeshabber o yichpe aval lo yeare
Mikvaot 2:8: Hassayyad sheshshachach atzitz babbor venitmalle mayim im hau hammayim tzafim al gabbav kal shehu yeshabber veim lav lo yeshabber divre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omer ben kach uven kach yeshabber
Mikvaot 2:9: Hamsadder kankannim betoch habbor venitmalleu mayim af al pi shebbala habbor et memav hare ze yeshabber
Mikvaot 2:10: Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim vatit rabbi eliezer omer matbilin bammayim veen matbilin battit rabbi yehoshua omer bammayim uvattit beeze tit matbilin betit shehammayim tzafim al gabbav hau hammayim mitztzad echad mode rabbi yehoshua shemmatbilin bammayim veen matbilin battit beeze tit amru betit shehakkane yored meelav divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer mekom sheen kene hammidda omed abba elazar ben dolay omer mekom shehammishkolet yoredet rabbi eliezer omer hayyored befi chavit rabbi shimon omer hannichnas bishfoferet hannod rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer hannimdad ballog
Mikvaot 3:1: Rabbi yose omer shene mikvaot sheen bahem arbaim sea venaflu laze log umechetza velaze log umechetza venitarvu kesherim mippene shello nikra alehen shem pesul aval mikve sheen bo arbaim sea venaflu vo shelosha luggin venechelak lishnayim pasul mippene shennikra alav shem pesul verabbi yehoshua machshir shehaya rabbi yehoshua omer kal mikve sheen bo arbaim sea venaflu lo shelosha luggin vechasar afillu kortov kasher mippene shechasru lo shelosha luggin vachachamim omrim leolam hu vifsulo ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo vaod
Mikvaot 3:2: Ketzad habbor shebbechatzer venaflu lo shelosha luggin leolam hu vifsulo ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo vaod o ad sheyyaamid bechatzer arbaim sea veyitharu haelonim min hattachtonim rabbi elazar ben azarya posel ella im ken pakak
Mikvaot 3:3: Bor shehu male mayim sheuvin vehaamma nichneset lo veotza mimmennu leolam hu vifsulo ad sheyyitchashshev shello nishtayyer min harishonim shelosha luggin shenayim shehau mattilin lammikve ze log umechetza vaze log umechetza hassochet et kesuto umattil mimmekomot harbe vehammeare min hatztzartzur umattil mimmekomot harbe rabbi akiva machshir vachachamim poslin amar rabbi akiva lo amru mattilin ella mattil amru lo lo chach velo chach amru ella shennaflu lo shelosha luggin
Mikvaot 3:4: Mikkeli echad mishshenayim umishshelosha mitztarfin umearbaa en mitztarfin baal keri hachole shennaflu alav tisha kabbin mayim vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin mikkeli echad mishshenayim umishshelosha mitztarfin mearbaa en mitztarfin bamme devarim amurim bizman shehitchil hashsheni ad shello fasak harishon uvamme devarim amurim bizman shello nitkaven lerabbot aval nitkaven lerabbot afillu kortov bechal hashshana mitztarfin lishlosha luggin
Mikvaot 4:1: Hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor echad kelim gedolim veechad kelim ketannim afillu chele gelalim kele avanim kele adama poslin et hammikve echad hammanniach veechad hashshocheach kedivre vet shammay uvet hillel metaharin beshocheach amar rabbi meir nimnu verabbu vet shammay al bet hillel umodim beshocheach bechatzer shehu tahor amar rabbi yose adayin machaloket bimkomah omadet
Mikvaot 4:2: Hammanniach tavla tachat hatztzinnor im yesh lah levizbez poselet et hammikve veim lav enah poselet et hammikve zekafah liddoach ben kach uven kach enah poselet et hammikve
Mikvaot 4:3: Hachotet betzinnor lekabbel tzerorot beshel etz kal shehu uvshel cheres reviit rabbi yose omer af beshel cheres kal shehu lo amru reviit ella veshivre chele cheres hau tzerorot mitchalchalim betocho poslim et hammikve yarad letocho afar venichbash kasher sillon shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav min haemtza eno fosel mippene shello naasa lekabbala
Mikvaot 4:4: Mayim sheuvin ume geshamim shennitarvu vechatzer uvaukka veal maalot hammeara im rov min hakkasher kasher veim rov min happasul pasul mechetza lemechetza pasul ematay bizman shemmitarvin ad shello yaggiu lammikve hau mekallechin betoch hammayim im yadua shennafal letocho arbaim sea mayim kesherim ad shello yarad letocho shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin kasher veim lav pasul
Mikvaot 4:5: Hashshoket shebbassela en memallein mimmenna veen mekaddeshin bah veen mazzin mimmenna veenah tzericha tzamid patil veenah poselet et hammikve hayeta cheli vechibberah besid memallein bah umkaddeshin bah umazzin mimmenna utzricha tzamid patil ufoselet et hammikve nikkeva millematta o min hatztzad veenah yechola lekabbel mayim kal shehem keshera vechamma yihye vannekev kishfoferet hannod amar rabbi yehuda ben betera maase veshoket yehu shehayeta virushalayim vehayeta nekuva chishfoferet hannod vehau chal hattahorot shebbirushalayim naasot al gabbah veshalchu vet shammay ufchatuha shebbet shammay omrim ad sheyyifchatu rubbah
Mikvaot 5:1: Mayan sheheeviro al gabbe hashshoket pasul heeviro al gabbe safa chal shehu kasher chutza lah shehammayan metaher bechal shehu heeviro al gabbe verecha vehifsiko hare hu chemikve chazar vehimshicho pasul lazzavim velamtzoraim ulkaddesh mehen me chattat ad sheyyeda sheyyatzu harishonim
Mikvaot 5:2: Heeviro al gabbe chelim o al gabbe safsal rabbi yehuda omer hare hu chemo shehaya rabbi yose omer hare hu chemikve uvilvad shello yatbil al gabbe hassafsal
Mikvaot 5:3: Mayan shehu mashuch kenadal ribba alav vehimshicho hare hu chemo shehaya haya omed veribba alav vehimshicho shave lemikve letaher beashboren ulmayan lehatbil bo bechal shehu
Mikvaot 5:4: Kal hayyammim kemikve shenneemar vrsht ulmikve hammayim kara yammim divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer hayyam haggadol kemikve lo neemar yammim ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harbe rabbi yose omer kal hayyammim metaharim bezochalin ufsulin lazzavin velamtzoraim ulkaddesh mehem me chattat
Mikvaot 5:5: Hazzochalin kemayan vehannotfim kemikve heid rabbi tzadok al hazzochalin sherabbu al hannotfim shehem kesherim venotfim sheasaan zochalin somech afillu makkel afillu kane afillu zav vezava yored vetovel divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer kal davar shehu mekabbel tuma en mazchilin bo
Mikvaot 5:6: Gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea venafal al haadam veal hakkelim tehorim kal makom sheyyesh bo arbaim sea tovlin umatbilin matbilin bacharitzin uvinatzim uvfarsat hachamor hamorevet babbika bet shammay omrim matbilin bechardalit bet hillel omrim en matbilin umodim shehu goder kelim vetovel bahem vechelim sheggadar bahem lo hutbelu
Mikvaot 6:1: Kal hamorav lammikve kammikve chore hammeara vesidke hammeara matbil bahem kema shehem ukkat hammeara en matbilin bah ella im ken hayeta nekuva chishfoferet hannod amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehi maamedet atzmah aval im enah maamedet atzmah matbilin bah kema shehi
Mikvaot 6:2: Deli shehu male chelim vehitbilan hare ellu tehorim veim lo taval en hammayim meoravin ad sheyyihu meoravin kishfoferet hannod
Mikvaot 6:3: Shelosha mikvaot baze esrim sea uvaze esrim sea uvaze esrim sea mayim sheuvin vehashshauv min hatztzad veyardu shelosha vetavlu vahen venitarvu hammikvaot tehorin vehattovlim tehorim haya hashshauv baemtza veyardu shelosha vetavlu vahem venitarvu hammikvaot kemot shehau vehattovlim kemot shehau
Mikvaot 6:4: Hassefog vehaddeli shehau vahen shelosha luggin mayim venaflu lammikve lo fesaluhu shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu
Mikvaot 6:5: Hashshidda vehatteva shebbayyam en matbilin bahem ella im ken hau nekuvin kishfoferet hannod rabbi yehuda omer bichli gadol arbaa tefachim uvkatan rubbo im haya sak o kuppa matbilin bahem kema shehem mippene shehammayim meoravin hau netunim tachat hatztzinnor enam poslim et hammikve ella matbilin otan umaalin otan kedarkan
Mikvaot 6:6: Gistera shebbammikve vehitbil bah et hakkelim taharu mittumatan aval temeim al gav keli cheres im hau hammayim tzafim al gabbav kal shehen tehorin mayan hayyotze min hattannur veyarad vetaval betocho hu tahor veyadav temeot veim hau al gabbav rum yadav af yadav tehorot
Mikvaot 6:7: Eruv mikvaot kishfoferet hannod keavyah vechachalalah kishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman safek kishfoferet hannod safek sheenah kishfoferet hannod pesula mippene shehi min hattora vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz kol sheyyaamod kishfoferet hannod memaatah rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim tahor
Mikvaot 6:8: Metaharim et hammikvaot haelon min hattachton veharachok min hakkarov ketzad mevi sillon shel cheres o shel avar umanniach yado tachtav ad shehu mitmalle mayim umoshcho umashshiko afillu chassaara dayyo haya vaelon arbaim sea uvattachton en kelum memalle vakkatef venoten laelon ad sheyyerdu lattachton arbaim sea
Mikvaot 6:9: Kotel shebben shette mikvaot shennisdak lashsheti mitztaref velaerev en mitztaref ad sheyehe vemakom echad kishfoferet hannod rabbi yehuda omer chilluf haddevarim nifretzu ze vetoch ze al rum kiklippat hashshum veal rochav kishfoferet hannod
Mikvaot 6:10: Haavik shebbammerchatz bizman shehu vaemtza posel min hatztzad eno fosel mippene shehu chemikve samuch lemikve divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim im mekabbelet haambati reviit ad shello yaggiu laavik kasher veim lav pasul rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer im mekabbel haavik kal shehu pasul
Mikvaot 6:11: Hammatheret shebbammerchatz hattachtona melea sheuvin vehaelona melea chesherin im yesh keneged hannekev shelosha luggin pasul kamma yehe vannekev veyihye vo shelosha luggin achad mishshelosh meot veesrim labberecha divre rabbi yose verabbi elazar omer afillu hattachtona melea chesherim vehaelona melea sheuvin veyesh betzad hannekev shelosha luggin kasher shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu
Mikvaot 7:1: Yesh maalin et hammikve velo foslin poslin velo maalin lo maalin velo foslin ellu maalin velo foslin hashsheleg vehabbarad vehakkefor vehaggelid vehammelach vehattit hannarok amar rabbi akiva haya rabbi yishmael dan kenegdi lomar hashsheleg eno maale et hammikve veheidu anshe medva mishshemo sheamar lahem tzeu vehaviu sheleg vaasu mikve battechilla rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer even habbarad kammayim ketzad maalin velo foslin mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat nafal mehem sea letocho veheelahu nimtzeu maalin velo foslin
Mikvaot 7:2: Ellu foslin velo maalin hammayim ben temeim ben tehorim ume chevashim ume shelakot vehattemed ad shello hechemitz ketzad poslin velo maalin mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser kortov venafal mehen kortov letocho lo heelahu poslo vishlosha luggin aval shear hammashkin ume ferot vehatztzir vehammuryas vehattemed mishshehechemitz peamim maalin ufamim sheenan maalin ketzad mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat nafal letocho sea mehem lo heelahu hau vo arbaim sea natan sea venatal sea hare ze chasher
Mikvaot 7:3: Hediach bo salle zetim vesalle anavim veshinnu et marav kasher rabbi yose omer me hatztzeva poslin oto vishlosha luggin veenan poslin oto veshinnuy mare nafal letocho yayin umochal veshinnu et marav pasul ketzad yaase yamtin lo ad sheyyerdu geshamim veyachzeru marehen lemare hammayim hau vo arbaim sea memalle vakkatef venoten letocho ad sheyyachzeru marehen lemare hammayim
Mikvaot 7:4: Nafal letocho yayin o mochal veshinnu miktzat marav im en bo mare mayim arbaim sea hare ze lo yitbol bo
Mikvaot 7:5: Shelosha luggin mayim venafal letochan kortov yayin vahare marehen kemare hayyayin venaflu lemikve lo fesaluhu shelosha luggin mayim chaser kortov venafal letochan kortov chalav vahare marehen kemare hammayim venaflu lemikve lo fesaluhu rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer hakkol holech achar hammare
Mikvaot 7:6: Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvanot yardu shenayim vetavlu ze achar ze harishon tahor vehashsheni tame rabbi yehuda omer im hau raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim af hashsheni tahor hitbil bo et hassagos veheelahu miktzato nogea bammayim tahor hakkar vehakkeset shel or kevan shehigbiha siftotehem min hammayim hammayim shebbetochan sheuvin ketzad yaase matbilan umaale otam derech shulehem
Mikvaot 7:7: Hitbil bo et hammitta af al pi sheragleha shokot battit heave tehora mippene shehammayim mekaddemin mikve shemmemav meruddadin kovesh afillu chavile etzim afillu chavile kanim kede sheyyitpechu hammayim veored vetovel machat shehi netuna al maalot hammeara haya molich umevi vammayim kevan sheavar aleha haggal tehora
Mikvaot 8:1: Eretz yisrael tehora umikveoteha tehorim mikveot haammim shebbechutza laaretz kesherim levaale kerayin afillu nitmalleu vekilon shebbeeretz yisrael shechutz lammafteach kesherim af leniddot millifnim min hammafteach kesherim levaale kerayin ufsulim lechal hattemeim rabbi eliezer omer hakkerovim lair veladderech temeim mippene hakkevisa veharchokim tehorim
Mikvaot 8:2: Ellu vaale kerayin shehem tzerichin tevila raa mayim chalukim o achurim battechilla tahor baemtza uvassof tame mittechilla vead sof tahor levanim venimshachim tame rabbi yose omer levanim kaachurim
Mikvaot 8:3: Hammetil tippin avot mittoch haamma tame divre rabbi elazar chisma hamharher ballayela veamad umatza vesaro cham tame happoletet zera bayyom hashshelishi tehora divre rabbi elazar ben azarya rabbi yishmael omer peamim shehem arba onot peamim shehem chamesh peamim shehem shesh rabbi akiva omer leolam chamesh
Mikvaot 8:4: Nachrit sheppalta shichvat zera miyyisrael temea bat yisrael sheppalta shichvat zera minnachri tehora haishsha sheshshimmesha vetah veyarda vetavla velo chibbeda et habbayit keillu lo tavla baal keri shettaval velo hetil et hammayim kesheyatil et hammayim tame rabbi yose omer bechole uvzaken tame beyeled uvvari tahor
Mikvaot 8:5: Nidda shennatna maot befiha veyarda vetavla tehora mittumatah aval temea hi al gav rukkah natna searah befiha kaftza yadah kartza siftoteha keillu lo tavla haochez beadam uvchelim umatbilan temein veim hediach et yado bammayim tehorim rabbi shimon omer yerappe kede sheyyavou vahem mayim bet hassetarim bet hakkematim enan tzerichin sheyyavou vahen mayim
Mikvaot 9:1: Ellu chotztzin baadam chute tzemer vechute fishtan vehartzuot shebberashe habbanot rabbi yehuda omer shel tzemer veshel sear enam chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahem
Mikvaot 9:2: Kilke hallev vehazzakan uvet hassetarim baishsha lifluf shechutz laayin vegeled shechutz lammakka vehartiyya shealeha usraf hayyavesh vegilde tzoa sheal besaro uvatzek shettachat hatztzipporen vehammilmulin vetit hayyaven vetit hayyotzrim vegetz yeveni ezehu tit hayyaven ze tit habborot shenneemar tehillim m vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven tit hayyotzrin kemashmao rabbi yose metaher beshel yotzrin umtamme beshel mareka vegetz yeveni ellu yitdot hadderachim sheen tovlin bahen velo matbilin otan ushar kal hattit matbilin bo keshehu lach velo yitbol baavak sheal raglav lo yitbol et hakkumkemus bappechamin ella im ken shifshef
Mikvaot 9:3: Ellu sheen chotztzin kilke harosh uvet hashshechi uvet hassetarim baish rabbi eliezer omer echad haish veechad haishsha kal hammakpid alav chotzetz vesheen makpid alav en chotzetz
Mikvaot 9:4: Lifluf shebbaayin vegeled sheal hammakka usraf hallach velichluche tzoa sheal besaro vetzoa shettachat hatztzipporen vetzipporen hamduldelet keshut shel katan lo tame velo metamme kerum sheal hammakka tame umtamme
Mikvaot 9:5: Ellu chotztzim bakkelim hazzefet vehammor bichle zechuchit ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz al hashshulchan veal hattavla veal haddargash al hannekiyyim chotztzin al habbelusin enan chotztzin al mittot baal habbayit chotzetz veal shel ani eno chotzetz al ikkuf shel baal habbayit chotzetz veal shel zakkakin eno chotzetz veal hammardaat chotzetz rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ad keissar haitalki
Mikvaot 9:6: Al habbegadim mitztzad echad eno chotzetz mishshene tzedadin chotzetz rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yishmael af mitztzad echad rabbi yose omer shel bannaim mitztzad echad veshel bur mishshene tzedadin
Mikvaot 9:7: Mitpachat shel zappatin veshel yotzrin veshel mefassele ilanot en chotztzin rabbi yehuda omer af shel kayyatzin kayyotze vahen ze hakkelal kal hammakpid alav chotzetz vesheeno makpid alav eno chotzetz
Mikvaot 10:1: Kal yedot hakkelim shehichnisan shello chedarkan o shehichnisan kedarkan velo merkan o shemmerkan venishberu hare ellu chotztzin keli shehitbilo derech piv keillu lo taval hitbilo chedarko velo zibborit ad sheyyattennu al tziddo keli shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav min haemtza eno tahor ad sheyyattennu al tziddo tzelochit sheppiha shokea enah tehora ad sheyenakkevenna mitztziddah kalmarin hedotot enah tehora ad sheyenakkevenna mitztziddah vekalmarin shel yosef hakkohen hayeta nekuva vetziddah
Mikvaot 10:2: Hakkar vehakkeset shel or hare ellu tzerichin sheyyavou vahem hammayim keset agulla vehakkaddur vehaemum vehakkamea vehattefilla enan tzerichin sheyyavou vahem hammayim ze hakkelal kol sheen darko lehachnis ulhotzi tovlim setumim
Mikvaot 10:3: Ellu sheenam tzerichim sheyyavou vahem hammayim kishre heani vehannimin vachavat shel sandal utfilla shel rosh bizman shehi chotza veshel zeroa bizman sheenah ola veoredet veazne hachemet veazne hattarmul
Mikvaot 10:4: Ellu shehem tzerichim sheyyavou vahen hammayim hakkesher shebbapperaksim shebbakkatef vesafa shel sadin tzarich lematteach utfilla shel rosh bizman sheenah chotza veshel zeroa bizman shehi ola veoredet ushnatzin shel sandal uvgadim shehitbilan mechubbasin ad sheyevabeu hitbilan neguvin ad sheyevabeu veyanuchu mibbibuan
Mikvaot 10:5: Kal yedot hakkelim shehem arukkin veatid liktzotz matbilan ad mekom hammidda rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyatbil et kullo shalshelet deli gadol arbaa tefachim veshel katan asara matbilan ad mekom hammidda rabbi tarfon omer ad sheyyatbil et kal hattabbaat hachevel shehu kashur bakkuppa eno chibbur ella im ken tafar
Mikvaot 10:6: Bet shammay omrim en matbilin chammin betzonen velo tzonen bechammin lo yafim beraim velo raim beyafim bet hillel omrim matbilin keli shehu male mashkin vehitbilo keillu lo taval male me raglayim roim otam keillu hem mayim male me chattat ad sheyyirbu hammayim al me chattat rabbi yose omer afillu cheli machazik kor veen bo ella reviit keillu lo taval
Mikvaot 10:7: Kal haochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya bechachatzi feras kal hammashkin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya birviit ze chomer beshote mashkin temein mibbammikve sheasu vo shear hammashkin kammayim
Mikvaot 10:8: Achal ochalim temeim veshata mashkim temeim taval vehekian temeim mippene sheenan tehorim bagguf shata mayim temeim taval vehekiam tehorim mippene shehem tehorim bagguf bala tabbaat tehora nichnas leohel hammet hizza veshana vetaval vehekiah hare hi chemot shehayeta bala tabbaat temea tovel veochel batteruma hekiah temea vetimmeattu chetz shehu tachuv baadam bizman shehu nire chotzetz veim eno nire tovel veochel bitrumato
Niddah 1:1: Shammay omer kal hannashim dayyan sheatan hillel omer mippekida lifkida vaafillu leyamim harbe vachachamim omrim lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze ella meet leet memaet al yad mippekida lifkida umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet kal ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah sheatah vehamshammeshet beiddim hare zo chifkida ummaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida
Niddah 1:2: Ketzad dayyah sheatah hayeta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka vetahorot ufersha veraata hi temea vechullan tehorot af al pi sheamru metammea meet leet enah mona ella mishshaa sheraata
Niddah 1:3: Rabbi eliezer omer arba nashim dayyan sheatan betula meubberet menika uzkena amar rabbi yehoshua ani lo shamati ella vetula aval halacha kerabbi eliezer
Niddah 1:4: Ezo hi vetula kol shello raata dam miyyameha af al pi shennesua meubberet mishsheyyivada ubbarah menika ad shettigmol et benah natna venah lemenika gemalattu o met rabbi meir omer metammea meet leet vachachamim omrim dayyah sheatah
Niddah 1:5: Ezohi zekena kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot samuch leziknatah rabbi eliezer omer kal ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot dayyah sheatah rabbi yose omer meubberet umenika sheavru alehen shalosh onot dayyan sheatan
Niddah 1:6: Uvamme amru dayyah sheatah biriyya rishona aval bashsheniyya metammea meet leet veim raata harishona meones af hashsheniyya dayyah sheatah
Niddah 1:7: Af al pi sheamru dayyah sheatah tzericha lihot bodeket chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar umshammeshet beiddim chutz miyyoshevet al dam tohar uvtula sheddameha tehorim ufaamayim tzericha lihot bodeket beshacharit uven hashshemashot uvshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah yetera alehen kohanot beshaa shehen ochlot batteruma rabbi yehuda omer af bishat avaratan milleechol batteruma
Niddah 2:1: Kal hayyad hammarba livdok benashim meshubbachat uvaanashim tikkatzetz hachereshet vehashshota vehassuma veshennitrefa datah im yesh lahen pikchot metakkenot otan vehen ochlot batteruma derech benot yisrael meshammeshot bishne iddim echad lo veechad lah hatztzenuot metakkenot lahen shelishi letakken et habbayit
Niddah 2:2: Nimtza al shello temein vechayyavin karban nimtza al shellah otom temein vechayyavin karban nimtza al shellah leachar zeman temeim missafek ufturim min hakkarban
Niddah 2:3: Ezehu achar zeman kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha veachar kach metammea meet leet veenah metammea et boalah rabbi akiva omer af metammea et boalah umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa chetem shemmetammea et boalah
Niddah 2:4: Kal hannashim bechezkat tahora levaalehen habbain min hadderech neshehen lahen bechezkat tahora bet shammay omrim tzericha shene iddim al kal tashmish vetashmish o teshammesh leor hanner bet hillel omrim dayyah bishne iddim kal hallayela
Niddah 2:5: Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha hacheder vehapperozdor vehaaliyya dam hacheder tame nimtza vapperozdor sefeko tame lefi shechezkato min hammakor
Niddah 2:6: Chamishsha damim temeim baishsha haadom vehashshachor uchkeren karkom uchmeme adama uchmazug bet shammay omrim af kememe tiltan uchmeme vasar tzali uvet hillel metaharin hayyarok akavya ven mahalalel metamme vachachamim metaharim amar rabbi meir im eno metamme mishshum ketem metamme mishshum mashke rabbi yose omer lo chach velo chach
Niddah 2:7: Ezehu adom kedam hammakka shachor kacheret amok mikkan tame dehe mikkan tahor uchkeren karkom kabbarur shebbo uchmeme adama mibbikat bet kerem umetzif mayim uchmazug shene chalakim mayim veechad yayin min hayyayin hashsharoni
Niddah 3:1: Hammappelet chaticha im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach temea
Niddah 3:2: Hammappelet kemin kelippa kemin saara kemin afar kemin yavchushim adummim tattil lammayim im nimmochu temea veim lav tehora hammappelet kemin dagim chagavim shekatzim urmasim im yesh immahem dam temea veim lav tehora hammappelet min behema chayya vaof ben temein ben tehorim im zachar teshev lezachar veim nekeva teshev linkeva veim en yadua teshev lezachar velinkeva divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam eno valad
Niddah 3:3: Hammappelet shefir male mayim male dam male genunim enah chosheshet levalad veim haya merukkam teshev lezachar velinkeva
Niddah 3:4: Hammappelet sandal o shilya teshev lezachar velinkeva shilya babbayit habbayit tame lo shehashshilya valad ella sheen shilya velo valad rabbi shimon omer nimmok havalad ad shello yatza
Niddah 3:5: Hammappelet tumtum veanderoginos teshev lezachar velinkeva tumtum vezachar anderoginos vezachar teshev lezachar velinkeva tumtum unkeva anderoginos unkeva teshev linkeva vilvad yatza mechuttach o mesoras mishsheyyatza rubbo hare hu cheyalud yatza chedarko ad sheyyetze rov rosho veezehu rov rosho mishshettetze faddachto
Niddah 3:6: Hammappelet veen yadua ma hu teshev lezachar velinkeva en yadua im valad haya im lav teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda
Niddah 3:7: Hammappelet leom arbaim enah chosheshet levalad leom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda rabbi yishmael omer yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar ulnidda yom shemonim veechad teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda shehazzachar nigmar learbaim veechad vehannekeva lishmonim veechad vachachamim omrim echad beriyyat hazzachar veechad beriyyat hannekeva ze vaze learbaim veechad
Niddah 4:1: Benot kutim niddot mearisatan vehakkutim metammeim mishkav tachton kaelon mippene shehen boale niddot vehen yoshvot al kal dam vadam veen chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma mippene shettumatan safek
Niddah 4:2: Benot tzedokin bizman shennahagu lalechet bedarche avotehen hare hen kechutiyyot pershu lalechet bedarche yisrael hare hen keyisreelit rabbi yose omer leolam hen keyisrael ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen
Niddah 4:3: Dam nachrit vedam tahora shel metzoraat bet shammay metaharim uvet hillel omrim kerukkah uchmeme ragleha dam yoledet shello tavla bet shammay omrim kerukkah uchmeme ragleha uvet hillel omrim metamme lach veyavesh umodim beoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh
Niddah 4:4: Hammaksha nidda kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom veshafta meet leet veyalda hare zo yoledet bezov divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer layela vaom kelele shabbat veomo sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam
Niddah 4:5: Kamma hu kishshuyah rabbi meir omer afillu arbaim vachamishshim yom rabbi yehuda omer dayyah chadshah rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim en kishshuy yoter mishshette shabbatot
Niddah 4:6: Hammaksha vetoch shemonim shel nekeva kal damim shehi roa tehorim ad sheyyetze havalad verabbi eliezer metamme amru lo lerabbi eliezer uma bimkom shehechmir bedam hashshofi hekel bedam hakkoshi mekom shehekel bedam hashshofi eno din shennakel bedam hakkoshi amar lahen dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon mimma hekel aleha mittumat ziva aval temea tumat nidda
Niddah 4:7: Kal achad asar yom bechezkat tahora yashva lah velo vadka shagga neensa hezida velo vadka tehora higgia sheat vistah velo vadka hare zo temea rabbi meir omer im hayeta vemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo vadka hare zo tehora mippene shecharada mesalleket et haddamim aval yeme hazzav vehazzava veshomeret yom keneged yom hare ellu bechezkat tuma
Niddah 5:1: Yotze dofen en yoshvin alav yeme tuma vime tahora veen chayyavin alav karban rabbi shimon omer hare ze cheyalud kal hannashim mittammeot babbayit hachitzon shenneemar vkr tyt dam yihye zovah bivsarah aval hazzav uvaal keri enan mittammeim ad shettetze tumatan lachutz
Niddah 5:2: Haya ochel batteruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma umtammeim bechal shehu afillu cheen hachardal uvfachot mikkan
Niddah 5:3: Tinoket bat yom echad mittammea venidda bat asara yamim mittammea veziva tinok ben yom echad mittamme veziva umittamme vingaim umittamme vitme met vezokek leyibbum ufoter min hayyibbum umaachil batteruma ufosel min hatteruma venochel umanchil vehahorgo chayyav vahare hu leaviv ulimmo ulchal kerovav kechatan shalem
Niddah 5:4: Bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia veim ba aleha yavam kenaah vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish umtammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton kaelon nisset lechohen tochal batteruma ba aleha achad min happesulim pesalah min hakkehunna ba aleha achad mikkal haaraot haamurot battora mumatin al yadah vehi fetura pachot mikkan kenoten etzba baayin
Niddah 5:5: Ben tesha shanim veom echad shebba al yevimto kenaah veeno noten get ad sheyyagdil umittamme venidda letamme mishkav tachton kaelon ufosel veeno maachil batteruma ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach veniskelet al yado veim ba al achat mikkal haaraot haamurot battora mumatim al yado vehu fatur
Niddah 5:6: Bat achat esre shana veom echad nedareha nivdakin bat shettem esre shana veom echad nedareha kayyamin uvodkin kal shettem esre ben shettem esre shana veom echad nedarav nivdakim ben shelosh esre shana veom echad nedarav kayyamin uvodkin kal shelosh esre kodem lazzeman hazze af al pi sheamru yodin anu leshem mi nadarnu leshem mi hikdashnu en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh leachar hazzeman hazze af al pi sheamru en anu yodin leshem mi nadarnu leshem mi hikdashnu nidran neder vehekdeshan hekdesh
Niddah 5:7: Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha pagga bochal vetzemel pagga odah tinoket bochal ellu yeme neureha bazo uvazo aviha zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha tzemel kevan shebbagra shuv en leaviha reshut bah
Niddah 5:8: Ezehu simaneha rabbi yose haggelili omer mishsheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad rabbi akiva omer mishsheyyattu haddaddim ben azzay omer mishshettashchir happittomet rabbi yose omer kede sheyehe noten yado al haoketz vehu shokea veshohe lachazor
Niddah 5:9: Bat esrim shana shello hevia shette searot tavi reaya shehi vat esrim shana vehi ayelonit lo choletzet velo mityabbemet ben esrim shana shello hevi shette searot yavi reaya shehu ven esrim shana vehu saris lo choletz velo meyabbem ellu divre vet hillel bet shammay omrim ze vaze bene shemone esre rabbi eliezer omer hazzachar kedivre vet hillel vehannekeva kedivre vet shammay shehaishsha memaheret lavo lifne haish
Niddah 6:1: Ba siman hattachton ad shello va haelon o choletzet o mityabbemet ba haelon ad shello va hattachton af al pi shei efshar rabbi meir omer lo choletzet velo mityabbemet vachachamim omrim o choletzet o mityabbemet mippene sheamru efshar lattachton lavo ad shello va haelon aval i efshar laelon lavo ad shello va hattachton
Niddah 6:2: Kayyotze vo kal keli cheres shehu machnis motzi veyesh shemmotzi veeno machnis kal evar sheyyesh bo tzipporen yesh bo etzem veyesh sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen
Niddah 6:3: Kol hammittamme midras mittamme teme met veyesh shemmittamme teme met veeno mittamme midras
Niddah 6:4: Kol harauy ladun dine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot veyesh sherauy ladun dine mamonot veeno rauy ladun dine nefashot kol hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid veyesh shekkasher lehaid veeno chasher ladun
Niddah 6:5: Kol shechayyav bammaasrot mittamme tumat ochalim veyesh shemmittamme tumat ochalin veeno chayyav bammaasrot
Niddah 6:6: Kol shechayyav bappea chayyav bammaasrot veyesh shechayyav bammaasrot veeno chayyav bappea

Niddah 8:3: Maase veishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva amra lo raiti chatem amar lah shemma makka hayeta vich amra lo hen vechayeta amar lah shemma yechola lehiggala ulhotzi dam amra lo hen vetiharah rabbi akiva raa talmidav mistakkelin ze vaze amar lahem ma haddavar kashe veenechem shello amru chachamim haddavar lehachmir ella lehakel shenneemar vkr tv veishsha ki tihye zava dam yihye zovah bivsarah dam velo chatem

Niddah 9:1: Haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha veraata dam rabbi meir omer im omedet temea veim yoshevet tehora rabbi yose omer ben kach uven kach tehora

Niddah 9:5: Shalosh nashim shehau yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat haemtzait kullan temeot tachat happenimit shettayim happenimiyyot temeot vehachitzona tehora tachat hachitzona shettayim hachitzonot temeot vehappenimit tehora amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheavru derech margelot hammitta aval im avru shelashtan derech aleha kullan temeot badka achat mehen venimtzet tehora hi tehora ushtayim temeot badku shettayim umatzu tehorot hen tehorot vehashshelishit temea shelashtan umatzu tehorot kullan temeot lema haddavar dome legal tame shennitarev ben shene gallim tehorim uvadku achad mehen umatzu tahor hu tahor ushnayim temein shenayim umatzu tehorim hem tehorim vehashshelishi tame shelashtan umatzu tehorim kullan temeim divre rabbi meir shehaya rabbi meir omer kal davar shehu vechezkat tuma leolam hu vetumato ad sheyyivada lecha tuma hechan hi vachachamim omrim bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula
Niddah 9:6: Shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem rok tafel ume gerisin ume raglayim veneter uvorit kemunya veeshlag hitbilo veasa al gabbav tahorot heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar hare ze tzeva hattahorot tehorot veeno tzarich lehatbil avar o sheddeha hare ze chetem vehattahorot temeot vetzarich lehatbil
Niddah 9:7: Ezehu rok tafel kol shello taam kelum me gerisin leissat gerisin shel pol chalukat nafesh me raglayim shehechemitzu vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim lechal echad veechad heeviran shello chesidran o sheheevir shiva sammanin keachat lo asa velo chelum
Niddah 9:8: Kal ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah sheatah veellu hen havvesatot mefaheket umatteshet vechosheshet befi cheresah uvshippule meeha veshofaat uchmin tzemarmorot ochazin otah vechen kayyotze vahen vechol shekkava lah shalosh peamim hare zo vaset
Niddah 9:9: Hayeta lemuda lihot roa vitchillat havvesatot kal hattahorot sheasta vetoch havvesatot temeot besof havvesatot kal hattahorot sheasta vetoch havvesatot tehorot rabbi yose omer af yamim veshaot vesatot hayeta lemuda lihot roa im hanetz hachamma enah asura ella im hanetz hachamma rabbi yehuda omer kal hayyom shellah
Niddah 9:10: Hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinneta lihot roa leom esrim ze vaze asurin shinneta faamayim leom esrim ze vaze asurin shinneta shalosh peamim leom esrim huttar chamishsha asar vekava lah yom esrim sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim veenah mittaheret haveset ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim

Niddah 10:1: Tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset bet shammay omrim notnin lah arbaa lelot uvet hillel omrim ad shettichye hammakka higgia zemannah lirot venisset bet shammay omrim notnin lah layela harishon uvet hillel omrim ad motzae shabbat arbaa lelot raata veodah bevet aviha bet shammay omrim notnin lah beilat mitzva uvet hillel omrim kal hallayela kullah
Niddah 10:2: Nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit umatzta tehora uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar yamim badka umatzta temea hare hi vechezkat tahora badka atzmah bayyom hashshevii beshacharit umatzta temea uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar zeman badka umatzta tehora hare zo vechezkat tuma umtammea meet leet umippekida lifkida veim yesh lah veset dayyah sheatah rabbi yehuda omer kol shello hifrisha vetahora min hammincha ulmala hare zo vechezkat tuma vachachamim omrim afillu vashsheniyya leniddatah badka umatzta tehora uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar zeman badka umatza temea hare zo vechezkat tahora
Niddah 10:3: Hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman beom rishon umatzu tahor uvayyom hashshevii umatzu tahor ushar yamim shebbentayim lo vadku rabbi eliezer omer hare hen bechezkat tahora rabbi yehoshua omer en lahem ella yom rishon veom shevii vilvad rabbi akiva omer en lahem ella yom shevii vilvad
Niddah 10:4: Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehamtzora shemmetu metammein bemassa ad sheyyimmok habbasar nachri shemmet tahor milletamme vemassa bet shammay omrim kal hannashim metot niddot uvet hillel omrim en nidda ella shemmeta nidda
Niddah 10:5: Haishsha shemmeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam metammea mishshum ketem umtammea veohel rabbi yehuda omer enah metammea mishshum ketem mippene shenneekar mishshemmeta umode rabbi yehuda beoshevet al mashber umeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam shehi metammea mishshum ketem amar rabbi yose lefichach enah metammea veohel
Niddah 10:6: Barishona hau omrim hayyoshevet al dam tohar hayeta meara mayim lappesach chazru lomar hare hi chemagga teme met lakkadashim kedivre vet hillel bet shammay omrim af kitme met
Niddah 10:7: Umodim shehi ochelet bammaaser vekotza lah challa umakkefet vekora lah shem veim nafal merukkah umiddam tahorah al kikkar shel teruma shehu tahor bet shammay omrim tzericha tevila baacharona uvet hillel omrim enah tzericha tevila baacharona
Niddah 10:8: Haroa yom achad asar vetavla laerev veshimmesha bet shammay omrim metammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bakkarban uvet hillel omrim peturin min hakkarban tavla vaom shelleacharav veshimmesha et betah veachar kach raata bet shammay omrim metammein mishkav umoshav ufturim min hakkarban uvet hillel omrim hare ze gargeran umodim beroa vetoch achad asar yom vetavla laerev veshimmesha shemmetammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bakkarban tavla vayyom shelleacharav veshimmesha hare zo tarbut raa umaggaan uvilatan teluyim
Makhshirin 1:1: Kal mashke shettechillato leratzon af al pi sheen sofo leratzon o shessofo leratzon af al pi sheen techillato leratzon hare ze vechi yuttan mashkin temeim metammein leratzon veshello leratzon
Makhshirin 1:2: Hammarid et hailan lehashshir mimmennu ochalin o et hattuma enan bechi yuttan lehashshir mimmennu mashkin bet shammay omrim hayyotzin veet shebbo bechi yuttan bet hillel omrim hayyotzin bechi yuttan veet shebbo enan bechi yuttan mippene shehu mitkaven sheyyetzu mikkullo
Makhshirin 1:3: Hammarid et hailan venafal al chavero o socha venafla al chavertah vetachtehen zeraim o yerakot hamchubbarin lakkarka bet shammay omrim bechi yuttan bet hillel omrim enan bechi yuttan amar rabbi yehoshua mishshum abba yose chale kufri ish tivon temah atzmecha im yesh mashke tame vattora ad sheyyitkaven veyitten shenneemar vkr y vechi yuttan mayim al zera
Makhshirin 1:4: Hannoer agudda shel yarak veyardu mitztzad haelon lattachton bet shammay omrim bechi yuttan bet hillel omrim enam bechi yuttan amru vet hillel levet shammay vahalo hannoer et hakkelach choshshin anu shemma yatzu min heale leale amru lahen bet shammay shehakkelach echad vaagudda kelachim harbe amru lahem bet hillel hare hammaale sak male ferot untano al gav hannahar choshshin anu shemma yardu mitztzad haelon lattachton aval im heela shenayim untanan ze al gav ze hattachton bechi yuttan verabbi yose omer hattachton tahor
Makhshirin 1:5: Hammachek et hakkeresha vehassochet searo bichsuto rabbi yose omer hayyotzin bechi yuttan veet shebbo enan bechi yuttan mippene shehu mitkaven sheyyetzu mikkullo
Makhshirin 1:6: Hannofeach baadashim levadkan im yafot hen rabbi shimon omer enan bechi yuttan vachachamim omrim bechi yuttan vehaochel shumshemin beetzbao mashkin sheal yado rabbi shimon omer enan bechi yuttan vachachamim omrim bechi yuttan hattomen perotav bammayim mippene haggannavim enan bechi yuttan maase veanshe yerushalayim shettamnu develatan bammayim mippene hassikarin vetiharu lahen chachamim hannoten perotav beshibbolet hannahar lahavian immo enan bechi yuttan
Makhshirin 2:1: Zeat battim borot shichin umarot tehora zeat haadam tehora shata mayim temein vehizzia zeato tehora ba vemayim sheuvim vehizzia zeato temea nistappeg veachar kach hizzia zeato tehora
Makhshirin 2:2: Merchatz temea zeatah temea uthora bechi yuttan habberecha shebbabbayit habbayit mazzia mechamatah im temea zeat kal habbayit shemmechamat habberecha temea
Makhshirin 2:3: Shette verechot achat tehora veachat temea hammazzia karov lattemea tame karov lattehora tahor mechetza lemechetza tame barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor im rov min hattame tame veim rov min hattahor tahor mechetza lemechetza tame gisteraot sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letochah im rov min hattame tame veim rov min hattahor tahor mechetza lemechetza tame me shefichut sheyyardu alehen me geshamim im rov min hattame tame veim rov min hattahor tahor mechetza lemechetza tame ematay bizman shekkadmu me shefichut aval im kadmu me geshamim afillu chal shehen leme shefichut tame
Makhshirin 2:4: Hattoref et gaggo vehamchabbes et kesuto veyardu alehen geshamim im rov min hattame tame veim rov min hattahor tahor mechetza lemechetza tame rabbi yehuda omer im hosifu lenattef
Makhshirin 2:5: Ir sheyyisrael venachrim darim bah vehaya vah merchatz marchetzet beshabbat im rov nachrim rochetz miyyad veim rov yisrael yamtin kede sheyyechammu hachammin mechetza lemechetza yamtin kede sheyyechammu hachammin rabbi yehuda omer beambati ketanna im yesh bah rashut rochetz bah miyyad
Makhshirin 2:6: Matza vah yarak nimkar im rov nachrim lokeach miyyad veim rov yisrael yamtin kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov mechetza lemechetza yamtin kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov veim yesh bo rashut lokeach miyyad
Makhshirin 2:7: Matza vah tinok mushlach im rov nachrim nachri veim rov yisrael yisrael mechetza lemechetza yisrael rabbi yehuda omer holchin achar rov hammashlichin
Makhshirin 2:8: Matza vah metzia im rov nachrim eno tzarich lehachriz veim rov yisrael tzarich lehachriz mechetza lemechetza tzarich lehachriz matza vah pat holchin achar rov hannachtomin veim hayeta fat issa holchim achar rov ochle fat issa rabbi yehuda omer im hayeta fat kibbar holchin achar rov ochle fat kibbar
Makhshirin 2:9: Matza vah basar holchin achar rov hattabbachim im haya mevushshal holchim achar rov ochle vasar mevushshal
Makhshirin 2:10: Hammotze ferot badderech im rov machnisin levattehen patur velimkor bashshuk chayyav mechetza lemechetza demay otzar sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letocho im rov nachrim vadday veim rov yisrael demay mechetza lemechetza vadday divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim afillu chullam nachrim veyisrael echad mattil letocho demay
Makhshirin 2:11: Perot sheniyya sherabbu al shel shelishit veshel shelishit al shel reviit veshel reviit al shel chamishit veshel chamishit al shel shishshit veshel shishshit al shel sheviit veshel sheviit al shel motzae sheviit holchin achar harov mechetza lemechetza lehachamir
Makhshirin 3:1: Sak shehu male ferot untano al gav hannahar o al pi habbor o al maalot hammeara veshaavu kol sheshshaavu bechi yuttan rabbi yehuda omer kol shehu cheneged hammayim bechi yuttan vechol sheeno cheneged hammayim eno bechi yuttan
Makhshirin 3:2: Chavit shehi melea ferot untuna letoch hammashkin o melea mashkin untuna letoch happerot veshaavu kol sheshshaavu bechi yuttan beellu mashkim amru bemayim uvyayin uvchometz ushar kal hammashkin tehorin rabbi nechemya metaher bekitnit sheen hakkitnit shoavet
Makhshirin 3:3: Harode fat chamma untanah al pi chavit shel yayin rabbi meir metamme rabbi yehuda metaher rabbi yose metaher beshel chittim umtamme veshel seorim mippene shehasseorim shoavot
Makhshirin 3:4: Hamrabbetz et beto venatan bo chittim vetannu im mechamat hammayim bechi yuttan veim mechamat hassela enan bechi yuttan hamchabbes et kesuto baareva natan bah chittim vetannu im mechamat hammayim bechi yuttan im mechamat atzman enan bechi yuttan hamtannen bechol hare ze vechi yuttan maase veanshe hammachoz shehau metinnin bechol amru lahem chachamim im kach heyitem osim lo asitem tahora mimechem
Makhshirin 3:5: Hamtannen betit hannaguv rabbi shimon omer im yesh bo mashke tofeach bechi yuttan veim lav eno bechi yuttan hamrabbetz et garno eno choshesh shemma natan bah chittim vetannu hamlakket asavim keshehattal alehem lehaten bahem chittim enan bechi yuttan im nitkaven lechach hare ze vechi yuttan hammolich chittin litchon veyardu alehen geshamim im samach bechi yuttan rabbi yehuda omer i efshar shello lismoach ella im amad
Makhshirin 3:6: Hau zetav netunim baggag veyardu alehen geshamim im samach bechi yuttan rabbi yehuda omer i efshar shello lismoach ella im pakak et hatztzinnor o im chilchel letochan
Makhshirin 3:7: Hachammarin shehau ovrim bannahar venaflu sakkehem lammayim im samchu bechi yuttan rabbi yehuda omer i efshar shello lismoach ella im hafchu hau raglav meleot tit vechen ragle vehemto avar bannahar im samach bechi yuttan rabbi yehuda omer i efshar shello lismoach ella im amad vehediach beadam uvivhema temea leolam tame
Makhshirin 3:8: Hammorid et haggalgallim veet kele habbakar bishat hakkadim lammayim bishvil sheyyachutzu hare ze vechi yuttan hammorid behema lishtot hammayim haolim befiha bechi yuttan uvragleha enan bechi yuttan im chashav sheyyudchu ragleha af haolin beragleha bechi yuttan bishat hayyachaf vehaddayish leolam tame horid cheresh shote vekatan af al pi shechoshev sheyyudchu ragleha enan bechi yuttan sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava
Makhshirin 4:1: Hashshoche lishtot hammayim haolim befiv uvisfamo bechi yuttan bechatmo uvrosho uvizkano enan bechi yuttan hammalle bechavit hammayim haolim achareha uvachevel shehu mechunnan al tzavarah uvachevel shehu letzarkah hare ze vechi yuttan kamma hu tzarkah rabbi shimon ben elazar omer tefach netanah tachat hatztzinnor enan bechi yuttan
Makhshirin 4:2: Mi sheyyardu alav geshamim afillu av hattuma eno vechi yuttan veim nier bechi yuttan amad tachat hatztzinnor lehaker o liddoach betame temein uvtahor bechi yuttan
Makhshirin 4:3: Hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach hare ze vechi yuttan im bishvil shello yilke hakkotel enan bechi yuttan
Makhshirin 4:4: Chavit sheyyarad haddelef letochah bet shammay omrim yeshabber bet hillel omrim yeare umodim shehu moshit et yado venotel perot mittochah vehem tehorim
Makhshirin 4:5: Areva sheyyarad haddelef letochah hannittazin vehatztzafin enan bechi yuttan netalah leshafchah bet shammay omrim bechi yuttan bet hillel omrim enan bechi yuttan hinnichah sheyyered haddelef letochah hannittazin vehatztzafin bet shammay omrim bechi yuttan bet hillel omrim enan bechi yuttan netalah leshafchah ellu vaellu modim shehen bechi yuttan hammatbil et hakkelim vehamchabbes et kesuto bimara hammayim haolim beyadav bechi yuttan beraglav enan bechi yuttan rabbi elazar omer im i efshar lo sheyyered ella im ken nittannefu raglav af haolin beraglav bechi yuttan
Makhshirin 4:6: Kuppa shehi melea turmosin untanuha letoch mikve moshit yado venotel turmosin mittochah vehem tehorim heelam min hammayim hannogim bakkuppa temeim ushar kal hatturmosim tehorim tzenon shebbammeara nidda medichato vehu tahor heelattu chal shehu min hammayim tame
Makhshirin 4:7: Perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim pashat mi shehau yadav temeot untalan yadav tehorot vehapperot tehorim veim chashav sheyyudchu yadav yadav tehorot vehapperot bechi yuttan

Oktzin 2:6: Betza megulgelet ad sheyyagos ushluka ad sheyerasses etzem sheyyesh bo moach chibbur ad sheyerasses harimmon shepperado chibbur ad sheyyakkish alav bekane kayyotze vo shelal hakkovsin vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim chibbur ad sheyyatchil lehattir
Oktzin 2:7: Ale yerakot yerukkim mitztarfin ulvanim enan mitztarfin rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer hallevanim mitztarfim bakkeruv mippene shehen ochel uvachazarim mippene shehen meshammerin et haochel
Oktzin 2:8: Ale vetzalim uvne vetzalim im yesh bahen rir mishtaarin bichmot shehen im yesh bahen chalal memaech et chalalan pat sefoganit mishtaeret bichmot shehi im yesh bah chalal memaech et chalalah besar haegel shennitpach uvsar zekena shennitmaet mishtaarin bichmot shehen
Oktzin 2:9: Kishshut shennetaah beatzitz vehigdila veyatza chutz leatzitz tehora amar rabbi shimon ma tivah littaher ella hattame betumato vehattahor yeachel
Oktzin 2:10: Kele gelalim uchle adama shehashsharashim yecholin latzet bahen enam machshirim et hazzeraim atzitz nakuv eno machshir et hazzeraim vesheeno nakuv machshir et hazzeraim kamma hu shiuro shel nekev kede sheyyetze vo shoresh katan milahu afar ad sefato hare hu chetavla sheen lah lizbez
Oktzin 3:1: Yesh tzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichim machashava machashava vehechsher machashava velo hechsher lo hechsher velo machashava kal haochalim hamyuchadim laadam tzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichim machashava
Oktzin 3:2: Hachotech min haadam umin habbehema umin hachayya umin haofot minnivlat haof hattame vehachelev bakkefarim ushar kal yarkot sade chutz mishshemarkaim ufitriyyot rabbi yehuda omer chutz mikkereshe sade vehargila venetz hechalav rabbi shimon omer chutz min haakkaviyyot rabbi yose omer chutz min hakkelusin hare ellu tzerichin machashava vehechsher
Oktzin 3:3: Nivlat behema temea bechal makom venivlat haof hattahor bakkefarim tzerichin machashava veenan tzerichin hechsher nivlat behema tehora bechal makom venivlat haof hattahor vehachelev bashshevakim enan tzerichin machashava velo hechsher rabbi shimon omer af haggamal vehaarnevet vehashshafan vehachazir
Oktzin 3:4: Hashshevet mishshennatan tamo bakkedera en bo mishshum teruma veeno mittamme tumat ochalim lulve zeradim veshel adal vaale halluf hashshote enan mittammein tumat ochalim ad sheyyimtoku rabbi shimon omer af shel pakkuot kayyotze vahem
Oktzin 3:5: Hakkoshte vehachemes verashe vesamim hattia vehachiltit vehappilpelin vechallot charia nilkachim bechesef maaser veenan mittammein tumat ochalin divre rabbi akiva amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri im nilkachim bechesef maaser mippene ma enan mittammein tumat ochalin veim enan mittammein tumat ochalim af hem lo yillakchu vechesef maaser
Oktzin 3:6: Happaggin vehabboser rabbi akiva metamme tumat ochalin rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer mishsheyyavou leonat hammaasrot peritze zetim vaanavim bet shammay metammein uvet hillel metaharin hakketzach bet shammay metaharin uvet hillel metammein vechen lammaasrot
Oktzin 3:7: Hakkor hare hu cheetz lechal davar ella shehu nilkach bechesef maaser kafniyyot ochalin ufturot min hammaasrot
Oktzin 3:8: Dagim meematay mekabbelin tuma bet shammay omrim mishsheyyitztzodu uvet hillel omrim mishsheyyamutu rabbi akiva omer im yecholin lichot yichur shel teena shennifshach umore vakkelippa rabbi yehuda metaher vachachamim omrim im yachol lichot tevua shenneekra umora afillu veshoresh katan tehora
Oktzin 3:9: Chelev behema tehora eno mittamme tumat nevelot lefichach hu tzarich hechsher chelev behema temea mittamme tumat nevelot lefichach eno tzarich hechsher dagim temeim vachagavim temeim tzerichin machashava bakkefarim
Oktzin 3:10: Kaveret devorim rabbi eliezer omer hare hi chekarka vechotvin aleha perozbul veenah mekabbelet tuma vimkomah veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav chattat vachachamim omrim enah kekarka veen kotvim aleha perozbul umkabbelet tuma vimkomah veharode mimmenna beshabbat patur
Oktzin 3:11: Challot devash meematay mittammeot mishshum mashke bet shammay omrim mishsheyecharcher bet hillel omrim mishsheyerassek
Oktzin 3:12: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanchil lechal tzaddik vetzaddik shelosh meot vaasara olamot shenneemar mshly ch lehanchil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle amar rabbi shimon ben chalafta lo matza hakkadosh baruch hu keli machazik beracha leyisrael ella hashshalom shenneemar tehillim cht oz leammo yitten yevarech et ammo vashshalom
